title: Head of Brand & Sponsorship
description:
Capital.com is scaling fast, and this role makes sure that ambition shows up everywhere the brand does. Reporting to the Brand Director, you’ll own delivery end to end, turning brand strategy into standout campaigns and building a sponsorship and events function that makes every partnership work harder. It’s a hands-on role for someone as comfortable running a campaign timeline as negotiating a sponsorship deal or managing an event on-site. Working with the CMO, Head of Creative, PR and regional teams, you’ll have real influence over how Capital.com shows up globally as it pursues premiumisation and expansion.

### **Responsibilities:**

**Brand Campaigns**

* Own end-to-end delivery of Capital.com's big-ticket brand campaigns, turning the Brand Director's strategy into standout, well-executed work across markets
* Partner closely with the Head of Creative, who leads creative production, to ensure every campaign is built and delivered to a premium standard
* Work with market analysts and the PR team to align campaign timing, messaging and measurement
* Manage campaign budgets, timelines and sign-off across multiple markets and stakeholders
* Lead delivery across campaigns of every scale, from moments built around a global brand asset to local activity such as a UK spread betting campaign or a new performance-led campaign for the paid social team
* Feed into the strategic thinking behind paid social alongside the paid social team, for example how a new channel is seeded with initial paid support, or how an organic boosting strategy is agreed and backed with paid
* Bring imagination to how the brand shows up, finding new ways to express Capital.com's premiumisation and expansion ambitions through brand activity

**Sponsorship & Events**

* Own the sponsorship and events function end to end: evaluating and negotiating new opportunities, then delivering the activations that bring them to life
* Draw on activation support at global level from the events team and at local level from regional marketing leads and local offices, so delivery is never carried alone
* Evaluate opportunities across sport, conferences and other partnerships against clear criteria for brand fit, audience relevance and commercial value
* Lead negotiation and management of sponsorship contracts, protecting Capital.com's interests and tracking every commitment on both sides
* Build and maintain relationships with rights holders, sports marketing agencies and event partners as the primary point of contact
* Plan and deliver event activations and client hospitality end to end — suppliers, guest lists, merchandise, booths — working with the design team so every physical presence reflects the brand
* Collaborate with the CMO, regional marketing managers and regional CEOs to align sponsorship priorities across markets and activate global properties locally
* Work with Compliance and Legal to ensure all sponsorship and event activity meets regulatory requirements across Capital.com's jurisdictions
* Track and report on sponsorship performance and ROI, and build out the sponsorship and events team as the function grows

### **Requirements:**

* **Senior experience delivering brand campaigns end to end.**
* **Experience within a financial services or fintech business.**
* **Proven experience delivering sponsorship activation end to end, from deal negotiation through to on-site activation.**
* Breadth beyond sport (e.g. culture, academia, thought leadership) and integrated activation skills across social, content and brand campaigns, not just hospitality.
* Experience activating global properties across multiple markets.
* Strong commercial focus: you can articulate the value a sponsorship brings to the business and use it as a vehicle to drive acquisition.
* Experience in our industry or regulated financial services.
* Confidence negotiating commercial contracts and evaluating opportunities critically rather than just enthusiastically.
* Excellent relationship management across rights holders, creative partners and senior stakeholders in a multi-market structure.
* Comfortable building a function from a small base, with willingness to travel roughly 20% of the time.

### **Nice to have:**

* Existing relationships with sports rights holders, conference organisers or sports marketing agencies
* Agency-side background in sponsorship, experiential or brand campaign delivery
* Experience managing brand or sponsorship activity across multiple international markets simultaneously

### **What you will get in return:**

* Competitive Salary: We believe great work deserves great pay! Your skills and talents will be rewarded with a salary that makes you feel valued and motivated.
* Work-Life Harmony: Join a company that genuinely cares about *you*—because your life outside of work matters just as much as your time on the clock.
* Annual Performance Bonus: Your hard work doesn’t go unnoticed! Celebrate your achievements with a well-deserved annual bonus tied to your performance.
* Generous Time Off: Need a breather? Our annual leave policy lets you recharge and enjoy life outside of work without a worry.
* Employee Referral Program: Love working here? Share the love! Bring your talented friends on board and get rewarded for growing our awesome team.
* Comprehensive Health & Pension Benefits: From medical insurance to pension plans, we’ve got your back. Plus, location-specific benefits and perks!
* Workation Wonderland: Live your digital nomad dreams with 30 extra days to work remotely from anywhere in the world (some restrictions apply). Adventure awaits!
* Volunteer Days: Make a difference! Take two additional paid days each year to support causes you care about and give back to the community

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Head of Creative
description:
**Head of Creative**

**Department:**
Marketing

**Reports to:**
CMO

**Location:**
London Bridge, London (hybrid)

**Role Type:**
Full-time, permanent

**About Us**

At Cambridge Audio, we're a different sort of global audio company, resolutely independent and always authentic.

We're on a mission to break down barriers to top-tier sound, so it's not the exception, but the norm. It's what we've been doing for over 50 years, and we're only just getting started.

Our award-winning product lineup includes headphones, lifestyle audio, and premium hi-fi. We also own StreamMagic, our own music streaming platform, plus a music venue and bar called Melomania at our London Bridge HQ.

Work at Cambridge Audio is more than just a job. We're passionate about what we do, and have fun doing it, developing our skills and careers, plus those of the colleagues around us. Learn more at https://cambridgeaudio.com/about-us

**Our Culture**

A shared love for music and a commitment to exceptional products and customer experience drive us. With strong team spirit across our five global offices, our core values define our work:

* **Made By Music -**
  Inspired by shared passion and independence.
* **Pride in our product and service -**
  Obsess over detail, always learning and improving.
* **Embrace the culture -**
  Integrity, Innovation, Energy, Openness, Teamwork, Diversity, Flexibility, Fun, Music.
* **Make an impact -**
  See it through. Go the extra mile.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an exceptional person to join Cambridge Audio at a crucial time. We launched our new identity last year and have released a run of category-defining products through 2026, earning awards, critical acclaim and design accolades along the way. We need a Head of Creative to set the creative standard for what comes next. You will be the creative authority for the brand, responsible for the quality, consistency and impact of everything we put into the world, from product film and photography to web, print and live events. You will work closely with the CMO and the Head of PR and lead a small in-house creative studio. The company is small, the goals are demanding and the pace is high.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Set the creative vision:**
  Define and champion the creative direction across all channels (web, print, video, physical and digital), expressing our pillars:
  *Inspired by music. Crafted by design. Shaped by culture.*
* **Lead the function:**
  Own the creative team, workflow, budget and resourcing, blending in-house talent with agencies, copywriters and freelancers to deliver first-class work.
* **Lead the work from concept to delivery:**
  Art direct every shoot and campaign, owning the quality of the output and the results it delivers.
* **Own content direction:**
  Help shape and deliver a content strategy built around our brand pillars that reaches the right audiences, with a clear view of what success looks like.
* **Unite copy and design:**
  Direct tone of voice and copy alongside visual work. Own and evolve the brand guidelines and roll them out consistently across global markets.
* **Connect product and marketing:**
  Work with Engineering, Product and Marketing to shape creative requirements early in product development.
* **Be a voice of the brand:**
  Present the brand and creative direction to listeners, press, retailers and internal teams with confidence.
* **Build the process:**
  Put in place the planning, briefing and approval processes that let a small team deliver at pace without compromising standards.
* **Stay hands-on:**
  Pitch in and support design at busy times with the right skills and tools.

**Requirements**

* Creative Director/Head of Creative experience leading creative teams and external partners, including remotely, delivering on time and on budget across the campaign lifecycle from concept to delivery.
* A strong creative portfolio across multiple mediums and channels, including AV, Stills, Digital and ATL.
* Agency or similar in-house studio experience is essential.
* Passion for music, contemporary culture and technology.
* Deep understanding of how brand contributes to business growth, helping Cambridge Audio reach new audiences, drive product relevance, and open up new opportunities.
* Experience in hiring, nurturing and developing creative talent.
* Experienced in the use of and experimentation with AI as a copilot, or at least genuinely receptive and excited to experiment with AI design tools and integrate them into your workflow.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the confidence to represent the brand.
* Strong planning and project management skills in a small, scaling business.

**Desirable**

* Experience in technology and/or lifestyle businesses, Agency or publishing background
* Experience repositioning or evolving a brand with heritage
* Adobe Creative Suite proficiency and/or Web UX/UI experience.
* Understanding of how brand and creative drive business growth, product relevance and new audiences

**Personal Profile**

* Charismatic, personable and easy to work with.
* Driven, with the conviction to guide change and the drive to keep the brand relevant and ahead of the curve.

**Working Pattern & Duration**

Full-time, permanent.

**Location**

This role is based at our London Bridge HQ on a hybrid basis. We're looking for someone based in or near London who can be in the office regularly.

**Compensation**

Competitive salary based on experience.

**Benefits**

**Health & Wellbeing**

* Subsidised private healthcare (50:50 contribution)
* Annual wellness benefit pot covering 50% of life-enriching activities
* Annual life-enhancement training allowance
* 24/7 GP and Mental Health assistance

**Time & Flexibility**

* Charity volunteer days - 3 per year to support a cause of your choice
* 4pm finish on the last Friday of every month

**Social & Culture**

* Regular socials organised by our "Director of Fun"
* Annual team trips to surprise destinations
* 50% off gigs and festivals with our "Passion for Music" benefit

**Recognition & Rewards**

* Profit share scheme
* Colleague suggestion scheme to shape the way we work

**Equal Opportunities Statement**

Cambridge Audio is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. If you need any adjustments to the recruitment process, let us know.

**How To Apply**

Please click 'APPLY' and it will redirect you to our Careers Page on our website. Complete the form to submit your details with CV and cover letter. All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

Please do NOT apply via LinkedIn directly.

Read our candidate privacy notice: https://www.cambridgeaudio.com/candidate-privacy-notice to see how we handle your data.

title: Senior Director Creative Strategy
description:
Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies with an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, skin care and body care. COTY is the global leader in fragrance and number three in color cosmetics. COTY’s products are sold in over 150 countries around the world. COTY and its brands are committed to range of social causes as well as seeking to minimize its impact on the environment. For additional information about Coty Inc., please visit www.coty.com.
  
  
**MISSION**
Reporting to the SVP Brand & Equity, the role of Creative Strategy Snr Director, Consumer Beauty will be fully responsible for leading creative strategy across the iconic brands within the CB portfolio: across Color cosmetics and Mass scenting.
  
  
This pivotal role will partner with the creative teams and brand teams to enable disruptive thinking, ideas and execution – writing innovative creative strategy, cultural levers and conceptual ideas borne of consumer insight.
  
  
This is a hybrid role, half strategist half creative. The Creative Strategy Snr Director – Consumer Beauty might need to write a headline one day, write a compelling pithy presentation the next, a script the next, and think through what the cultural springboard is for a brand or a campaign. Or take the SVP’s place in a creative review to ensure the work is clear, effective and impactful, and refined until delivery. All while taking pressure off the SVP to free up focus for higher-level priorities.
  
  
Coty is a challenger brand; work is intense and entrepreneurial. It is agile and fast. Immediacy and hands on attitude is critical. Autonomy is pivotal.
  
  
Please note that whilst this position will be based in our Wimbledon Office, we do offer a flexible Omni-working policy which means that up to 50% of your hours will be based from the office and the remaining 50% of your hours can be remote.
  
  
**THE ROLE**

* Leading Creative strategy across the iconic brands within the Consumer Beauty portfolio.
* A unicorn with the ability to write disruptive creative strategy, borne of consumer insight, and concept ideas with the creatives.
* Critical ability to write in a pithy and provocative way, with fearless clarity.
* Partner with the creative teams to enable disruptive thinking, ideas and execution – helping generate vital creative thought starters which can be further developed.
* Pivotal ability to help teams (creative and brand) ‘see’ the idea amongst the clutter of creative development; articulating, expanding, and presenting story telling in a way that becomes unmissable and strategically flawless.
* Develop product claims and (both traditional and contemporary) to create something innovative that the world cannot miss!
* Responsible for creative strategy across color cosmetics, personal care, nail and mass scenting/fragrance.
* Social first thinker - with the ability to brand build in the new Meta led landscape our brands now live in.
* Connected to global culture, knowledgeable.
* GLOBAL - this is global business. Must be well versed in US beauty, as well as European beauty.
* A realist - not precious – if it doesn’t work or is too highbrow, move on!
* Hand-On. Not a floater waiting for other to action.

**What You’ll Bring**
Knowledge and Experience:
  
  

* 15+ years experience in an agency/in-house brand creative strategist.
* Global in outlook
* TikTok and socially savvy.
* Consumer first thinker.
* Ability to co-create with the SVP Brand & Equity, the creative teams, third parties and the brand teams within a highly collaborative environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of hierarchy with both multifunctional partners and with external stakeholders.
* A ‘roll the sleeves up do-er’ not a floater. We are an entrepreneurial set of people that think and do, and we do it fast.
* Ability to work autonomously under pressure.
* Agile and adaptable as the business and brand environment changes daily.
* Experienced in the new beauty world - not the old traditional world.
* A good beauty aesthete - this person needs judgment and an eye. They will take responsibility for the work being on brand, on strategy and effective (passing IPSOS tests, and driving in market growth)

**REQUIRED SKILLS:**

* Ability to think creatively, highly-driven and self-motivated.
* Digitally literate and culturally plugged in.
* Well versed in UK/EU/Global mass consumer beauty universes (color cosmetics and fragrance)
* Ability to work in an international business context.

**CONCLUDING**
You’ll get to work in a diverse and environment with a team who are passionate about the work they do and know how to have some fun along the way. Our people make us who we are. They are the brightest minds bringing the boldest ideas to life every day. If you’re the kind of person who refuses to settle, if you want to think bigger, learn faster and go further than you ever thought possible, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Head of Creative
description:
**Intro**

 

Founded by sisters Louisa and Rebecca, Regalrose is a British-born ecommerce jewellery retailer with over 15 years in business. Specialising in uniquely designed jewellery and accessories with a fierce edge and dreamy-dark twist, Regalrose is going from strength to strength as demonstrated by our exceptional growth over the last few years. We have built up a loyal community of passionate fans and customers, delivering our products to over 80 countries worldwide. We are now looking for an outstanding and experienced Head of Creative to join our team in our offices, located in St Albans.

 

 

**About You**

 

You will be a driven, self-motivated creative leader with an exceptional eye for brand and at least 10 years’ creative experience, or experience running a creative function as a Head of, Director or Senior Manager – ideally in fashion, jewellery or accessories. You will hold very high standards, make fast, confident creative calls under pressure, balance creativity with commercial awareness, and stay hands-on with asset creation while leading a team.

 

 

**Requirements and Skills**

 

As Head of Creative, you will be the guardian of the Regalrose brand – owning how it looks, sounds and feels across every channel, campaign and the website. Working from the founders’ vision, you will turn each collection into concepts, briefs, photography, copy and assets, lead the in-house creative team and have final creative approval on all outward-facing marketing. You will work as a peer to the Head of Marketing, who owns the commercial and go-to-market plan.

 

 

**The Role and Accountabilities**

Overall goal: Protect and grow the Regalrose brand by ensuring every piece of marketing and website output is on brand, to the highest standard and right first time.

 

*Brand guardian:*


 

* Final creative decision-maker, with a brand veto on any marketing output.
* Own the brand guidelines, copy and content rules, tone of voice, and social narrative and seasonal themes.
* Keep the brand culturally relevant, filtering trends and performance insight through the brand lens.

*Collection & campaign launches:*


 

* Turn the founders’ campaign vision into concepts, themes and the creative brief for every launch.

title: AI-Enabled Creative Director (US-Based)
description:
As an
**AI-Enabled Creative Director**
, you will turn complex business challenges into compelling creative ideas while making AI an essential part of how creative work is developed and delivered.

You will lead multidisciplinary teams, shape creative direction, and confidently sell ideas to clients. Beyond using AI tools yourself, you will build and apply practical workflows that expand creative possibilities, improve production efficiency, and help your teams deliver exceptional work.

This role calls for both strong creative leadership and hands-on AI expertise. You know how to inspire people, make confident creative decisions, and use emerging technology to elevate the work without compromising originality, strategy, or quality.

Designity is a premium, AI-enabled and human-led Creative-as-a-Service platform. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.

**Why this role exists**

Designity is moving beyond Creative Directors who use AI for occasional tasks toward leaders who can integrate it meaningfully throughout client projects.

With each Creative Circle supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts, maintaining exceptional creative quality while managing continuous production requires smarter, more effective ways of working.

We need a Creative Director who can turn AI into a practical advantage: expanding creative possibilities when developing ideas, building workflows that streamline asset production, and helping creative teams work more effectively.

This role brings hands-on AI expertise into our existing Creative Director model. It is not a company wide AI systems position, but a client-facing creative leadership role that combines AI implementation with strong strategic thinking, independent decision-making, and end-to-end creative ownership.

**What you will be doing**

* **Set the creative vision**
  – Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and disciplines, translating business objectives into compelling concepts, campaigns, brand identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* **Sell and champion creative ideas**
  – Present concepts with confidence, articulate the strategy behind your recommendations, and build buy-in from both clients and creative teams. Navigate objections assertively and constructively while protecting the integrity of the work.
* **Build and implement AI-enabled workflows**
  – Develop practical workflows for your client projects, combining AI tools to streamline asset creation, refinement, and production. Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work, improve efficiency, and strengthen execution.
* **Expand creative possibilities through AI**
  – Use AI to explore new directions, challenge conventional approaches, and develop stronger creative solutions. Apply the technology where it adds meaningful value, not simply because it is available.
* **Lead and mentor multidisciplinary creatives**
  – Provide clear direction, actionable feedback, and support to designers, writers, motion specialists, and other creative professionals. Help teams strengthen their craft and incorporate AI effectively into their work.
* **Own the creative lifecycle**
  – Stay involved from the initial brief through final delivery, overseeing execution and quality control. Ensure every asset meets the highest standards of strategic relevance, originality, brand consistency, and production quality.
* **Collaborate closely with Creative Project Managers (CPMs)**
  – Partner with your CPM to align priorities, navigate feedback, and support smooth project execution while maintaining ownership of creative direction and outcomes.
* **Anticipate and resolve challenges**
  – Proactively identify creative or client issues, make confident decisions, and find solutions independently. Take responsibility for keeping creative work moving without relying on managerial escalation.

**What you will bring**

* **Around 8 years of relevant creative experience**
  , including at least
  **2 years in creative leadership and 2 years of hands-on experience applying AI to creative workflows**
  .
* **An outstanding creative portfolio with strong AI-enabled samples**
  , demonstrating strategic thinking, originality, and high-quality execution across creative disciplines. You can clearly explain your role, creative decisions, and the impact of AI on the final work.
* **Proven experience developing and implementing AI-powered creative workflows**
  , combining technologies such as Higgsfield, Weavy, or comparable tools to enhance creative development and production. Your expertise goes beyond basic prompting or isolated AI-generated assets.
* **A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving**
  , with the confidence to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and independently resolve creative or client issues without waiting for direction.
* **Exceptional organization and attention to detail**
  , with the ability to balance competing priorities, identify inconsistencies, maintain brand standards, and deliver high-quality work across multiple projects.
* **Assertive, persuasive communication skills**
  , with a demonstrated ability to pitch and sell creative ideas, defend recommendations, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment among both clients and creative teams.
* **Experience leading and mentoring multidisciplinary creatives**
  , providing decisive direction, constructive feedback, and the motivation needed to bring ambitious ideas to life.
* **Strong creative and strategic judgment**
  , grounded in branding, storytelling, art direction, design, and audience-centered communication, with an understanding of responsible AI use and the importance of human oversight.
* **Experience managing a high volume and variety of creative deliverables**
  across multiple clients, brands, or products in fast-paced agency or in-house environments.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, along with the adaptability, reliability, and strong internet connection needed to succeed in a remote environment

**How we work**

Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection.

You will work within a
**Creative Circle alongside a Creative Project Manager (CPM) and a multidisciplinary team of creative professionals**
, supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts.

Your CPM partners with you on project coordination, timelines, priorities, and delivery. As the Creative Director, you lead creative strategy, guide the team, own the creative side of client relationships, and remain accountable for the quality of work from initial brief through final delivery.

**This role requires a high level of independence and accountability.**
You will operate autonomously without a Head of Department managing your day-to-day creative decisions or resolving routine client challenges on your behalf. We expect you to anticipate issues, communicate assertively, make sound decisions, and take ownership of solutions while keeping your CPM and creative team aligned.

**What this role offers**

* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards
* Total compensation of $90,000–$110,000 USD based on your qualifications.

**We believe great teams are built on shared values:**

* Choose Positivity and lift those around you.
* Say It Straight with honesty and respect.
* Raise the Bar by never settling for average.
* Take Ownership of your work and your impact.
* Move with Purpose and make every action count.

**Success in this role means:**

* Delivering original, strategically strong creative work across multiple client accounts, maintaining exceptional quality from concept through final execution.
* Making AI a practical part of creative production by implementing workflows that expand creative possibilities and improve efficiency.
* Building trust and alignment with clients and creatives through persuasive presentations, confident leadership, and clear creative direction.
* Proactively resolving challenges, managing priorities independently, and maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.
* Elevating team performance through effective mentorship, practical AI adoption, and consistently high creative standards.

**Disclaimer:**

**When applying, please include an updated portfolio showcasing the work you would like us to consider, along with relevant project links, supporting work, or samples of AI Creative Workflows.**

**For collaborative projects, clearly specify your contribution and the areas you were responsible for.**

Our team reviews every submission carefully and will contact candidates who best fit the role within 2–3 weeks.

Be cautious when applying. Official communications from Designity will come only from the Designity.com domain.

At Designity, employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences; it’s what makes our team and our work stronger.

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.
  
  
That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).
  
  
We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
  
  
Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
  
  
**Your Mission**
Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in-product moments, and beyond.
  
  
You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high-performing, on-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
  
  
This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
**build as much as they lead**
shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* **The AI-assisted creative engine.**
  Design the end-to-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.**
  Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.**
  Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.**
  Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In-person and experiential creative.**
  Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.
* **Brand-distinctive, entertainment-first work.**
  Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.
* **Testing velocity.**
  Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.
* **The creative team.**
  Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.

**How We'll Measure Success**
Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in-person moments.
  
  
Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.
* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance-driven digital work.
* Hands-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast-moving, AI-forward environment.

*We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.*
**Compensation**
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.
  
  
Base Pay Range
  
  
$157,505—$218,000 USD

We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
* **Benefits:**
  Check out our full list at engine.com/culture

‍
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

‍
  
  
You will work within a
**Creative Circle alongside a Creative Project Manager (CPM) and a multidisciplinary team of creative professionals**
, supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts.
  
  
‍
  
  
Your CPM partners with you on project coordination, timelines, priorities, and delivery. As the Creative Director, you lead creative strategy, guide the team, own the creative side of client relationships, and remain accountable for the quality of work from initial brief through final delivery.
  
  
‍
  
  
**This role requires a high level of independence and accountability.**

We expect you to anticipate issues, communicate assertively, make sound decisions, and take ownership of solutions while keeping your CPM and creative team aligned.

**What This Role Offers**

title: Creative Strategist, Mexico
description:
**Job Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
  
  
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
  
  
**Where And How You Can Work**
Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Mexico City so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.
  
  
This role is a 12 month engagement, working full time hours per week.
  
  
**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
As Creative Strategist for Mexico, you’ll be the creative performance engine behind Canva’s paid marketing in the region.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Growth, and Data - combining cultural insight, analytical depth, and creative instinct to continuously improve our performance marketing output. You won’t be running bids day-to-day - you’ll be driving the creative strategy that makes those campaigns win.
  
  
If you love decoding what makes a hook scroll-stopping, turning insights into structured testing, and raising the creative bar sprint after sprint, this role is for you.
  
  
**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**

* Leading the full creative cycle - research, briefing, production, and performance review — running weekly sprint cycles that balance quick-win iterations with bigger creative swings, and feeding learnings back to the broader team after every sprint
* Digging into performance dashboards to spot winning patterns, diagnose underperformance, and translate insights into clear, actionable creative direction that drives the next round of concepts
* Directing and collaborating with video editors, designers, writers, and local creators to produce high-quality work across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels - briefing and reviewing content to keep it on-brand, culturally relevant, and platform-optimised
* Bringing deep cultural fluency to every brief - identifying Mexican audience behaviours, regional trends, and platform dynamics that shape compelling, locally resonant storytelling
* Working closely with media buyers, data science, and the LatAm Growth Marketing Lead to make sure creative insights translate into measurable business outcomes

* Using AI tools to accelerate ideation, research, asset generation, and analysis - and staying across emerging formats and creative tech that give the team an edge

* You have solid experience in growth or performance marketing with a strong focus on creative strategy - and you've worked hands-on across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube
* You can lead structured creative testing and sprint frameworks, analyse what's working, and turn those learnings into clear briefs for the next cycle
* You have strong creative instinct - you know what makes a hook scroll-stopping, a format compelling, and a concept scalable across channels
* You're fluent in Spanish and English, with a sharp eye for tone, nuance, and cultural resonance for Mexican audiences
* You have experience briefing, directing, and iterating with creative talent — video editors, designers, writers, and creators - coaching them to produce performance-driven work
* You're confident using dashboards and analytics tools to inform decisions and optimise creative at scale
* You use AI tools to accelerate your workflow and improve output quality

**Meet the team**
We're Canva's LatAm Marketing group, and our mission is to make Canva the most loved brand in the region. We build culturally resonant, high-impact marketing across Latin America - combining bold creative storytelling with sharp performance thinking to drive visibility and growth, market by market. We make decisions to engage contractors based on your experience, skills and passion.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About JumpSeat**
JumpSeat is a B2B growth agency and advisory built around a simple belief: the best opportunities rarely come from the obvious signals.
  
  
We help go-to-market teams find the non-obvious signals others miss and turn them into highly relevant outreach that earns a response. It's an antidote to the automated, generic outbound buyers have learned to ignore.
  
  
Our Signal Intelligence methodology combines prioritized accounts, custom signal libraries, AI-assisted research, and 1:1 messaging based on what's actually happening inside a target account, before everybody else sees it.
  
  
We're a remote-first crew across the US and Buenos Aires. We care about bold, ground breaking work, and about the people who make it.
  
  
**The role**
We're looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative department.
  
  
This is more than a creative leadership role. You'll lead the people, the capacity, and the way we work: our two full-time creatives, our freelance bench, and the process that gets great work out the door. You'll partner with our delivery team on priorities, and set the vision and standards for the department.
  
  
You'll stay hands-on too, leading brand, campaign, web, and pitch work.
  
  
And you'll help shape how AI fits into our creative work. That means testing tools, deciding where and when they belong, and making sure they improve both the quality of what we make and the team's experience making it.
  
  
This is a senior role for someone with a proven track record leading creative in a fast-paced agency.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Lead the department.**

* Manage, mentor, and grow our two full-time creatives. Clear goals, honest feedback, real development.
* Set the creative vision and the way we work, then champion it across the agency.
* Build a team people want to be on, and a culture where the bar keeps rising.
* Bring the creative point of view to leadership conversations about where JumpSeat goes next.

**Run the engine.**

* Own capacity planning. Anticipate resourcing needs proactively and balance the load across the team.
* Know when we need more hands. Find, brief, and manage freelancers who meet our bar and our budget.
* Partner with the delivery team to set priorities, timelines, and scope.
* Keep sharpening the creative workflow, from brief to review to client handoff.
* Be the single point of contact for every creative deliverable. On brand, on time, every time.

**Raise the creative bar.**

* Own the quality of everything we make, across every client and channel.
* Lead brand development work: positioning, messaging, and visual identity.
* Concept and lead campaigns, ABM programs, and digital advertising.
* Oversee website design and development.
* Give clear, useful direction to designers and copywriters.
* Work closely with our strategy and account teams so creative work serves each client's business goals.
* Lead the creative side of new business pitches, from concept to presentation.

**Shape How We Use AI.**

* Experiment with AI tools across ideation, copy, design, and production.
* Decide where, when, and how AI tools and workflows are adopted in our day-to-day, based on one test: does it make the work better, and the work of making it better?
* Set practical guardrails for quality, brand fit, and client trust.
* Help the team build skill and confidence with new tools, and share what works across JumpSeat.

**Who You Are**

* A Creative Director, ACD, or Head of Creative from a strong agency, who has led a creative team directly.
* A department builder, not just a project lead. You've owned capacity, resourcing, and process, and you actually enjoy it.
* A true partner to delivery and account teams. Comfortable trading off priorities, scope, and timelines in the open.
* Experienced at bringing in and leading freelance talent.
* A versatile creative across branding, web, campaigns, and digital advertising, who still wants to roll up their sleeves.
* Quick to understand the unique aspects of a client's industry, culture and voice, so you can hit the ground running.
* Someone who loves growing people, and builds teams that stick together.
* Hands-on with AI tools, and clear-eyed about them. You already use them in your creative work, and you have a point of view on where they help and where they get in the way.
* A clear, confident presenter with existing and new clients.

**Nice to have**

* Fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite. Other design tools are a plus.
* B2B experience. Helpful, not required.
* You've led a team through a change in tools or workflows before.

**How We'll Get To Know You**

* A conversation with our Talent team.
* A practical case. You'll present how you'd approach a real-world challenge.
* A conversation with senior team members.

**What's In It For You**

* Real influence. You'll shape a function at the core of our business, and how it works.
* Great people. A team that will challenge you, inspire you, and have your back.
* Remote first. Colleagues across the US and Buenos Aires.
* Balance, for real. Unlimited PTO, Summer Fridays, time off between holidays, and more.

**Ready to take the seat?**
If you want to build a creative department, not just fill its pipeline, we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Creative Director
description:
TAIT partners with artists, brands, IP holders and place makers to bring culture-defining, never-before-seen experiences to life. With a legacy of innovation spanning over 45 years, TAIT has grown from pioneering in rock ‘n’ roll concert staging to setting the global standard for extraordinary live events and experiences through cutting-edge technology, precision engineering, and creative design. TAIT’s 20 global offices have developed iconic productions and experiences in over 30 countries, all seven continents, and even outer space for renowned performers, theme parks, exhibits, and venues across the globe, including partnerships with Taylor Swift, Cirque Du Soleil, Royal Opera House, Nike, NASA, Bloomberg, Google, Beyoncé, and The Olympics

**Position Purpose**

The Senior Creative Director position is primarily responsible for leading and contributing to the creative development of a variety of projects for the Company to meet the Client’s expectations and the Company’s quality guidelines. This position includes managing the original creation of new creative material for the Company’s projects, participating and contributing in brainstormings & charrettes, contributing to already developed concepts by others and acting as creative lead on all projects.

This position may include the participation and preparation of other non-project specific assignments, such as speech and editorial writing and preparation, marketing materials copywriting, RFQ/RFP positioning statements, white papers and other writing as deemed necessary by the Company. Participation will be required in presentations, meetings, production meetings, field trips, research and other projects as necessary. The Senior Creative Director will act as a representative of the Company to clients, professional organizations, and the media.

**Responsibilities**

The Senior Creative Director will set and communicate the creative direction for major, multidisciplinary guest experiences—articulating the big picture in an inspiring way and leading from pitch through final installation. They will drive concepts (including major IPs) in complex stakeholder environments; mentor and manage creative teams; align with business and brand strategy; and ensure operational, financial, and experiential feasibility. They will uphold creative quality, strengthen client relationships, and represent TAIT with passion, clarity, and composure across presentations, industry forums, and solo client engagements.

* Visualize and communicate the overarching creative vision in a clear, inspiring, and motivating way.
* Lead creative across all phases—concept, design, tender, production, installation/programming—for attractions, exhibits, interactives, and integrated experiences.
* Drive pitching and proposals: generate ideas with internal teams; lead kick‑offs and creative work sessions; craft persuasive pitch materials.
* Develop, write, and lead IP‑based concepts; ensure brand/IP compliance and alignment across complex stakeholder landscapes.
* Manage and or mentor talent (including Creative Directors); inspire cross‑functional teams and model passion, positivity, and creative rigor.
* Own narrative deliverables: oversee briefs, summaries, treatments, outlines, narratives, and scripts; augment with mood boards, storyboards, and reference media.
* Ensure feasibility and delivery: partner with SMEs to validate operational, financial, and experiential viability; collaborate with PM/PE to manage scope, schedule, budget; identify and mitigate risks; respond constructively to feedback.
* Maintain creative quality control throughout the lifecycle, including TAIT senior leadership reviews; lead client/stakeholder presentations and develop presentation materials.
* Partner across content and production: collaborate with producers and the Head of Content; incorporate feedback while protecting creative intent.
* Manage multiple projects end‑to‑end, keeping an open, adaptive process to accommodate pivots and resource realignment.
* Advance business and brand goals: develop creative programs and design concepts that meet client objectives; apply appropriate brand voice and ensure brand compliance.
* Optimize workflow and resources to meet timelines and deliverables; align staffing with project priorities.
* Work with vendors to realize creative intent and resolve challenges collaboratively.
* Research industry trends, technologies, and client context to inform and elevate creative development.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures; identify and communicate critical issues and milestones promptly.
* Travel domestically and internationally as required.
* Contribute to departmental growth through industry representation, competitions, technology exploration, marketing support, and educational outreach.
* Additional duties as needed

**Position Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, Design, Architecture, Humanities, or related field; Master's degree a plus.
* 12+ years of demonstrable experience in storytelling, creative ideation & leadership in the industry, including significant experience with high-level stakeholders on major projects.
* 12+ years of significant demonstrable major client facing and handling experiences.
* Significant experience exhibiting creative leadership in service to, and managing the portfolios for, major entertainment industry clients (including project development in the areas of LBE and/or placemaking).
* Excellent collaboration skills, and comfortable working as part of several teams simultaneously.
* Strong computer skills: Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Lucid, and Keynote
* Proven communication and presentation skills: written and verbal
* Understanding of the entertainment industry and participating in or leading a creative process
* Proven experience in constantly multitask and handling competing priorities between client business needs, organizational issues, and sound customer relations
* Possess judgment to know when to appropriately escalate issues up the chain of command
* Excellent diplomatic listening and communication skills, able to handle and resolve conflicts effectively in a firm but fair manner
* Able to work both collaboratively and independently while maintaining a high level of productivity in a remote or hybrid setting
* Able to work under tight timetables and high-pressure situations
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment and able to juggle, shift gears, and maintain a sense of humor; deliver under extreme deadlines and intense business environment
* Proactive and solution-oriented when managing issues
* Demonstrated experience and ability to provide strong coaching, mentorship, and advocacy to/for all levels and all members of a creative team
* Proficiency in English, required.
* Proficiency in Arabic, preferred.
* Ability to provide a portfolio for the interview process.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic as outlined by international, national, state, or local laws.

title: Creative Director
description:
**The Company**

Said Differently is an untraditional agency bringing together strategy, creativity, design and technology to build brands, campaigns, products and platforms. We create bespoke teams around each client’s needs, combining a core team with specialists across our global network. Our mission is to build the marketing agency of the future, creating exceptional work through a more flexible, collaborative way of working.

**The role**  
You know how to find the thought that unlocks a brief and bring it to life. Sometimes it starts with a line. Sometimes it’s an image. Sometimes it’s an observation that becomes something neither discipline could have reached alone.

**We’re hiring two hands-on Creative Directors**: one with a deep copywriting background and another who moves comfortably between art and copy. Both will develop brand platforms and integrated campaigns, lead client assignments, and collaborate with freelance specialists across our network while continuing to make work themselves.

**For the copy-focused role,** you can build a brand platform, develop a campaign and write the headline everyone wishes they’d written. You have exceptional writing and editing skills, strong visual judgment, and understand how words and images work together.

**For the art-and-copy role**, you can write a compelling headline, establish a visual direction and bring both together into an idea with a clear point of view. Your particular strengths may lean toward one discipline, but your portfolio should show meaningful contributions to both.

**What you’ll do**

  

* Turn business challenges and strategic insights into distinctive creative platforms and integrated campaigns.
* Lead the creative work on assignments from the first conversation through production and delivery, protecting the idea as it evolves.
* Write headlines, scripts, concept narratives and other copy across film, social, digital, out of home, brand voice and other relevant channels.
* For the art-and-copy role, create visual directions, layouts and storyboards that communicate the idea.
* Partner with freelance writers, art directors, designers and other specialists, providing clear direction and useful feedback.
* Recognize when an idea needs stronger writing, better art direction or a different approach entirely.
* Build persuasive presentations and lead creative conversations with clients, explaining the thinking and building confidence in ambitious ideas.
* Help select and brief the right specialists for each assignment.
* Partner with strategy, account leadership and production to deliver strong work within the scope, budget and timeline.
* Contribute to pitches and identify creative opportunities within existing client relationships.

  

**What you’ll bring**

  

* 10+ years in advertising or brand creativity, with experience leading creative work at ACD or Creative Director level.
* A portfolio of original, strategically grounded ideas brought to life across multiple channels.
* Strong writing and editing skills, with range across brands, audiences and tones. The copy-focused role requires exceptional depth in this craft.
* Strong visual judgment and the ability to direct the complete campaign. The art-and-copy role also requires hands-on visual craft and proficiency with relevant design and presentation tools.
* Production experience relevant to your practice, including film, photography or digital content.
* Confidence working directly with clients and navigating feedback without losing the central idea.
* A generous approach to collaboration and the confidence to make clear creative decisions.
* Curiosity about AI and emerging creative tools, with sound judgment about where they improve the work.
* The independence and communication skills to lead within a distributed team.

  

**Show us**  
A portfolio that demonstrates your craft and creative leadership. Tell us what you made, what you led and how you helped make the work happen.

We are a remote company and welcome candidates based in the US and internationally. Our team generally works Eastern Time hours, and this role requires availability during the standard Eastern Time workday to collaborate with colleagues and meet client needs.

title: Creative Director
description:
The Creative Director is the face of creative on their accounts. They lead concept development and the campaigns that grow out of it. On some of that work, they execute hands-on at a senior level. For the rest, they manage and develop the creative team producing it. They immerse themselves in their clients' businesses, technologies, and markets deeply enough to own the work and the relationship, and they hold the line on quality whether the work is theirs or the team's.

**Who You Are:**
================

* A creative leader who owns the work on your accounts, directing the team's output and holding the standard on everything that reaches a client.
* Still hands-on in the craft, executing at a senior level on the work that calls for it, and setting the bar by what you make as much as what you direct.
* Able to take a complex B2B business and find the idea that makes it land with real people, then sell it in the room.
* A developer of people, giving direct feedback, creating real opportunities, and taking your team's growth personally.
* Commercially sharp, running creative on your accounts profitably and building client relationships that grow.
* Ahead of the problem, whether that's work drifting off strategy, a team stretched too thin, or a client losing confidence.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

Creative Direction & Craft

* Execute at a senior level on a subset of client work, from concept through production-ready files, taking on the projects that most need your hands.
* Lead the development and presentation of campaign concepts and key creative executions on your accounts.
* Deliver creative that meets clients' marketing and communications objectives, not just their aesthetic preferences.
* Write and present persuasive rationales for campaign approaches and defend the work in the room.
* Own brand consistency and unification across everything your accounts produce.
* Set the visual direction on your accounts, making the calls on typography, color, imagery, and how a piece moves the eye, and giving designers and art directors what they need to execute it.
* Make sure art and copy work together from concept through execution.

Team Leadership

* Manage and develop art directors, designers, and writers on your accounts, owning the quality of their work.
* Direct and review creative before it reaches clients, giving the feedback that makes the work and the person better.
* Own your direct reports' development through regular one-on-ones, growth plans, and stretch assignments.
* Lead critiques, ideation sessions, and creative reviews that raise what the team believes is possible.
* Balance assignments and capacity across your accounts and get ahead of workload risk before it reaches clients.
* Run creative on your accounts efficiently and profitably, working with project management on scope, resourcing, and timelines.

Account & Agency Partnership

* Serve as a core team member on your accounts alongside account, strategy, and channel leads.
* Immerse yourself in your clients' business, technology, products, and markets, and keep that knowledge current.
* Partner with strategy so creative is built on insight rather than assumption.
* Bring creative thinking to growth conversations and contribute to new business where your accounts or expertise fit.
* Keep the VP of Creative and account leadership informed on creative health, client relationships, and anything that could turn.

AI Leadership

* Identify workflows and task types across your team that could benefit from new AI tools or approaches.
* Test and pilot new tools, evaluating quality before recommending broader use.
* Support your team in applying approved tools appropriately, including where a tool should and shouldn't be used, and make sure they have the training and guidance.
* Reinforce Godfrey's AI usage policies and guidelines, and the expectation that AI output gets reviewed for quality, accuracy, and originality before it's relied on or shared.
* Surface promising tools, risks, and adoption concerns to the VP of Creative.

**Qualifications:**
===================

* Extensive agency creative experience, including leading campaign concepting and execution across print, digital, and web. B2B experience preferred.
* Experience managing and developing creative talent, including art directors, designers, and writers.
* Proven ability to judge concepts, art, and copy, give direction that makes the work better, and execute at a senior level yourself.
* Strong command of marketing principles and how creative connects to client business objectives.
* Experience presenting and selling creative work to client leadership.
* Digital and content fluency, including how creative performs across channels.
* Experience running creative profitably, including scope, resourcing, and timelines.
* Experience evaluating or rolling out tools and workflows across a team, including AI.
* Portfolio showing range, craft, and ideas that moved client businesses.

At Godfrey, we are guided by 5 core values that all team members are expected to embrace: Fascination, Drive, Partnership, Transparency and Community. By following these principles, we have become the driving force behind many B2B brands’ success stories.

title: Art Director — Editorial Photography & Motion
description:
Maison Sportiefs | Sportiefs Matcha

About Us

Sportiefs Matcha is a premium matcha collection under Maison Sportiefs, a lifestyle and wellness brand bringing together sport, culture, and everyday rituals.

We believe in creating experiences that extend beyond the product itself. Our creative approach emphasizes thoughtful design, refined aesthetics, and compelling visual storytelling.

As we continue developing our visual identity, we’re looking for an Art Director who can bring original concepts to life through photography, motion, and experimental visual production.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly creative, detail-oriented Art Director with expertise in editorial product photography, stop-motion animation, and mixed-media content production.

This is a hands-on creative position for someone who can take an idea from initial concept through production and final delivery.

The ideal candidate combines a strong artistic perspective with technical production skills and an understanding of premium consumer brands.

You’ll help shape the visual direction of Sportiefs Matcha across digital campaigns, product launches, e-commerce, and social media.

We are particularly interested in creatives who enjoy experimenting with composition, lighting, movement, textures, and unconventional storytelling techniques.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Direction & Concept Development

* Develop original creative concepts for product campaigns, seasonal launches, and digital storytelling.
* Translate brand references, mood boards, and creative briefs into distinctive visual concepts.
* Establish cohesive visual direction across photography, video, and motion projects.
* Explore innovative approaches to product presentation, animation, and visual storytelling.

Editorial Photography & Studio Production

* Conceptualize, style, and execute editorial product photography.
* Produce high-quality still-life imagery for website, e-commerce, advertising, and social platforms.
* Direct studio lighting, composition, backgrounds, props, and set styling.
* Capture product details, textures, and packaging with precision.
* Create visually compelling imagery while maintaining accurate product representation.

Motion & Mixed-Media Production

* Develop and produce stop-motion sequences, mixed-media animations, and short-form brand films.
* Combine photography, video, animation, and experimental techniques to create engaging visual content.
* Direct product movement, transitions, and visual effects.
* Edit and refine content for digital campaigns, website features, and social media.
* Experiment with creative production techniques that elevate traditional product advertising.

Post-Production & Creative Execution

* Oversee photo retouching, color correction, video editing, and animation.

title: Associate Creative Director, Design
description:
#### **About Us**

At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice.

More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. From admin work to clinical care, our suite of innovative solutions work together to reduce administrative burden—empowering solo and small group practitioners to thrive alongside their clients.

Award-winning and people-first, SimplePractice is shaping the future of health tech. Recognized by MedTech Breakthrough, the Digital Health Awards, and BuiltIn's Best Places to Work.

#### **The Role**

We're looking for an Associate Creative Director, Design to help lead the next chapter of the SimplePractice brand. Reporting to the Head of Creative & Creative Director, you'll partner across Brand, Growth, Web, Product Marketing, and Copy & Content Strategy to concept and launch integrated campaigns that strengthen our brand, drive business impact, and elevate our creative standards.

As a member of the Creative Leadership Team, you'll work alongside your ACD peers to shape our creative vision, raise the bar for craft, mentor designers, and help define how our team operates and grows. You'll play a key role in evolving our creative organization by championing AI-enabled ways of working, advancing our design systems, and helping build a high-performing, future-ready team.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role for someone with exceptional taste, a systems-thinking mindset, and a passion for making great work. You'll be equally comfortable developing breakthrough campaign concepts, art directing productions, designing alongside the team, and coaching designers to do the best work of their careers.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Lead creative direction and visual design for integrated brand campaigns across product marketing, paid media, lifecycle, social, video, events, and emerging channels.
* Partner with the Creative Director, ACD Copy & Content Strategy, Growth, Product Marketing, and cross-functional teams to develop breakthrough campaign concepts that strengthen the brand and drive measurable business outcomes.
* Create emotionally resonant, strategically grounded work that builds brand awareness, deepens customer connection, and delivers against business objectives.
* Remain a hands-on creative leader by concepting, designing, prototyping, and art directing alongside the team, setting the standard for creative excellence through both execution and leadership.
* Help drive the evolution of the creative organization into AI-enabled workflows, scaling speed and experimentation while maintaining brand and creative quality.
* Raise the creative bar across the organization through exceptional design, art direction, creative feedback, and hands-on leadership.
* Mentor and develop designers through coaching, performance management, career development, and creative direction while fostering a culture of high creative standards, continuous learning, collaboration, and experimentation.
* Partner with Creative Leadership on team planning, hiring, onboarding, resource allocation, and workload prioritization to build a high-performing team.
* Help shape team culture, creative standards, processes, and the long-term evolution of the Creative organization.
* Build scalable campaign design systems, templates, and creative frameworks that enable consistency while encouraging flexibility.
* Maintain and evolve the SimplePractice visual identity across channels, ensuring every execution feels fresh, cohesive, and distinctive.
* Lead art direction for photography, illustration, motion, and video productions, including on-set creative direction with internal teams and external production partners.
* Collaborate closely with Web, Copy & Content Strategy, Growth, and Product Marketing to create seamless, integrated customer experiences across every touchpoint.
* Stay at the forefront of design, advertising, AI, and visual culture, bringing fresh ideas, inspiration, emerging technologies, and best practices back to the team.

#### **Desired Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in brand design, art direction, advertising, or integrated creative, either agency-side, in-house, or both.
* An exceptional portfolio that demonstrates outstanding creative taste across integrated campaigns, visual identity systems, digital design, and art direction.
* Strong conceptual thinker with experience developing integrated campaign ideas and the ability to balance creative leadership with hands-on design execution.
* Ability to connect creative thinking with business outcomes, developing work that builds brand awareness, drives engagement, and supports growth.
* Deep understanding of typography, layout, storytelling, visual systems, and contemporary design.
* Experience building and evolving scalable brand design systems.
* AI-forward in your approach to design, with experience leveraging AI-enabled workflows to accelerate ideation, iteration, and production while maintaining exceptional creative quality and brand consistency. You know where automation adds value and where human judgment and craft are essential.
* Experience leading creative on set for brand photography and video productions, partnering with photographers, directors, talent, and production teams to bring creative concepts to life.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and inspiring designers through thoughtful feedback, coaching, and creative direction while fostering a culture of high creative standards, continuous learning, collaboration, and experimentation.
* Highly proficient in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and modern creative workflows.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing channels and platform-specific design best practices.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build trust, articulate creative rationale, and influence cross-functional partners and stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to deliver high-quality work across multiple projects and priorities.
* Motion design, photography, or video art direction experience strongly preferred.

We offer a competitive benefits program including:

* Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance
