title: Senior Designer & Art Director
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**
-------------------

CodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education. We increase participation in AI+CS education by reaching students of all backgrounds where they are — at their skill level, in their schools, and in ways that inspire them to keep learning, with a focus on increasing participation by young women and students from other underrepresented groups. The leading provider of K-12 AI+CS education curriculum across the globe, CodeAI also organizes the annual Hour of AI campaign, building on the legacy of the Hour of Code, which has engaged more than 15% of all students in the world!

**A unifying approach in a divided world**
------------------------------------------

CodeAI's global role in the K-12 computer science movement is only possible because we use a unifying approach across diverse and often divided stakeholders. At a time of increasing polarization, the idea of increasing opportunity for students unites people from across the political spectrum. CodeAI's team members, students, teachers, and supporters have diverse and diverging view points, and they are all welcome in our mission. **Read more**.

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

As our Sr. Designer & Art Director, you'll bring the CodeAI brand to life through design, visual direction, and creative ideas across every channel we use. Reporting to the Executive Producer of Creative and Delivery, you'll lead the visual side of how our brand shows up everywhere and partner with our copywriter on integrated campaigns of every size.

This role leans toward design. You'll concept alongside your copywriter, direct the look of the work, and design much of it yourself, from video and social to out of home, experiential, and everyday channel assets. We have an established brand and campaigns already in market, and finding fresh ways to express them is at the heart of this job.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-------------------------------

In this role, you will own the visual direction of the CodeAI brand and design much of the work that carries it.

**Visual Direction & Design**

* Set the visual direction for campaigns and channel work, and design key pieces yourself, from key visuals to social, email, web, and paid assets.
* Bring strong typography, layout, composition, and color to every deliverable, and carry the work through to final, production-ready files.
* Design for motion and platform-native formats, including vertical video and social-first content.
* Build accessible work that meets WCAG standards across digital channels.
* Use AI tools in your design workflow and help the team keep pushing how we use them.

**Concepting & Art Direction**

* Concept integrated campaigns with your copywriter partner from first brief to final delivery, and translate each idea into a visual system that works across channels.
* Bring forward new ideas that engage our audiences and solve brand challenges, often before a brief asks for them.
* Art direct photo and video shoots from shot list through post, while production partners handle logistics and vendors.
* Direct contract designers and creatives when they're brought on, with clear feedback that raises the quality of the work.

**Brand Stewardship**

* Own the visual elements of the CodeAI brand guidelines and evolve them over time, with final approval resting with the Executive Producer.
* Be the go-to resource for visual brand questions, helping teams across CodeAI and external partners apply the guidelines well.
* Present your work to leadership and stakeholders with clear strategic reasoning, using audience insights and performance data to sharpen it.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**
-------------------------------

  

We seek candidates who have:

* 8 to 10 years in graphic design and art direction, including time at a senior level.
* A portfolio showing both hands-on design craft and integrated campaign work, with your specific role noted on each project.
* Expert typography, layout, and composition skills, with the ability to flex across visual styles.
* Experience concepting with copywriters, with produced campaign work to show for it.
* Experience art directing photo or video shoots through post.
* Experience building or evolving brand guidelines and helping other teams apply them.
* Experience directing the work of other creatives.
* Experience using AI tools in a creative workflow.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.

We prefer candidates who also have:

* Agency or design studio experience.
* Experience with education, nonprofit, or mission-driven brands.
* Motion design or video editing skills.

In addition, candidates must:

* Be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
* Work within the continental United States
* Pass a pre-employment background check
* Be willing to travel a minimum of two times per year for team events

**OUR CULTURAL PRINCIPLES**
---------------------------

The way we work matters as much as the work itself. Before you apply, we invite you to take a look at our cultural principles. They reflect who we are, how we show up for each other, and what we look for in the people who join us.

**OUR APPROACH TO AI IN HIRING**
--------------------------------

At CodeAI, we use AI thoughtfully and responsibly to support human-centered hiring. AI may help with administrative tasks, but every hiring decision is made by real people on our team. We welcome candidates to use AI appropriately in their job search while upholding our values of honesty and integrity throughout the process.

Read our full AI Use Policy in Hiring here.

**WHAT IS THE INTERVIEW PROCESS LIKE?**
---------------------------------------

Step 1: Informational Interview - learn more about the role and share your experience (30 minutes)  
Step 2: Interviews with several members of the Code.org team (~3 hours)  
Step 3: Final Interview (1 hour)  
Step 4: Reference Checks

*All interviews are currently being conducted virtually via Google Meet*

**TO APPLY**
------------

Our team will review all applications on an ongoing basis and if we believe your qualifications would make a great fit, we'll contact you to schedule an informational interview.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS PACKAGE**
-----------------------------------

The expected salary range for this position is $100,800 - $112,000. Most offers are on the lower end of the salary range and are at the company's sole discretion based on the final candidate's experience. This allows us to provide a fair and equitable approach to compensation when setting pay and maintaining internal pay equity.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees that includes:

* Technology subsidy consistent with our Bring Your Own Device environment
* Flexible, engaging, and remote working environment
* Paid time off: 5 weeks total, comprised of 3 weeks vacation annually, plus a 2-week winter break office closure (including Christmas and New Year's), and sick leave
* Medical, dental and vision premiums paid at 100% for FT positions and their dependents
* Option to participate in 403b retirement plan
* The opportunity to help students learn better and change the face of computer science

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.*

title: Art Director
description:
**Say hello to Hagerty**  
Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do, and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us!  
  
As an **Art Director,** you’ll contribute to Hagerty’s creative output by developing design and concepts that bring the Hagerty brand to life across digital, print, video and event marketing. You’ll collaborate closely with Creative Directors, writers, strategists, and other team members to develop integrated campaigns and presentation decks for business and marketing need. Working as part of a cross-functional creative team, you’ll produce work that is compositionally strong, conceptually driven, and true to our brand’s distinct voice and visual identity. You’re detail-oriented, curious, and eager to grow your craft while contributing to projects that span the full breadth of Hagerty’s creative work.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
***Creative Concept Development***

* Work with Creative Directors and cross-functional teams to build presentation decks for business and marketing needs.
* Develop concepts and campaign ideas for integrated brand and marketing campaigns across channels, including large-scale events and key business initiatives.
* Take campaign platform ideas and develop them into strong, channel-specific creative executions while maintain brand guidelines.
* Produce work that reflects Hagerty’s visual identity and brand voice, including the brand’s signature “twinkle in the eye.”
* Contribute to brainstorming sessions and concept exploration for assigned projects through research and creative development.
* Deliver work on time and communicate with project leaders when timelines are at risk.
* Seek and incorporate feedback from creative leadership with a growth mindset.
* Navigate day-to-day creative challenges by following established processes, seeking guidance from peers and senior team members when unfamiliar situations arise.

***Design Execution***

* Create compositionally strong, thoughtful design work across digital and print mediums using Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma).
* Apply an understanding of graphic design principles including layout, typography, color, and hierarchy to produce effective visual communications.
* Maintain consistency with brand standards and contribute to assigned projects with direction from the Art Director or Creative Director.
* Assist with photo shoot preparation, including contributing to shot lists and asset needs under direction.
* Support pre-flighting and print production processes as needed.

***Collaboration & Brand Stewardship***

* Collaborate with clients, creative leadership, and project teams to understand business objectives and develop appropriate creative solutions.
* Regularly interact with internal clients and stakeholders to ensure work aligns with project goals.
* Stay current on industry trends, popular culture, and emerging advertising techniques; share relevant insights with the team.
* Contribute to a collaborative team environment that encourages creative problem-solving and continuous learning.
* Always keep the member’s point of view in mind when creating, ensuring work resonates with Hagerty’s audience.

**This might describe you**

* A plus if you love cars, the automotive world and are an enthusiast yourself.
* You have experience in an advertising agency or strong in-house creative department, concepting, writing, and producing integrated brand and retail campaigns.
* You can easily build presentation decks in programs like Figma, Keynote, or Power Point.
* Foundational knowledge of art direction and graphic design principles.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma.
* Understanding of brand visual identity guidelines and brand voice.
* Ability to follow creative direction and incorporate feedback effectively.
* Although you’re an art director, you enjoy throwing out headlines and taglines too.
* Self-motivated with strong organizational habits and attention to detail.
* Collaborative team player who communicates well with cross-functional teams.
* You’re curious about culture, advertising trends, emerging technologies, and new ways to tell stories.
* You enjoy solving creative problems and finding unexpected ways to make an idea more compelling.

**Requirements**

* A portfolio demonstrating conceptual thinking, art direction, and integrated advertising campaigns.
* Bachelor’s degree in Communication Design, Graphic Design, or a related field, or 3+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and collaboration tools such as Slack.

**Over and above**

* Experience or coursework in both visual design and copywriting disciplines.
* Exposure to print production, pre-flighting processes, or photo shoot support.

**Other things to note**

* This role can be worked from any U.S. remote location.
* Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. Including attestation to the completeness, accuracy, and compliance of all financial reporting data, where applicable.

description:

**JOIN US ON OUR MISSION TO BECOME THE #1 RETAIL TRADING PLATFORM IN THE WORLD**

Welcome to the dynamic world of NinjaTrader! As an industry-leading trading platform and futures broker, we're empowering traders to take control of their financial destiny. How do we do it? We provide cutting-edge products and services that enhance the trading journey. Whether a seasoned pro or just starting out, NinjaTrader equips traders with award-winning software and brokerage services to navigate the world's leading financial markets with confidence.

Our growth story is nothing short of exhilarating. Since 2003, NinjaTrader has been dedicated to understanding and supporting traders on their journey toward trading triumph. Through those efforts, our user base has grown to over 2 million users and we have become the number one rated futures brokerage worldwide.

But we're not stopping there. We're constantly evolving, pushing boundaries, and modernizing the futures industry. Our commitment to innovation means users will always have access to dynamic tools, real-time support, and a community of like-minded traders.

So, why work at NinjaTrader? Here, you're not just part of a team; you're part of a movement. We empower employees to reach new heights in their careers by providing a dynamic culture focused on social connection, professional development, and employee recognition initiatives. Sounds too good to be true? Take it from our employees.

Join us as we redefine what's possible in trading, advocate for our customers, and continue our journey toward becoming the world's top retail-focused trading platform in the world.

**What you'll do:**

NinjaTrader is hiring a Creative Director to own how the company looks, sounds and feels across every marketing surface a consumer encounters. This is the senior-most creative role in the marketing organization, reporting directly to the CMO.

Our brand strategy and positioning are sharp, but the visual expression lags behind.. This is an opportunity to level up our visual identity to reflect the dynamic and growing nature of the brands we have in market. Then your job is to make it real — operationalize it, extend it into the places it doesn't yet reach, and defend it as volume scales. After that, you own the creative standard for the group.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction, and you will still be in the file. We are not hiring someone to run a review calendar.

Trading is a category of noise: identical charts, identical claims, identical stock photography of men in headsets. The mandate is to make NinjaTrader unmistakable.

**In this role you will:**

The marketing identity system

* Operationalize the incoming brand identity system — typography, color, photography and illustration direction, motion language, iconography, layout systems — and extend it into the surfaces it does not yet cover
* Own the marketing design system: build it to scale across campaign, web, lifecycle and partner surfaces, and to hold up when other hands use it
* Establish the governance that keeps the system intact — standards, documentation, review, and the authority to say no
* Act as the final quality gate on brand expression across marketing

Creative output and storytelling

* Concept and direct integrated campaigns from brief to launch — video, social, paid, OOH, sponsorship, events
* Develop the narrative, not just the look. You will shape the story a piece of video tells, then art-direct the production that delivers it
* Own marketing web and landing page design, including the pages that carry acquisition and conversion volume
* Direct lifecycle and product marketing creative so the experience stays coherent from first impression to funded account
* Stay personally in the work on hero projects — concepting, designing, writing direction, cutting with the editor

Team and partners

* Hire, manage and develop a small in-house design team; set the critique culture and the standard
* Brief, direct and evaluate agencies, production partners and freelancers; own creative quality of outsourced work
* Build the operating rhythm — briefs, reviews, handoffs — that lets a small team ship at volume
* Grow into broader creative ownership over time, including copy and video production

Cross-functional leadership

* Partner with Product Design on shared brand guidelines so marketing and platform surfaces stay recognizably the same brand. Product Design owns the product design system; you own the marketing one. The two are deliberately scoped differently and should stay that way
* Work with performance marketing to build creative that is testable, iterable and measured against funnel outcomes
* Operate fluently inside a regulated marketing environment, partnering with compliance early rather than treating review as a downstream tax

**What you'll need:**

* 8+ years of brand and creative experience, with 2+ years leading a team as an ACD, CD or design lead
* A portfolio built on systems, not one-offs
* Storytelling range — able to develop narrative, not only art-direct someone else's script
* Range across brand campaign work and performance creative
* A desire to remain hands-on — actively driven to stay in the work, not just direct it
* Fluency with AI tooling in the creative process
* A track record of managing designers and directing external agencies
* Comfort with performance data

**Bonus Points for:**

* Fintech, brokerage, trading, crypto or exchange experience, or genuine curiosity about markets and retail traders
* Experience operationalizing an inherited identity system rather than only building from scratch
* Experience running a marketing design system alongside a separately owned product design system
* Experience in a constrained or regulated environment — finance, healthcare, insurance, pharma or gaming
* Practicing a craft outside the day job — photography, film, writing or illustration
* Agency background plus in-house leadership experience

**Compensation:**

The salary range for this role will be $166,000.00 - $216,000.00 USD. In addition, this position will also receive an annual target bonus of 15%. Bonus pay at NinjaTrader is based on individual performance (50%) as well as company/team performance (50%).

Salary and bonus earnings are only two components of the total compensation package offered by NinjaTrader. NinjaTrader offers a 401K plan through ADP under which the company will match up to 3.5% of employee contributions. Annual paid time off allowance accrues at a rate of 23 days per year plus seven paid holidays.

**Location:**

This role is based in Chicago, IL. \*There may be remote flexibility for exceptional candidates in the following states: California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Washington DC, Wisconsin.

**Hybrid:**

For Chicago-based employees, we follow a hybrid work schedule: In-office Tuesday through Thursday, with remote work on Mondays and Fridays. In addition to these weekly remote days, we offer:

* 20 additional flex remote days annually
* 5 Company Wide Office-Optional weeks tied to major holidays

**Our Core Benefits Include:**

* Generous PTO
* 7 Paid Holidays Annually + 5 Conditional Holidays Annually
* 1 Service Day Annually
* 401k with 3.5% Company Match
* Paid Parental Bonding Leave
* Health, Vision, Dental Coverage
* Life and Disability Insurance Covered 100% by NinjaTrader

title: Brand Strategist
description:
### **About FieldWrk & Our Mission**

FieldWrk is a mission-first B2B branding agency built for the essential people and companies who build and maintain our world. **Our mission is to help hardworking people and companies reach their full potential**, starting with our team.

We are a strategic agency that offers branding, web design and development, field photo and video production, and digital marketing services. We partner with leaders in civil construction, heavy equipment, waste and environmental services, energy, and critical infrastructure to build brands that work as hard as the people behind them.

### **About This Role & Its Impact:**

**Your mission as Brand Strategist, should you choose to accept it: build brands that create real, measurable business impact for our infrastructure clients.** *NOTE: this role requires travel and facilitating workshops with executive leaders.*

This role exists to craft brand foundations and long-term strategies for both our clients and FieldWrk creative teams to carry forward. The brand identities and strategies you create will establish the direction for all deliverables that follow, from websites, social media, and paid ads to production of brand videos, marketing collateral, and campaigns for recruitment and business development. You’ll serve as a guardian of the brand for the duration of client relationships, ensuring our work remains relevant and continues to drive real, measurable business impact as companies scale and grow.

We're looking for a Brand Strategist who knows how to get to the heart of a business, uncover what makes it different, and turn that understanding into a clear, compelling brand strategy that drives measurable impact.

### **Key Responsibilities & How You'll Spend Your Time**

**25% — Research and discovery**

* Audit existing client brand identity materials, guidelines, and placements across websites, social media, qualification packages and more.
* Create and distribute client surveys for internal and external audiences, and pull key insights to guide workshop discussions and recommendations.
* Conduct employee interviews, both individual and roundtable.
* Research and evaluate the market landscape, brand competition and each client's unique positioning challenges.
* Establish a baseline of brand health to measure the impact of our work against.

**25% — Workshop facilitation**

* Lead 2–3 day on-site workshops at client headquarters with executive leaders.
* Build custom presentations to share research findings.
* Facilitate discussion of purpose, mission, vision, value propositions and values.
* Challenge assumptions and gain executive buy-in on key messaging.
* Visit jobsites and meet with client employees.

**25% — Brand strategy and verbal identity**

* Develop the brand foundation: positioning, purpose, vision, value proposition, differentiation, brand pillars, audience messaging, tagline and verbal identity.
* Present, defend and revise strategy with clients.
* Connect strategy to business goals, recruiting, customer experience and marketing.
* Translate strategy into direction for web, production and social teams.

**25% — Client leadership and ongoing account strategy**

* Lead the strategic relationship with client executives, while PMs own schedule and scope.
* Run periodic brand and account audits that measure results against each client's baseline.
* Lead annual strategic account planning with clients and recommend the next scopes of work based on their business goals.
* Deliver clear handoff briefs to web and production teams.
* Review creative work for alignment with the strategy and brand standards.
* Identify gaps in our process and recommend improvements.

### **Your First 90 Days:**

* By 30 days: You've audited our recent brand work and learned the FieldWrk delivery method. You've completed research on the industries we serve and attended one client workshop for training.
* By 60 days: You're writing verbal identities under the Director of Strategy's supervision. You've co-led 1–2 workshops and presented strategy to clients, with moderate internal revision.
* By 90 days: You're leading workshops independently and owning strategy for multiple clients. You're leading handoffs to web and production teams, and your work needs only minor revision.
* By six months: You're working independently across FieldWrk teams and have contributed to strategy for at least one client campaign beyond the brand foundation.

  
**Requirements**

This role requires:

* 3-5+ years of brand strategy experience at an agency or consultancy, including leading B2B positioning and messaging work.
* A portfolio of brand strategy and verbal identity work you developed, with the rationale behind your decisions.
* Senior-level brand copywriting ability.
* Experience facilitating multi-day workshops with executive teams.
* Experience presenting to and building trust with executive stakeholders.
* Experience writing briefs for and collaborating with designers, writers, developers and video teams.
* Ability to manage 6–8 concurrent engagements.
* Proficiency in monday.com, Figma and Google Slides.
* Experience using AI tools for research, competitive audits, and synthesis. NOTE: FieldWrk does not use or accept AI-written copy for any deliverable work. Human-written messaging is a requirement of the Brand Strategist position.
* Willingness to travel 3–9 days per month.
* Largely available to work within CST hours (9 AM-5 PM CT)
* Strong desire to make a positive impact through design for hardworking / construction industries

### **How You Work / Culture Fit:**

* You are a great listener and question-asker
* You can build rapport quickly and easily, whether it's a creative designer or a senior executive
* You think critically, have a healthy skepticism of superficial answers, and have a deep curiosity to understand. You consider the audience, objective, content, and constraints — not just aesthetics — and use critical thinking to arrive at the right solution.
* You’re a quick learner and comfortable with context switching. You can enter an unfamiliar project, client, or industry, absorb information quickly, and become productive without needing everything spelled out for you. Moving between different clients, projects, and types of work doesn’t derail you.
* You have a “get it done, do it well” mentality. You care deeply about craft while understanding that great agency work also requires speed, resourcefulness, sound judgment, and follow-through.
* You take ownership. When you encounter a problem, your instinct is to investigate, ask the right questions, propose a solution, and move the work forward rather than wait for someone else to tell you what to do.
* You have high standards without being precious. You notice the details and want the work to be excellent, while remaining receptive to feedback, adapting quickly, and knowing when the work is ready to move forward.
* You’re dependable and collaborative. Your team can trust you to communicate proactively, manage your commitments, raise concerns early, and contribute positively to a fast-moving remote team.
* You understand that working at an early-stage company sometimes means wearing multiple hats and adapting as the needs of the business evolve.

**Our Approach to AI**

At FieldWrk, AI is a research assistant — not the strategist or writer. We use it to conduct research, explore directions, generate references, refine presentations, and speed up shallow-work tasks so we can focus on concept, craft, and execution.

Strategists are expected to use AI intentionally and critically. Submitting unedited AI-generated writing, relying on AI for concept development, or skipping the thinking behind the work is not acceptable.

***AI Submission Note\**** *AI is a great tool that can help structure thoughts, and we know it can provide complete responses to job postings. For this application, your final submission must be written in your own words and voice.*

 **Benefits**

Our mission to help hardworking people reach their full potential starts with our team. We bring together branding and marketing experts who care deeply about the industries we serve, and invest in developing their talents through collaboration, mentorship, benefits, and a team culture unlike any other.

* Health insurance (United) — FieldWrk covers 85% for full-time employees, 50% for families + optional HSA match
* Vision / dental insurance — FieldWrk covers 100%
* Two weeks paid holiday rest at the end of the year
* Flexible PTO policy — We encourage everyone to take 2-3 weeks off per year, outside of our standard company holidays
* Life, disability, accident, critical illness, and cancer insurance plans
* 401k / retirement plans — Available after three months of employment
* Paid parental leave
* Dirty boots — see really cool massive earthwork, demolition, mining, and construction projects
* Work for a company that cares for, trusts, and empowers their people
* Eligible for performance bonus/profit sharing after 6 months of employment— we believe when FieldWrk wins, so should our team
* Remote work and flexible hours within a 40-hour work week

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each key responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

*We are devoted to building an inclusive and supportive culture at FieldWrk. We're proud to offer equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability, or veteran status.*

title: Head of Creative (Remote US)
description:
**Directive Consulting** is the leading B2B marketing agency for companies that are done optimizing for metrics that don't move the business. With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands behind us, we know what real results look like. We operate through 3 divisions: **Performance, Communications, and Commerce,** each built to share intelligence and align on revenue. Our methodology, **DiscoverabilityOS**, aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point. Across Technology, Industrial, and Services verticals, that system spans everything from Paid Media and **Content** Marketing to PR and Paid Social to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing.

At Directive, we're always looking to connect with talented people who care about work that actually counts. As we grow across all 3 divisions, we're seeking forward-thinking people who thrive in fast-paced environments, are obsessed with analytics and storytelling, and are ready to make their mark doing B2B marketing that actually means something.

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a Head of Creative to lead our Performance Design department — a team that sits at the intersection of creative craft and performance marketing. In this role, you will often wear two different “hats”. You'll be equally responsible for the strategic & financial direction of the department and the day-to-day development of the people and work within it. You'll inherit a team with strong momentum, an established methodology, and a clear positioning — and your job is to scale it.

This role reports to senior leadership and manages the full Performance Design team, including designers, project management, and motion contractors.

**Creative Leadership & Output**

* Own the creative vision and quality standard for the Performance Design department
* Ensure all work meets both craft and conversion benchmarks — great looking and built to perform
* Review and elevate creative across paid social, display, video, and landing page formats
* Build systems and workflows that help support excellent creative output for our clients both internally and externally.
* Ensure we’re running campaigns vs. ads
* Ensure we are testing & learning
* Partner with Directive senior leadership to develop our unique and ownable creative process that supports DiscoverabilityOS

**People Management & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of designers and motion contractors
* Set clear expectations, foster accountability, and build a culture where creative people do their best work
* Identify growth opportunities for team members and actively invest in their development

**Strategy & Client Partnership**

* Partner closely with paid media and client success teams to ensure the creative is data-informed from the start
* Represent the department in new business pitches, cross-sell opportunities, and client conversations. While you will not be client-facing from a day-to-day perspective with our clients, you will be expected to meet with them monthly during leadership meetings to discuss quality & results.

**AI & Technology Integration**

* Lead adoption of AI creative tools across the team
* Identify where emerging technologies can sharpen output and improve efficiency
* Build AI into real production workflows — not just as a proof of concept

**WHAT YOU OFFER**

**Experience & Background**

* 5+ years in creative roles within performance marketing, paid media, or growth-focused agency environments
* Proven track record in managing creative teams and balancing creative quality with business outcomes
* Comfortable presenting department strategy and financial projections to VPs and CMOs, just as much as reviewing a creative brief

**Business Acumen**

* Strong understanding of how a creative department operates as a business
* Direct experience managing or having visibility into P&L, margin, and resourcing decisions

**AI & Tools**

* Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — generative image, AI-powered video, design analytics, or similar
* Knows how to integrate AI into real production workflows, not just demo it
* Experience with platforms like EyeQuant, Creatify, or Superside is a plus

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communicator with executive presence who can translate creative thinking into business language
* Track record of building trust with both creative practitioners and senior leadership

**What Success Looks Like:**

In the first 90 days, you've built strong relationships across the team and key internal stakeholders, identified gaps in methodology and workflow, and begun making your mark on the department's output.

Within six months, you're running the department with full confidence — driving creative quality, owning margin targets, making smart resourcing decisions, and positioning Performance Design as a competitive differentiator in new business conversations.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in the US is $160,000-$185,000 USD. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.

title: Creative Director - Growth / Experiential
description:
About Us:

**Who We Are**  
  
At Left Field Labs, we turn complex concepts, emerging technologies, and often ambiguous challenges into irresistible experiences people can see, touch, and understand. Experiential moments where abstract ideas become clear, irressistible, and tangible.

Our positioning is simple:

**We Make It Real.**

We’re looking for a Creative Director who can do exactly that shape bold ideas, tell the story that sells them, and lead — not dictate — teams to bring them to life.

Overview:

**THE WORK**

This role sits inside our GROWTH & NEXT Pods, working across some of the most ambitious and creatively open territory in the industry:

  

* Experiential environments — brand worlds, immersive spaces, permanent and touring installations
* Themed entertainment — narrative environments, attraction concepts, destination experiences
* Brand activations — moments that earn attention, build belief, and convert audiences into advocates
* Interactive and technology-enabled work — experiences where the audience participates, not just observes

You’ll lead creative across the full arc: from early pitch and concept development through to final execution. That means being as sharp in a competitive pitch room as you are on a build site walkthrough.

Responsibilities:

**HANDS-ON CRAFT**

This isn’t a role for someone who only directs from a distance.

We want someone who can get into the work — who can open a file, shape a frame, and contribute meaningfully to what’s on screen or in the room. Specifically, we’re looking for hands-on fluency in:

* **Graphic and/or digital design** — Visual systems, spatial graphics, concept visualization, motion
* **3D** — Environmental modeling, spatial concept development, real-time rendering

Both is exceptional. One is the floor. Either way, your hands-on capability should show up in how you direct, how you review, and how quickly you help a team find the right answer.

**THE QUESTION WE CARE ABOUT**

AI is everywhere.

Clients use it. Teams use it. Partners use it. So do we.

The real question isn’t whether you use AI — it’s how you use it to gain an advantage.

We want to understand:

  

* How AI expands your creative exploration
* How it helps you uncover insights others miss
* How it strengthens ideas instead of flattening them
* How it accelerates thinking without outsourcing judgment

In short: **How does AI make you a better Creative Director, not just a faster one? (or a lazier one.)**

  
Required Skills:

**TABLE STAKES**

There are fundamentals every Creative Director here must bring.

* + **Great Work** — A portfolio of ideas that live beyond the slide deck. Work that exists in environments, systems, installations, or interactions. Show us things that were actually built.
  + **Pitch Leadership** — You know how to shape and sell ideas in competitive environments. You understand what converts opportunity into business — and you can carry a room.
  + **Storytelling** — You craft narratives that capture attention, build belief, and move clients to act. From concept decks to client presentations, your work reads and performs.
  + **Team Leadership** — You elevate the people around you. Clear direction, strong taste, and the generosity to help others do their best work. Not a gatekeeper. A multiplier.
  + **Taste & Clarity of Vision** — You understand the difference between novelty and meaning, spectacle and substance. You push for both.

Qualifications:

**BACKGROUND & EXPERIENCE**

Experience across two or more of the following areas will set you apart:

* Experiential marketing and brand activations at scale
* Themed entertainment, attraction design, or narrative environment development
* Permanent or touring installations
* Technology-forward or interactive experience design
* Cultural moments; festivals, tentpoles, world’s fairs, fan experiences

We’re less interested in a single lane and more interested in someone who has genuine range and the creative ambition to push further in each direction.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $150,000-$200,000. This range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in Culver City, California. This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

title: Regional Patient Care Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

**Why join us?**

Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long-term success.

**Job Description**

**How will you make an impact?**  
**Job Purpose**

As Patient Care Regional Manager, you will be the people manager and operational lead for Patient Care teams in your assigned European markets. You will own team performance, quality reviews, and day-to-day operations — while working closely with Country Managers and the Global Patient Care Head to align on priorities and ensure service consistency across markets.

You will be the missing link between global standards and local execution: someone who can read data, give direct feedback, run a tight operational cadence, and genuinely develop the people on your team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Management**

* Own performance reviews, 1:1s, and development conversations for direct reports across your markets
* Manage absence, availability, and team sizing for your region
* Lead hiring decisions and internal mobility within the Patient Care team
* Build a culture of direct feedback and consistent follow-through

**Operational Performance**

* Track and own regional KPIs: response SLA, first-contact resolution, CSAT, and quality scores
* Run quality review and moderation programs — calibration sessions, rubric definition, feedback loops
* Identify performance trends using dashboards and reports; translate them into concrete actions
* Own escalation protocols for complex patient cases

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Country Managers to align on priorities, workload, and service commitments
* Work with the Product/PATS team on tooling rollouts, workflow automation, and process improvements
* Contribute to the monthly Patient Voice reporting — classified ticket analysis, actionable issue surfacing
* Act as regional interface for global policy rollouts and operational changes

**Qualifications**

**What will help you thrive?**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in customer support, patient experience, or service operations — with at least 2 years managing people
* Experience managing teams across multiple countries in Europe (not just one market)

title: SDR Team Lead - Benelux & Nordics
description:
**About Us**  
  
Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.  
  
We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.  
  
Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.  
  
At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.  
  
Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

**The Role**
------------

We’re looking for a motivated aspiring manager to take their first step into leadership as an SDR Team Lead, supporting our Benelux & Nordics markets within our Barcelona-based Sales team.. You’ll coach and support a team of 8 outbound SDRs, helping them develop their skills, generate pipeline, and hit their targets. You’ll partner closely with the SDR Manager and Head of Sales Development to shape strategies, improve processes, and ensure the team’s success directly contributes to Perk’s growth.

**What will you be doing?**
---------------------------

* Lead and support a team of up to 8 Outbound SDRs, running weekly 1:1s, setting development goals, and reviewing performance.
* Coach & mentor, focus on continuous skill development, identify training needs, and support new hires during onboarding.
* Enable growth, design and deliver engaging training (role-plays, pitch simulations, gamification) and share best practices across the team.
* Be the expert, master Perk’s products and confidently guide your team in delivering value to prospects.
* Collaborate, partner with SDR Managers and internal stakeholders to create playbooks, scripts, and materials that drive results.
* Drive operational excellence by improving processes, ensuring data accuracy, and fostering efficiency across the SDR function.
* Drive new prospecting techniques to further outbound pipeline generation and support innovation in lead generation.
* Foster cross-functional communication with Sales, aligning on goals, feedback, and strategies to maximise impact.

**What will you need to succeed?**
----------------------------------

* High business fluency in English as well as a working knowledge of the business culture in the Benelux & Nordics regions.
* You have experience in outbound sales/sales development and have successfully managed the full sales cycle from prospecting and lead generation through to opportunity creation and closing.
* You are passionate about coaching and developing junior talent. You experiment, adapt, and grow, and you inspire your team to do the same through hands-on guidance and training. For this role we don’t require direct leadership experience, but previous coaching and mentoring of junior team members is a must have.
* You’re a clear communicator. You can break down complex ideas into simple, actionable steps and write concise messages that get straight to the point.
* You’re a great listener. You take the time to understand your team, picking up on the nuance that helps drive better conversations and coaching.
* You’re organised and focused. You know where to prioritise your energy to maximise results, for yourself and your team, and you don’t shy away from putting in the extra effort.
* You’re detail-oriented. You take pride in operational excellence, from accurate CRM updates to preparing your team for success.
* You embrace tools and technology. You leverage systems to drive productivity and are always curious about smarter, more efficient ways of working.

**What it’s like to work at Perk:**
-----------------------------------

* We build a product that makes a real difference, because selling something great is the best way to win customers.
* We put people first in every interaction, leading with empathy and expertise.
* Small, talented teams can achieve big things. That’s why we hire the best, give them the right environment, and reward them fairly.

**What we offer:**
------------------

* Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays.
* Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk.
* Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance.
* Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen.
* Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party.
* Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.
* Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan.
* Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year.
* Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes.
* Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year.
* Nurture your language skills with real-life English, Spanish and Catalan lessons.
* Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years
* Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support.

**Interview process:**
----------------------

Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

Interview with the hiring manager - 30mins Virtual

Assessment interview with the hiring manager - 60mins - Virtual

Senior Leadership interview - 30mins In-Person

Values fit interview - 30mins Virtual

**AI at Perk**  
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

**How We Work**

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

**Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Lead Product Designer (m/f/d)
description:
### **About Hilo by Aktiia**

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

### **Role overview**

UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

### **Core responsibilities**

### **Direction & Outcomes**

* Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.
* Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.

### **Design System & Prototyping**

* Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.
* Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.

### **Leadership & Collaboration**

* Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.
* Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.
* Work daily with product managers and design engineers.

 **Requirements**

### **Background & Experience**

### **Essential**

* Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.
* 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.
* Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
* High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.
* Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.
* Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
* Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.
* Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
* A public portfolio website (required with your application).

### **Nice to Have**

* Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

### **How you work**

* AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.
* Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.
* Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.
* Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
* Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.
* Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

### **This isn't for you if**

* You need all requirements, research and data before you start.
* You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
* You'd rather list risks than own one.

### **How we hire**

* Recruiter screen (30 min)
* Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min): visual craft, prototyping, AI fluency
* Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
* Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
* Final conversation with senior leadership (finalists)

### **What success looks like**

* You take something off our plate and it gets done.
* If it won't happen, you tell us first.
* You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
* You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.
* The product feels consistent, fast and high quality, and design outcomes show up in the numbers.

  
**Benefits**

### **What Makes You A Great Fit**

**At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:**

**Move the Needle** — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

**Move Fast, Learn, Refine** — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

**Team First** — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

### **Why Join Us?**

* Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
* Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
* Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
* Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
* Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

### **Ready to Move the Needle?**

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Installation Engineer
description:
The mission of the installation engineering team is to develop installation process and tools to achieve the industry’s safest, most efficient, and most economical installation of onshore wind turbines.
  
The Lead Installation Engineer will be responsible for the technical development of installation capabilities and tools from start to finish: Starting with defining the problem and empathy gathering, through design development, and finally to an on-site field validation, resulting in a completed tool package that can be handed off to regional installation teams. The installation engineering team develops tooling for all turbine subsystems, and therefore covers many different technologies: Scope may include major component lifting equipment which can apply to machine heads, hubs, and other major components, and/or drivetrain-related capabilities such as geared turning drives, alignment equipment, and lifting/rigging.

**Job Description**
===================

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Manage tooling development projects through the NPI process from concept through industrialization by executing design, prototyping, development, validation, and final documentation of Installation tooling, processes. Tools may include lift beams, site fixtures, and other specialized tooling, and the associated processes required for installation of wind turbine.
* Lead a cross-functional core team to define requirements, develop concepts, and create technical specifications to guide the mechanical design of tooling and processes.
* Engage with and manage suppliers to finalize design and manufacture the proposed technology.
* Utilize the design process to generate concepts that optimize the end user experience.
* Utilize systems thinking to understand the operations required to complete an installation. During the tool design, incorporate end user feedback and detail the operational steps required to use the tooling. Assess for safety and ergonomic considerations.
* Conduct design reviews, FMEAs, review structural assessments, and other critical technical deliverables with chief and principal engineers to ensure all tools and/or methods created by the installation engineering team meet or exceed the safety standards of both GE and Industry
* Create design packages and hand off to regional installation and Global Tech Operations team to enable them to be self-proficient with the newly created tools, processes and/or methods
* Support on-site validations for each project, and assist with training of the on-site installation leaders and technicians for newly created tools, processes and/or methods

Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.

*Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our* *contentsquare.com* *or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.*

We are looking for a senior creative leader to **define the next chapter of Contentsquare’s brand and lead the evolution of our global Studio.**

You will set the creative vision for how Contentsquare shows up in the world. Your mission is to elevate our brand, making it more distinctive, modern, and recognizable, and ensuring our creative expression positions us as a leader in our industry.

You will drive the **creative evolution of our brand across every touchpoint**, from campaigns and product launches to web, events, motion, and executive storytelling. You'll push creative boundaries, champion bold ideas, and set an exceptional standard for quality and differentiation.

A key part of the role is translating complex technology, data, and AI innovation into simple, compelling creative experiences. You'll partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Brand, and GTM teams to understand what makes our platform unique and bring that story to life.

You'll also **lead and transform our global Studio**, developing a high-performing team of designers, creative leads, and agency partners. You'll evolve our brand system and embrace AI, automation, and self-service to scale production, freeing the team to focus on creativity, craft, and high-impact work.

**Your mission: build a category-defining brand and a world-class, AI-enabled creative organization to bring it to life.**

### **What you’ll own**

### **Brand creative direction**

* Set the creative vision for Contentsquare and hold an exceptional standard across launches, campaigns, brand, web, events, and executive storytelling.
* Champion bold ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and push the team beyond safe, predictable creative work.
* Stay ahead of what the best brands are doing, in SaaS, AI, technology, and beyond, to create work that is unmistakably ours.

### **The team**

* Lead, develop, and retain exceptional designers and team leads, building a high-performing culture of craft, bold thinking, ownership, and accountability. Empower the team to take creative risks and make strong decisions independently.
* Build and manage a network of world-class agencies and specialist partners, bringing fresh perspectives and expertise. Own agency selection, creative direction, budgets, and performance, ensuring exceptional quality and the flexibility to scale during peak demand.

### **The platform and product story**

* Build a deep understanding of our platform, AI capabilities, and technology, keeping the Studio closely connected to our product and customers.
* Partner early with Product and Product Marketing to turn complex technology into simple, compelling, and memorable creative experiences.
* Bring our product story to life through distinctive design, motion, video, and storytelling across every relevant touchpoint.

### **The Brand System**

* Evolve our visual identity into a distinctive, recognizable, and scalable brand system that reflects our ambition as an AI leader.
* Build reusable frameworks, templates, and self-service tools that help teams create effectively without compromising quality.
* Know when to scale through the system and when an idea deserves something entirely new.

### **AI in the studio**

* Lead how the Studio uses AI across design, copy, production, and creative operations.
* Use AI to absorb repetitive work and production volume, expanding creative capabilities and giving the team more time for ideas, craft, and innovation.
* Help the team adopt new tools and workflows confidently, without compromising creative quality or brand standards.

### **How the creative studio runs**

* Own the Studio operating model, including priorities, resourcing, project management, creative reviews, and delivery across internal teams and external partners.
* Build a fast, effective, and scalable operation that anticipates demand, manages production peaks, and removes unnecessary complexity.
* Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Brand, Content, Web, Comms, and GTM teams, engaging early enough to shape the work rather than simply receive briefs.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years across design, brand, creative, or Studio leadership, including 5+ years leading teams in SaaS or technology.
* Experience managing managers/team leads and operating in complex, global organizations.
* Exceptional portfolio with a high creative bar across brand, digital, campaigns, and product storytelling.
* Strong ability to turn complex technology and AI into simple, compelling creative narratives.
* Deep understanding of SaaS/tech; AI or AI-native experience is a strong plus.
* Proven experience evolving brand/design systems and scaling quality through templates and self-service.
* Hands-on experience transforming creative teams with AI across workflows, automation, production, and enablement.
* Strong command of Creative Operations, resourcing, agencies, and end-to-end Studio workflows.
* Strong benchmarking instincts and a clear point of view on differentiation and creative excellence.
* Excellent executive communication and cross-functional partnership skills.

### **You’ll Thrive in This Role If You**

* Have **exceptional creative taste and a strong point of view** on what our brand could become.
* Understand the product deeply enough to find the creative idea within it, rather than waiting for a brief to define it.
* Turn complex technology, data, and AI into simple, human, and memorable creative experiences.
* Know what the best brands are doing, both in our category and far beyond it, and are more interested in **what nobody has done yet**.
* Move confidently between setting creative vision, challenging the details, shaping product storytelling, and leading a high-performing team.
* See **AI as a way to take more creative risks, not fewer**. Let it handle the volume so your team can focus on the work only people can do.
* Build simple systems that keep creative teams fast, collaborative, and effective, while knowing which work deserves something entirely original.
* Challenge work that's merely good enough, inspiring teams and agency partners to push for exceptional.
* Balance bold creative ambition with a strong understanding of customer impact and business outcomes.

### **What Success Looks Like**

Within your first year, we would expect to see:

* A visibly higher and more consistent creative bar across the company.
* A distinctive creative language for our platform, products, and AI capabilities that makes complex technology easier to understand and more exciting to experience.
* A Studio that is deeply connected to Product and Product Marketing and engaged earlier in the storytelling process.
* Strong differentiation from competitors across our visual identity, campaigns, product launches, and customer-facing experiences.
* A strong, scalable brand and design system.
* A clear Studio operating model with stronger prioritization, ownership, and delivery.
* Meaningful adoption of AI across creative workflows, resulting in faster execution, better output, and expanded team capacity.
* More teams able to self-serve effectively through high-quality templates, systems, and guidelines.
* Strong leadership across the Studio, with team leads operating with greater autonomy and accountability.
* Better balance between internal resources, agencies, automation, and self-service.
* A Studio viewed by the business not as a production function, but as a strategic partner in how we bring our product and technology to the world.

**Why you should join Contentsquare**

We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.

Here are a few we want to highlight:

* Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year

* Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies

* Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)

* Lifestyle allowance

* A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work

* Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success

* We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts

* And more benefits tailored to each country

*Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

*Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our* *Job Candidate Privacy Notice* *to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal* *here**.*

*Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Ride & Experience Marketing Specialist
location: Sant Boi de Llobregat, CT, Spain
description:
#### **About Stark**

Stark builds the world’s most powerful electric motorcycles. From the VARG MX to the road-legal VARG EX & SM, our bikes have won world championships and are engineered to outperform anything with a combustion engine.

We’re based in Sant Boi, Barcelona, growing fast (77% year-on-year), and building a team that will take us even further. If you want to work on a product that people are genuinely obsessed with, this is it.

Stark will become the global market leader in premium motorcycles. Building premium motorcycles requires innovation and we need your help to make us succeed

Our mission is to lead the way towards a sustainable motorcycle industry, by reducing plastic and CO2 pollution.

This will be achieved by building sustainable products that are superior to traditional technology in terms of Performance, Emotion and Design.

#### **The Role**

As Ride & Experience Marketing Specialist in our Sports & Field Marketing team, you will own the programs that put Stark bikes in people’s hands: the Demo Warrior Program, our Experience Centers and Stark Race Rewards. These programs are built on strong human relationships and are ready to scale globally, and you will grow with them, with the potential to lead a team across territories in the future.

* Join a small, passionate team working directly with riders, partners and brand collaborators
* Own three global programs with real room to scale
* Work closely with the Sports & Field Marketing Director
* Fully on-site in Sant Boi de Llobregat, close to the product

* Run and develop Stark’s Experience Centers and the Stark Race Rewards program
* Support local demo activations in different markets
* Track, analyse and report on demo and Experience Center performance (using our Demo Warrior portal) to find where conversion falls short and what to change
* Manage program budgets and coordinate with agencies and internal stakeholders
* Free up the wider team to focus on events and brand collaborations by taking ownership of these programs

#### **What you will bring to Stark**

* Solid understanding of the motorcycle industry
* Strong people skills and excellent communication
* Strategic thinking and an entrepreneurial mindset
* Experience managing budgets
* Professional English; additional languages are a plus
* Availability to work fully on-site in Sant Boi, with occasional travel

#### **Why work with us?**

* The chance to work on a product people are genuinely passionate about
* A fast-growing company with real momentum
* A creative, international team based in Barcelona
* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Direct access to riders, race teams, and the product — this is not a remote-from-the-product role
* Subsidized lunch in our in house restaurant

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Are you an experienced marketing project manager who wants to join multicultural team? We are looking for a **Marketing Project Lead** who can grow alongside the project and reach new heights. You’ll be part of a creative and friendly team in a people-oriented environment that values autonomy, results-driven thinking, and achieving business goals.  
  
**Brandbutter** is part of **CENTRO** is a fully remote creative marketing agency partnering with ambitious brands to build awareness, relevance, and growth in fast-moving markets. We work across strategy, content, campaigns, and events, operating as an embedded partner rather than a task-based service provider.

**About the role**  
You’ll lead one of our two marketing cells, covering several brands across B2B fintech, adtech and creator programs. You’ll own the marketing vision and roadmap for these brands and lead a team of designers and social media managers to deliver it.

This is a player-coach role, not a pure management one. You’ll set direction and lead the team, but you’ll also spend a large share of your time doing the work yourself: writing the strategy, building campaigns, drafting copy, setting up ads and building AI workflows. You’ll report to the Director of Marketing.  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* **Set the vision.** Define the marketing strategy for each brand in your cell, grounded in business goals, customer insight and data.
* **Build and run the roadmap.** Turn quarterly OKRs into clear plans with priorities, owners and timelines, and make sure they ship.
* **Execute hands-on.** Write briefs, copy and campaign plans. Launch and optimise paid campaigns. Build landing pages and reports. Produce first versions yourself instead of waiting on others.
* **Lead and grow the team.** Coach designers and social media managers, delegate with clarity, give direct feedback and help people grow.
* **Make AI the default.** Identify where AI and automation can speed up research, content production, reporting and campaign operations, build those workflows yourself and teach the team to use them.
* **Own the numbers.** Track pipeline, lead quality, CPL, ROAS and engagement, and change course when something isn’t working.
* **Work across the business.** Partner with sales, product, tech and leadership, and present plans and results clearly and concisely.

  
**What you bring:**

* 7+ years in marketing, including at least 3 years leading a team. You can name people who grew under you.
* A doer’s track record: you’ve personally written, built, launched and optimised campaigns, not only managed people who did.
* Experience building marketing strategies and roadmaps from scratch, ideally across more than one brand or audience.

**What we offer**

* **Competitive salary** that reflects your skills and experience.
* **Remote flexibility:** work from anywhere, with a team that values balance and results.
* **Autonomy and ownership:** no bureaucracy or micromanagement, just room to take initiative and own your work.
* **Growth and development:** educational programs and support for your professional development.
* **Team events:** team-building activities and opportunities to attend industry events.
* **Time off:** paid holidays, vacation, personal days and sick leave.
