title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform & Ecosystem
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Our vision:** A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

### **About the Role:**

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike's Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike's AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

**Role Scope:**

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike's agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

**MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:**

* Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.
* Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.
* Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.
* Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

**Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:**

* Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.
* Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.
* Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.
* Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

**What You Will Help Shape:**

* A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.
* GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.
* A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

### **Your Impact:**

* Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers' existing ecosystems.
* Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.
* Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.
* Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

### **Your Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.
* Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.
* Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.
* Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.
* Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

**Why This Role Is Unique:**

* You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.
* You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.
* The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

### **What's Next?**

* Introduction Call with a Recruiter

* Conversation with the AI Product Director

* Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives

* Final interview with CPO and HRBP

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.  
  
#LI-AV1

### **Who Is Wrike and Our Culture**

We're a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

**Hybrid work mode**

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

#### **Our persona**

**Smart:** We love what we do, and we're great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

**Dedicated:** We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We're committed to helping our teammates win, too!

**Approachable:** We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

#### **Our culture and Values**

**Customer-Focused**

**We care about our customers.** We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

**Collaborative**

**We work as one and win together,** each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

**Creative**

**We strive to succeed through continuous innovation.** It's our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

**Committed**

**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,** by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

title: Performance Media Buyer
description:
### **About ExoClick**

ExoClick is an innovative and global ad company serving 20 billion daily geo-targeted ads to web and mobile advertisers & publishers. We are part of EXOGROUP, a set of companies made up of +200 talents and offering a wide range of services within the digital business landscape with headquarters in Barcelona and offices in Dublin, Porto and Valencia.

We are revolutionizing the online ad-serving industry for advertisers, publishers, and networks alike and are seeking to recruit a Performance Media Buyer for our Barcelona office.

### **Role**

As Performance Media Buyer, you will work with global performance-based online advertisers across a wide variety of verticals within the adult entertainment industry. You will actively create, monitor and optimize campaigns for a portfolio of clients (both assigned and newly qualified leads) with a particular focus on effective inventory monetization, delivering a first-class service and sharing best practices within the various internal departments. Your daily tasks will also involve data analysis, preparing strategic client reports, proposals and contracts.

Together with a cross functional team, you will participate in development on new products and new marketing angles. As a top-notch media buyer you should educate and coach new media buyers in developing advertising strategies and campaigns. You will report to the Sales Director.

### **Responsibilities**

* Media buy on CPM, CPC, and CPV pricing models to back into CPA goals.
* Setup, manage and optimize campaigns using ExoClick Ad platform.
* Use of internal tools, systems and processes to keep a daily track of client development and expansion.
* Prospect and identify new potential direct response advertisers.
* Daily spend/revenue monitoring.
* Effective client relationship management, dealing with internal/external conflicts and collate best practice examples of reporting, client feedback and case studies.
* Proven technical capabilities and understanding, including basic skills in the editing of landing pages (HTML), use of tracking pixels and creative optimization.
* Close interaction with Business Intelligence, Business Development teams in order to interpret market insights, client data, and be able to react quickly and implement this back into the business.
* Effective management of your clients on performance versus target and company growth strategies.
* Support and coach existing and new employees. Help Performance team members by providing additional steps and resources that help employees move ahead with confidence.
* Collaborate with multiple departments in creation of documentation, educational material, case studies.
* Develop and incorporate new marketing angles in the user flows. Guide the marketing team on how to implement them in the marketing material.
* Participate in establishment and improvement of relevant processes of the department.
* Take responsibility and accountability over new products and projects within the department.

### **Profile**

* You have a solid working knowledge of the digital performance and affiliate marketing ecosystems, and understand the general needs of online advertisers and publishers
* Very detail-oriented with a meticulous approach and be able to manage multiple campaigns successfully
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Money conscious with an innovative approach and ability to thrive in a fast-paced working environment
* Proactive, a strong communicator and confident with pitching new opportunities to external clients
* Analytical mind, good with calculations and statistical interpretation
* Problem-solving attitude
* Interest in following advertising and media trends

### **Requirements**

* +2 years minimum experience in the online advertising industry as a media buyer.
* Previous Developing effective media buying strategies.
* Experience with RevShare models.
* Experience managing 6 digit campaigns directly for product owners or affiliate networks.
* We will value any experience as a media buyer or traffic manager. Previous experience with ExoClick Platform is a highly appreciated.
* Strong analytical proficiency, especially with Excel or Google spreadsheets.
* Good technical knowledge (HTML).
* Perfect knowledge of the different performance-based pricing models (CPA, CPL, CPM, CPC, etc.).
* Fluent English, written and spoken (Russian, German, French, Spanish or other languages will be highly valued).
* Strong proficiency with web applications (browsers, software).
* Experience with tracking and attribution tools.

### **What you’ll find working at ExoClick**

We offer a position in a young, dynamic and international team with exceptional working conditions in unique offices high up in the Torre Mapfre, one of Barcelona’s world-renowned landmarks, located right on the city’s seafront.

Additionally, we offer the opportunity for permanent training, personal development, ambitious career growth, and a competitive salary.

Most of all, we offer a position in a team that thrives on achievement, success, and leadership within our industry. Our core company value is innovation: where people and creativity drive innovative technology. If you have an innovative, winning mentality, this position is for you!

title: Senior Product Manager Air Reshopping - Barcelona or London
description:
**Job no:** 533107
  
**Brand:** Product and Technology
  
**Work type:** Full time, Hybrid, Remote
  
**Location:** London, Barcelona, Flexible, Homeworking
  
**Categories:** Digital and Technology, Project and Program Management

**About The Opportunity**

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager to own and drive Air Reshopping, a product that continuously monitors booked air itineraries and secures better fares on behalf of some of the world's largest corporate travel programs. This is a high-impact opportunity where your work directly influences customer savings, commercial outcomes, and how far we can push automation and AI enablement across a global travel program. Working at the intersection of Product, Technology, and our partner ecosystem, you'll take a capability with proven value and define how it scales. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact. You will report to the Global Head of Revenue Management and Pricing, and work as part of the Reshopping program led by the Program Leader, Reshopping.

  

**Location**

This role can be based in one of our major offices in in Barcelona or London. Fully remote in EU region may be considered for the right person.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and document the product strategy — the purpose, ambition and direction of the domain — and communicate it clearly across the business.
* Maintain an informed view of the post-booking cost optimization market, so that product decisions are innovative and genuinely differentiated.
* Facilitate ongoing research to understand consultant needs, customer expectations, competitive landscape, and emerging travel technology trends; share findings with stakeholders to inform strategy.
* Translate strategy into clear product roadmaps and prioritized requirements that enable the Tech team to design and size solutions and deliver. Prioritise effectively using an MVP-first mindset, balancing business impact, technical feasibility, product commitments, stakeholder feedback.
* Build trusted relationships with and gather input from stakeholders across customers and prospects, global business units, travel consultants, and executive leadership; synthesize diverse perspectives and keep all parties aligned and informed.
* Own and evolve the commercial model, so that the value created for customers is also value realized for the business.
* Shape global GTM and rollout sequencing, working closely with the delivery leader, working market by market so that each launch reflects local operational, industry, and customer requirements.
* Maintain a working view of the end-to-end process, human and automated, and identify opportunities to automate and AI enable.
* Evaluate where AI Enablement can improve outcomes while maintaining appropriate levels of auditability and deterministic logic.
* Establish and monitor quality and success metrics, including savings identified and realized, rebooking conversion, and savings methodology integrity. Define and track product KPIs to measure adoption, engagement, and delivered value; use insights to drive iteration cycles.
* Contribute to a safe, inclusive, accessible, and fun work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive.
  

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience owning a product and roadmap end-to-end, with measurable business outcomes.
* Proven at building commercial models for new offerings and evolving them as products mature.
* A track record of raising automation within a product, with the judgment to know which manual steps to remove and which are worth keeping because they add value for the customer.
* Skilled at agreeing data and process handoffs across teams.
* Able to communicate complex topics to stakeholders with varying levels of technical knowledge.
* Grounded in corporate travel or travel technology, including supplier commercial models, post-booking servicing, and managed travel program economics.
* Working knowledge of air content, fares, and ticketing data structures across GDS, NDC and other direct sources.
* Familiar with travel consultant workflows, operational needs, and common technology challenges.
* Experience using AI or automation to enhance workflows or product operations is a strong plus.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Experiences
description:
**Job Description:**

**About the Team** **:** **Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies.** **About the Role**

Dow Jones is hiring a Senior Product Manager to help shape how AI shows up across our product portfolio. This role will help build the AI experiences across both consumer products (WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch) and our professional information products (Factiva, WSJ Pro, Oxford Analytica, Dragonfly). You will partner closely with the internal teams that build our **AI agent and orchestration platform, our search platform, and our personalization platform** to ensure the experiences you ship consume reusable services rather than one-off implementations. Most importantly, you will represent the end user (whether a subscriber on their morning commute or an analyst building a client briefing) in the AI roadmap to ensure our work represents something that adds value to their lives.

The role sits on the GenAI Experiences team and reports to the Director of Product Management.

**You Will**

* Own the AI experience roadmap for one or more surfaces across the portfolio, with success measured against retention, engagement, and demonstrable user value, not shipped feature count.
* Translate the specific jobs of our users (consumer subscribers, financial analysts, risk and legal professionals, researchers) into AI experiences that do the work, save the time, or reveal insight they could not surface on their own, and ship them on reusable shared capabilities rather than hand-built per product.
* Partner with the internal platform teams to bring your users' requirements into the shared capability roadmap, and run the experimentation and measurement discipline that lets us tell retention-grade stories about AI impact.

**You Have**

* 7+ years of product management experience, preferably with at least 2 years shipping AI-powered products in production (using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, agent-based or retrieval-based systems).
* Experience owning a consumer, B2B, or enterprise product that serves a well-defined user, ideally one where retention or engagement is the north-star metric.
* Working fluency in modern AI product patterns: retrieval and context engineering, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop design, plus comfort reasoning about tradeoffs across model, prompt, data, and orchestration layers.

**Nice to have:**

* A track record of shipping on top of shared platforms (internal APIs, SDKs, developer tooling, or third-party AI assistant integrations), with evidence of partnering with platform teams rather than building parallel one-offs.
* Hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP): has designed or shipped an MCP-based integration for a third-party AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Slack, or similar), including the content-rights and entitlement considerations that distribution through those channels brings.
* Experimentation and measurement discipline: can design an A/B test, define a retention-oriented metric, and gate a release on both business and AI-quality signals.

**Our Benefits**

* Comprehensive Healthcare Plans for you and your family (paid by Dow Jones)
* Extra paid Time Off (30 days of holidays/year)
* Possibility to work remotely for 3 months/year (desplazamiento program) or one week of remote work per quarter
* Meal benefit with Pluxee (171€/month on top of your salary)

* Family Care Benefits & Caregiving Support
* Subscription Discounts
* Employee Referral Program (2,500 USD for referring a talent)

Learn more about us and our benefits click here.

description:
About Graitec Group:

Graitec is a global leader in Building Information Modeling (BIM) solutions, designing and developing software that helps architects, engineers, and manufacturers design smarter and better. With over 30 years of innovation and an entrepreneurial spirit, we’ve tripled our revenue in just five years.

Our North Star is clear — accelerate the digital transformation of the AECO industry and model the future. We  
achieve this by growing our recurring revenue through innovative software and services that drive adoption,  
integration, and lasting value for our customers.

Our 800 experts across 30+ offices in 12 countries support more than 270,000 users worldwide. As a global Autodesk Platinum Partner, we combine world-class partnerships with our own cutting-edge software and services to drive performance and sustainability across the industry.

At Graitec, we move fast and think big. We collaborate across teams and borders, embrace diversity, and challenge ourselves to innovate every day. We believe in doing the right thing, breaking down silos, and making an impact together.

**How we work:** Growth, Agility, Innovation, Responsibility  
**How we behave:** Ambition, Engagement, One Graitec, Positive Energy

Learn more about the Graitec Group: graitec-group.com/graitec-a-global-player

About the Team Hiring:

IT & Business Transformation is a global function reporting to the Graitec CEO, made up of four teams: Business Transformation, Data & AI, Information Security, and IT Operations & Platforms. Together we own the delivery capability behind how Graitec operates and we drive Graitec’s continued transformation.

We work as fusion teams and as one with the wider organisation: technology and business colleagues working towards the same goals and outcomes.

Data & AI is the team that turns Graitec's data into decisions. It brings together data platform engineering, BI and machine learning development, data science, AI engineering, and business-aligned analysts embedded with the functions they serve. The team is growing, and you will help shape how it works.

Overview:

Business Purpose & Value Contribution

The Data Platform Engineer builds and runs the platform that all of Graitec's reporting, analytics and AI depend on: the Microsoft Fabric data lake, the pipelines that feed it, and the controls that keep it reliable, secure and affordable.

The priority is a governed single source of truth: data from Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, CRM, services

licensing and product telemetry, integrated once, modelled consistently and served to every function, with sensitive data protected by design.

You will work with the Data and AI Leader, BI developers, IT Operations & Platforms, Information Security and R&D. It is a hands-on senior engineering role, setting the patterns others build on.

Key Outcomes Expected

What success looks like in the first 12 months

* A published data platform architecture and engineering standards, with a layered data model in use
* Core sources ingested reliably and monitored, with failures detected before users notice
* Platform capacity right-sized and its cost transparent, with workloads separated so reporting and engineering do not collide
* Access, classification and privacy controls in place, including for HR and financial data
* Pipelines and models in source control, with automated deployment across environments
* A clear interface with R&D for product telemetry and shared data platforms

Responsibilities

Platform Engineering

* Design, build and run the Microsoft Fabric platform: lakehouses, warehouses, pipelines and dataflows
* Ingest and integrate data from Dynamics 365, CRM, Kantata, licensing and telemetry, using standard connectors and APIs where they fit
* Build a layered, medallion-style data model that turns raw data into certified, reusable datasets
* Resolve customer and product identities across CRM, ERP, licensing and telemetry, so every report counts the same customer once

Reliability & Cost

* Monitor pipelines and automate data quality tests for completeness, freshness, uniqueness and referential integrity, with alerting and clear ownership of failures
* Manage platform capacity and cost, separating workloads and scaling only when justified
* Run source control, environments and deployment pipelines for data and BI content

Security & Governance

* Implement access, classification, row- and column-level security, masking and privacy controls with Information Security
* Protect sensitive data such as compensation, using anonymisation and restricted workspaces
* Maintain lineage and documentation, supporting the data governance the business agrees

Collaboration

* Set engineering standards and coach BI developers and analysts in using them
* Work with the Enterprise Architect and R&D on integration patterns, master data and telemetry
* Prepare data for AI, exposing governed, well-described data to agents and models through controlled interfaces

Responsibilities:

* 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, including at least two years working with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, or Databricks.
* Strong experience with SQL and Python or PySpark, and data modelling for analytics.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines, Notebooks, and OneLake.
* Experience integrating ERP and CRM data, ideally from Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and Dataverse.
* Experience with master data management and entity resolution, including matching customers and products across multiple systems.
* Practical experience implementing security and governance, including Entra ID, row-level security, and Microsoft Purview.
* Experience managing capacity and costs on a shared analytics platform.
* Uses AI tools such as Copilot in day-to-day work for code generation, testing, and documentation.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to document effectively and explain technical trade-offs to non-engineering stakeholders.
* Experience with product telemetry or event-driven data.
* Experience preparing data for AI solutions, including retrieval, vector search, and governed access for agents (for example through MCP).
* Experience with other modern data platforms and tools such as dbt, Snowflake, or Databricks, and with infrastructure as code.

Qualifications:

* Strong proficiency in **SQL** and **Python/PySpark** development.
* Expertise in **analytics-focused data modelling** and data architecture.
* Deep knowledge of **Microsoft Fabric** technologies, including:
  + Lakehouse
  + Warehouse
  + Data Pipelines
  + Notebooks
  + OneLake
* Experience with **source control and CI/CD practices for data platforms**, including Git and Azure DevOps.
* Knowledge of enterprise **security, governance, and compliance frameworks**, including:
  + Entra ID
  + Row-Level Security (RLS)
  + Microsoft Purview
* Understanding of data platform operations, including performance, scalability, and cost optimization.
* Practical application of AI-assisted development tools such as **Copilot**.
* **Preferred Certifications**
  + Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer (**DP-700**)
  + Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (**DP-600**)
* Familiarity with modern AI data architectures, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Vector Search
  + MCP-enabled data access and governance

description:
### **Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: **AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.**

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: **we operationalise intelligence.**

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: **understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.**

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a **Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.**

**Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.**

### **Role Details**

**Job location:** Barcelona, Spain (Onsite model)  
**Contract type:** Employee / Contractor B2B  
**Target start date:** Early January 2027  
**Working hours:** Full-time
  
**Compensation:** €45,000–€60,000 gross per year  
**Languages:** Spanish and English

**Note:** All applications and CVs must be submitted in English.

#### **What You'll Architect**

As an **AI-Native Business Analyst / Forward Deployed Engineer**, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining **business analysis, data, AI-enabled ways of working, and human decision-making**.

Working closely with **business stakeholders and digital delivery teams**, you will help identify the real problem behind a request, challenge assumptions constructively and **translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements.** You will also bring a practical **AI-first approach** to your work, exploring how **AI and Generative AI can accelerate analysis, improve processes and help teams** validate solutions more effectively.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the **intersection of business, data and technology**, and who is curious about better ways to turn ideas into outcomes.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

* Engage directly with business stakeholders to understand **processes, challenges, and desired business outcomes**.
* Translate business needs into **clear requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria** for digital delivery teams.
* Challenge requirements constructively to ensure teams solve the **right business problem**, rather than simply implementing requested features.
* Act as the bridge between **business stakeholders and technical delivery teams**, ensuring alignment throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Apply an **AI-first mindset** to identify opportunities where **AI and GenAI can accelerate analysis, improve requirements quality, support prototyping, or optimise business processes**.
* Leverage AI tools as part of your daily work to increase speed, quality, and effectiveness in analysis and documentation.
* Help teams rapidly explore and validate alternative approaches rather than defaulting to traditional solutions.
* Understand and consider **data dependencies, data quality considerations, and governance implications** when shaping requirements.
* Collaborate effectively with distributed teams across **France, Spain, India, and the Philippines**.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders through an active on-site presence in Bangalore.

#### **Who You Are**

* You are naturally curious and constantly looking for better ways to solve business problems.
* You do not see AI as a separate capability. Instead, you instinctively think **AI-first**, using AI tools to improve analysis, accelerate delivery, and challenge traditional ways of working.
* You enjoy understanding business processes, questioning assumptions, and uncovering the underlying problems that need to be solved.
* You are comfortable working between **business** and **technical teams,** helping both sides reach clarity and alignment.
* You are a**nalytical and structured**, but also p**ragmatic and focused** on outcomes.
* You are **confident challenging stakeholders constructively** when requirements, assumptions, or proposed solutions can be improved.
* You **thrive in collaborative and international environments** and enjoy working with people from different backgrounds and functions.
* You are **self-directed, take ownership of your work, and are comfortable operating autonomously** within a global organisation.
* You communicate clearly and effectively with both business users and technical teams.

#### **️** **What You Bring**

##### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Relevant academic background or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong Business Analyst experience with **strong data / CRM / Salesforce exposure**.
* Experience gathering, analysing, documenting, and refining business requirements.
* Experience producing high-quality **user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria**.
* Ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams including business stakeholders, developers, product teams, and data specialists.
* Experience operating within international or distributed organisations.
* Professional proficiency in **English**.
* Able to work **on-site in Bangalore.**

##### **Technical & Professional Skills**

* Excellent **requirements engineering and business analysis capabilities**.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business challenges into clear and actionable delivery requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working closely with technical delivery teams and understanding technology constraints and opportunities.
* Practical experience using **AI and GenAI tools** to improve productivity, analysis, documentation, requirements engineering, or delivery effectiveness.

* Ability to demonstrate how AI meaningfully changes and improves your approach to business analysis rather than simply using AI occasionally.

##### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with **data-intensive applications**, analytics platforms, or data transformation programmes.
* Understanding of **data governance, data lifecycle management, and data quality frameworks**.
* Experience in a **Technical Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Forward Deployed Engineer, or similar hybrid role**.
* Exposure to **industrial, manufacturing, energy, or services environments**.
* Experience working in **Agile product delivery environments**.
* Familiarity with using AI to support **requirements engineering, business analysis, solution exploration, documentation, or rapid prototyping**.

#### **What Makes You Successful**

* You focus on **understanding the business problem** before defining the solution.
* You use **AI naturally as part of your workflow**, enabling faster analysis, better requirements, and more informed decision-making.
* You challenge assumptions respectfully and help stakeholders explore alternatives that may create greater value.
* You balance business needs, technical realities, and delivery constraints to arrive at practical solutions.
* You can move **comfortably** between **strategic conversations** anddetailed **requirements definition**.
* You **build trust with stakeholders** through clear communication, curiosity, and consistent delivery.
* You understand that requirements are rarely perfect on day one and are comfortable working through ambiguity to create clarity.
* You proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, accelerate delivery, and **enhance outcomes through AI-enabled approaches.**
* You contribute to collective intelligence by **sharing knowledge,** **encouraging better ways of working**, and **helping teams become more effective.**
* You combine the mindset of a **Business Analyst, Product Analyst, and AI practitioner**, using technology not as an end goal, but as a way to solve meaningful business challenges.

#### **What We Offer at Keyrus Spain**

* **Competitive salary**, paid in **14 instalments** (option for **12 from day one**).
* **Annual performance bonus**.
* **Meal allowance** (Restaurant Tickets): **€1,800/year net,** distributed over 11 monthly reloads
* **Flexible retribution plan**: transport & daycare tickets
* **Private medical insurance with Sanitas** (no copays, dental included)
* **22 days of annual leave**, increasing every 3 years (up to 26 days)
* **14 public holidays** (Madrid calendar)
* December **24th** and **31s**t are considered **company holidays when they fall on working days**
* Continuous learning via **KLX – Keyrus Learning Experience**
* A collaborative, international, and human-centred work environment

#### **How Our Salary Ranges Work**

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect **different levels of mastery and impact within the same role** — not different job titles.

* **Bottom of the range**  
  You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support.
* **Middle of the range**  
  You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently.
* **Top of the range**  
  You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team.

Final offers are based on **experience, autonomy, scope, and market context**, and are discussed transparently during the process.

#### **Responsible AI & Recruitment**

**At Keyrus, all stages of our recruitment process are conducted and evaluated by human recruiters and interviewers.**  
To support accuracy and efficiency, AI may occasionally be used internally by our team exclusively for **note-taking purposes during interviews**. AI is **never** used to make decisions.

To ensure **fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information**, the use of AI tools by candidates during the recruitment process is **strictly prohibited**.

Our commitment to **responsible AI practices** ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate’s own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise.

title: BIM Modeller - AI Product Platform
description:
**About the role:**

**About Janus Digital** Janus Digital ™ is the agentic AI platform that runs the world's real assets. We earn only on the additional value we create. Built on 15+ years of R&D, 76 granted patents and US$100M+ invested, the platform is live across 10,000+ building datasets in 253 cities with Fortune Global 500 owners, sovereign funds and hospitality groups.

**Strategic Context** Every building we make intelligent starts with accurate information about how it is built. High-detail BIM models, and MEP models in particular, are the foundation for digital twins, predictive maintenance and autonomous building operations. Janus Digital is now building its own AI BIM platform to create, check and enrich these models far faster than traditional workflows allow.

This role sits at the centre of that effort. You will deliver production-grade MEP and commercial BIM models using AI tooling to speed up every step, while giving the Chief Platform/Product Officer a practitioner's view of the AI-for-AEC market and the requirements our own platform must meet.

**Position Overview** We seek an experienced BIM Modeller specialising in MEP and commercial buildings, reporting directly to the Chief Platform/Product Officer. This hands-on role combines high-detail model delivery with structured market research into AI tooling and platforms, directly guiding the build of the Janus AI BIM platform.

Your time will split roughly 60% production BIM and 40% platform intelligence. You will model to LOD 350-400 under ISO 19650, measure the time AI and automation save against manual baselines, evaluate emerging AI tools on real project data, and translate real modelling workflows into product requirements, datasets and acceptance criteria.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Produce federated MEP models (HVAC, plumbing and drainage, fire protection, electrical, ELV and low-current systems) for offices, retail, hospitality, mixed-use and data-centre projects
* Model to LOD 350-400, including fabrication-ready ductwork, pipework, containment, hangers and supports where required
* Build and maintain parametric Revit families, shared parameters and project templates aligned to Janus Digital standards
* Run clash detection in Navisworks and BIM Collaborate Pro across architectural, structural and MEP models
* Apply AI and automation across the modelling workflow: auto-routing, family generation, drawing and sheet automation, model checking and scan-to-BIM
* Write and maintain Dynamo and pyRevit/Python scripts, using AI coding assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to build them faster
* Map the AI-for-AEC landscape and run structured, hands-on evaluations of shortlisted tools on real Janus Digital project data
* Work closely with the Chief Platform/Product Officer to shape platform priorities from a practitioner's perspective
* Apply ISO 19650 information management: BEPs, MIDPs/TIDPs, naming conventions and CDE workflows
* Work with the Product team on developing an AI automation BIM tool.
* Highly skilled in testing and trailing new AI tool kits to build.

  
**Requirements**

**Experience**

* 6+ years of BIM modelling, with at least 4 years focused on MEP in commercial projects
* Portfolio of coordinated LOD 350+ MEP models on at least 3 delivered commercial projects
* Proven delivery on ISO 19650 projects, including multi-disciplinary clash coordination
* Demonstrable use of scripting or AI tools to speed up modelling, with before-and-after evidence

**Technical Expertise**

* Expert in Autodesk Revit (MEP); proficient in AutoCAD
* Navisworks Manage, clash detection and BCF issue tracking
* Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360 and BIM Collaborate Pro
* ISO 19650, BEP/MIDP/TIDP, Uniclass or OmniClass classification and IFC export
* Dynamo scripting and working knowledge of Python
* Daily use of LLM assistants for scripting, documentation and research

**Core Competencies**

* Precision: models are right first time, with clashes and data errors caught before issue
* Builder mindset: automates any task done more than twice and shares the tool with the team
* Critical evaluation: tests AI vendor claims on real data and reports results without hype
* Product thinking: turns modelling pain points into clear problem statements the product team can build against

**Preferred Qualifications**

* pyRevit, Revit API (C#), Grasshopper / Rhino.Inside or Autodesk Platform Services (APS) APIs
* Hands-on experience with AI-for-AEC tools in generative design, auto-routing, drawing automation, AI model checking or scan-to-BIM
* Point cloud import and modelling to scan
* Fabrication parts (Revit Fabrication / MEP Fabrication) and data-centre or healthcare services experience
* Solibri, Revizto or BIMcollab; COBie, IDS and bSDD; Dubai Municipality BIM e-submission experience
* Prior work at a software, PropTech or construction-tech company, or on an internal digital tools team

  
**Benefits**

This role can be based in our UAE office or fully remote, within a 4hr/+- window of Gulf Standard time

title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) | Hydrogen
description:
*Lead the technological core of Kerionics: the development and industrialization of the SOEC technology you'll bring to market in 2028.*

### **About us**

At Kerionics, we accelerate industrial decarbonization through technologies that make cleaner, more efficient energy possible. We are a spin-off from ITQ (UPV-CSIC), born from scientific knowledge with a clear goal: turning research into real industrial solutions.

Our SOEC (solid oxide electrolysis) technology produces hydrogen with high energy efficiency where it is needed most: energy-intensive industries such as steel, petrochemicals, cement, ceramics and paper, where replacing fossil fuels remains a major challenge. We are a multicultural team of more than 40 people, united by a shared purpose.

### **What we are looking for**

We need a CTO to lead the development and industrialization of our SOEC technology, with our 2028 go-to-market in sight. Over the coming years we will scale the technology by orders of magnitude. You would join at a critical point: not at the beginning, where everything is exploration, nor at the end, where everything is execution, but where scientific rigor and industrial discipline must coexist every day.

We want someone who combines the scientific rigor to solve the open challenges in MEA (Membrane Electrode Assembly), Stack and Balance of Plant (BoP) with the discipline of New Product Introduction (NPI) to take the technology from the lab to an industrial product.

You will lead three managers, one each for MEA, Stack and BoP: people with judgment, autonomy and deep knowledge of their fields. Your challenge is not to build a team from scratch, but to take it to the next level: aligning everyone around the roadmap, professionalizing how we develop product and building a technical culture together.

This is not a role for silent execution. You will be **the CEO's technical right hand**: following the defined strategy and, when needed, challenging it with arguments if you believe something has been decided wrongly. You report to the CEO, but we expect you to co-build, not just execute. That technical honesty is part of the job.

### **Why this role matters**

* **Technical leadership of a European deeptech scale-up**, with technical, commercial and environmental impact at the same time.
* **A project with real backing**: financial support from deeptech-specialized funds such as InnoEnergy, top-tier industrial and scientific partners, participation in strategic European projects, and new conversations with private investors for the next phase.
* **A real voice in strategy**: you sit on the management committee, take part in strategic and investment decisions, and your technical opinion carries weight.
* **The full transition to market**: from prototype to product, from lab to industrial plant, from first customer to deployment.

### **What you will do**

* **Product development:** lead the cross-functional development of our SOEC technology across MEA, Stack and BoP; make sure it follows an NPI logic with clear stage gates, technical pass/fail criteria and traceability of decisions; lead the transition from R&D to industrialization.
* **Team and culture:** lead the MEA, Stack and BoP managers directly, unblock what they need, build a technical culture grounded in data, honesty and accountability, and take an active role in technical hiring.
* **Critical technical problems:** provide top-level judgment on open challenges and lead decisions that cut across areas, even with incomplete data.
* **Strategy:** be the technical reference in the management committee, give the CEO honest judgment, and represent Kerionics before partners, investors and customers.
* **Industrialization and quality:** coordinate with the Industrial Project Manager on the future plant, and with the Quality & Testing Manager to align validation criteria with the product.

### **What we expect in your first 12 months**

1. **Own the technical roadmap:** understand the current state of the product and the commitments made to partners and investors. By the end of your first quarter, present your own critical assessment of the roadmap to the CEO and the board.  
2. **Build the trust of the MEA, Stack and BoP managers and their teams**, and the cross-functional rituals and processes that do not yet exist.  
3. **Strengthen the development process:** consolidate the existing stage-gate system, refining pass/fail criteria, decision traceability and documentation.  
4. **Bring AI into how the team works**, where it adds real value, leading by example. No top-down rollout.  
5. **Deliver the next major validation milestones** of the roadmap.  
6. **Build Kerionics' technical voice externally** and position it as a SOEC reference in Europe.

### **How we work**

We work **on-site** at Parque Tecnológico de Paterna (Valencia), close to the product: lab, workshop, prototypes and test benches. We usually start early (around 7:30), which leaves your afternoons free for sports, family or whatever you prefer.

### **What we ask for**

**Must-haves**

* Advanced degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Materials, Energy), Materials Science or Chemistry. A PhD will be highly valued.
* At least **5 years** in electrochemical or hydrogen technologies (electrolysis, fuel cells or equivalent). Direct SOEC experience is not required: we value deep knowledge of stacks, MEAs or systems that you can bring to ours.
* At least **3 years** leading product development from R&D toward industrialization.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Solid knowledge of at least one pillar: MEA and electrochemical materials, stack design and validation, or BoP in complex energy systems. We do not expect equal depth in all three, but you must hold demanding technical conversations across them.
* Fluent English, spoken and written, for technical discussions and for representing the company.
* Availability to relocate to Valencia within 2-3 months. If you need more time for family reasons, let's talk.
* Valid work permit for Spain, or eligibility to obtain one. For the right candidate, we support the paperwork.

**We are looking for someone who...**

* Has the judgment to say no to a good project that doesn't fit the strategy, and yes to a hard one when the evidence supports it.
* Decides under uncertainty without falling into paralysis or improvisation.
* Challenges the CEO with arguments when needed, while staying loyal to the agreed strategy.
* Leads through context and example, not micromanagement, and stays hands-on when needed.
* Stays current with AI and uses it critically.
* Can join an already formed team and earn its trust through knowledge and respect, not hierarchy.

**Not required, but you'll surprise us if you also...**

* Have direct experience with SOEC or SOFC, or high-temperature ceramic materials.
* Have been a CTO, VP of R&D or Head of Technology in a deeptech scale-up.
* Have lived a complete industrial scale-up (TRL 5-6 to TRL 8-9) in electrochemical, energy or advanced materials technologies.
* Know our target sectors (steel, cement, petrochemicals, ceramics, glass, paper).
* Speak Spanish.
* Have your own network in the European hydrogen, SOEC/SOFC or industrial decarbonization ecosystem.

**A note before you decide...**

This list describes an ideal profile, not a checklist. People from groups underrepresented in deeptech and engineering tend to be harder on themselves when reading job descriptions. Don't decide for us: send us your CV, and let us decide whether there's a fit.

### **What we offer**

* **€70-90K gross per year**, depending on experience and fit.
* **Variable bonus of up to €20K**, linked to the technical milestones of our roadmap. Details shared during the process.
* **Stock option plan.** Full terms shared during the process.
* **Permanent contract**, with a standard 6-month probationary period.
* Relocation support package for candidates moving to Valencia.
* 22 working days of holiday.
* Language lessons (Spanish or English) if you want to strengthen your language skills.
* Annual training budget tailored to your needs.
* A multicultural team: colleagues from India, the UK, France, Pakistan, Mexico, Uruguay, Colombia, Ecuador...
* Every Friday, 11:00 to 12:00, a good Valencian esmorzaret to disconnect and celebrate the week's small wins.

### **How our selection process works**

1. A video call with our Head of People & Culture.  
2. A video call with our CEO, to explore your technical vision and how it fits with Kerionics' strategy.  
3. A video call with an external expert.  
4. A video call with a member of our Board, focused on long-term vision and an independent view of strategic fit.  
5. A full-day visit to our facilities in Paterna (Valencia), where you will see the product and meet the MEA, Stack and BoP managers, your future direct reports. We cover your travel and accommodation.

We will update you within 5 working days after each step and treat your candidacy with full confidentiality.

title: Senior Campaign Manager (Temp Contract)
description:
**About Pleo**
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
  
  
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
  
  
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!
  
  
**Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.**
**Who You’ll Be Working With And Reporting To**
You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:
  
  

* Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.
* The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.
* Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.
* Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.
* Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

**What You Bring**
You’ll thrive in this role if you have:
  
  

* A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.
* Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).
* High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.
* Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.
* Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.
* A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

**Why is this role a good fit for you**
This role is a good fit for you if:
  
  

* You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.
* You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.
* You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:
  
  

* You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.
* You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.
* You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

**How You’ll Develop In This Role**
In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:
  
  

* Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.
* Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.
* Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

**The location**
Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.
  
  
**Show me the benefits!**

* Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
* Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
* Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
* 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).
* For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
* We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
* Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

**The interview process**
We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:
  
  

* Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
* Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience
* Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
* Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!
  
  
Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:
  
  

* CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!
* Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
* Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

**About Your Application**

* English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
* A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
* Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
* Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
* Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
* Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
* Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.
