title: Global Retail Health & Safety Manager
description:
Brand

Puig

City

Barcelona

Work area

Facility Management

Job type

Permanent

**Who we are**
--------------

Puig is a home of Love Brands within a family company that furthers wellness, confidence and self-expression while leaving a better world. For more than a century, our entrepreneurial spirit and passion for creativity have made us a challenger in the premium beauty industry.

With 17 Love Brands across Fragrance and Fashion, Makeup and Skincare, we create stories that connect with people’s emotions and are powered by a global team of over 13,000 passionate professionals. With products sold in more than 150 countries and €5,042 million in net revenue in 2025, and guided by strong values and sustainability commitments, Puig continues to grow as a Home of Creativity: an open-minded space where Creators Of All Kinds are empowered to thrive, innovate and express who they are.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Puig is looking for a Global Retail Health & Safety Manager to define, deploy and continuously improve the Health & Safety strategy across the Group's worldwide retail network, with particular focus on directly operated stores and guidance for concessions, joint ventures and partner-operated retail environments.

Based in Barcelona and reporting directly to the OHSE & Integrated Management Systems Director, you will provide global leadership, governance and technical expertise, working closely with Retail Operations, Local Markets, Human Resources and other key stakeholders.

**What you'll get to do**
-------------------------

* Review and deliver the global Retail Health & Safety strategy, roadmap, governance model and annual objectives in alignment with the Group OHSE and business priorities
* Develop, maintain and deploy global retail Health & Safety processes, standards, procedures, toolkits and minimum requirements, ensuring they are practical, scalable and adaptable to local legislation
* Establish and maintain a global risk profile and risk register for retail locations, using a risk-based approach to prioritise resources, controls and improvement plans
* Partner with Global Retail and Facilities teams to integrate Health & Safety requirements into new store design, fit-outs, refurbishments, pre-opening reviews, property due diligence and management of change
* Carry out Health & Safety risk assessments in flagship stores and other key or higher-risk retail locations, documenting findings, defining proportionate controls and supporting their implementation
* Plan and perform Health & Safety inspections and audits in stores, concessions and other retail environments, both independently and together with local teams
* Prepare clear inspection and audit reports, agree corrective actions with local owners, monitor deadlines and verify that actions have been effectively closed
* Deliver Health & Safety training, workshops and awareness sessions for store managers, retail employees and relevant contractors, in person and virtually
* Review, update and quality-check Retail Health & Safety training content, guidance materials, induction resources and operational communications before deployment
* Provide day-to-day technical advice and practical support to Retail Operations and country teams, helping resolve Health & Safety issues arising in stores
* Support and, when required, lead investigations of incidents and near misses, identify root causes, agree corrective and preventive actions and share lessons learned across markets
* Monitor Retail Health & Safety performance, maintain accurate data in corporate systems and prepare practical reports on incidents, findings, overdue actions, recurring risks and deployment progress

**We'd love to meet you if you have**
-------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Occupational Health and Safety, Engineering, Facilities Management or a related discipline
* Professional Health & Safety qualifications, such as NEBOSH, IOSH or an equivalent international credential, are strongly preferred
* At least 5 years of Health & Safety experience, including substantial responsibility in a global or multi-country retail, luxury, consumer goods, hospitality or similarly customer-facing environment. Experience managing a geographically dispersed network of stores is essential
* Strong knowledge of occupational Health & Safety management systems, ISO 45001, risk assessment, legal compliance, audits and inspections, incident investigation, contractor management, emergency preparedness and continuous improvement
* Technical credibility with strong stakeholder management, persuasion and coaching skills. You can influence without direct authority, build effective relationships across cultures and functions, and create shared accountability for Health & Safety performance;
* English and Spanish are a must; French or other languages would be an advantage
* Availability to travel internationally
  

We welcome Creators Of All Kinds. If you are unsure of meeting all the requirements but trust you have the transferable skills to excel in this role, complete the application and our teams will get in touch if you are selected for an interview.

**What you'll love about us**
-----------------------------

* An entrepreneurial, creative and welcoming work culture
* A range of learning and development opportunities
* An international company with plenty of opportunities to grow
* A competitive compensation & benefits package

Puig is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

At Puig, we are continually looking for enthusiastic and committed individuals from a broad range of backgrounds and experiences to join our team. We believe that creating an inclusive environment in which you feel welcomed, valued, engaged, and empowered strengthens our business and fosters a culture where we are inspired to work hard, challenge ourselves, and be innovative in our thinking. Additionally, we believe that the diversity of our employees makes us a stronger company and better able to serve our customers around the world.

title: General Ledger Accountant
description:
**Company Description**

SLS Barcelona, a five-star urban resort of extraordinary experiences, brings a new variety of seaside glamour, indulgence and excellence to Barcelona’s waterfront district of Port Forum. Here the hallmarks of an SLS wonderland – playful ambiance, VIP treatment, and theatrical experiences - meet idyllic views to set a lavish stage for the extraordinary to unfold. The only 5-star hotel in the city to feature a terrace off every guestroom (471 in total), SLS Barcelona is all-encompassing in its delight, offering an array of exclusive amenities including rooftop dining and bars, three inviting swimming pools, a spacious 800 square-meter ballroom with abundant natural light, break out rooms catering to all size of meetings, a rejuvenating spa, and a state-of-the-art fitness centre. Say farewell to the ordinary, and hello to the extraordinary!

 **Job Description**

**What you’ll do**

We are looking for a Geneal Ledger Accountant to join the team at SLS Barcelona. Under the guidance of the Assistant Director of Finance, you’ll support the Finance department on the financial operations of the hotel while managing hotel assets and ensuring a centralized accounting environment.

  

* Maintains and consolidates all financial transactions in the general ledger.
* Ensures all assets are duly capitalized
* Ensures all necessary adjustments are done before month end
* Support internal and external audits
* Implement internal controls to prevent imbalances and ensure company procedures are in place
* Work closely with accounts payable and receivable teams to ensure timely postings
* Maintain Contract Log
* Resolve queries from suppliers
* Check vouchers, prepare payments and forward to FC for authorization.
* Perform or assist in the performance of month-end closing. Input General Ledger entries and journal vouchers as required. Ensure that appropriate supporting information is collated and submitted.
* Perform or assist in performing balance sheet reconciliations and bank reconciliations and oversee the process of credit extension and collection of overdue accounts.
* Oversee internal hotel audits and report anomalies to management team and ensuring that audit policies and procedures (Control Self-Assessment) are being followed.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports in accordance with reporting calendars, ensuring that all reports are submitted on a timely basis.
* Conduct necessary procedures to meet all legal requirements

  
**Qualifications**

**What we are looking for...**

* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, business administration or related field.
* +2 years of experience in a hotel’s accounting department.
* Ability to multitask, work in a fast-paced environment and have a high-level attention to detail.
* Fluent in Spanish and English.
* You take ownership of important issues, solve problems, and make effective decisions.
* You learn quickly and adapt to SLS’s unique culture.
* You are humble and open to ideas. We leave our ego at the door and help get things done.
* You’re up for doing things differently and trying (almost) everything once.
* You want to be part of a team that works hard, supports each other and has fun along the way.

  
**Additional Information**

**What's in it for you...**

* The opportunity to join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand.
* The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
* Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and exploring new locations at every opportunity.
* A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.
* Excellent discounts across the entire Ennismore family of brands.

SLS is part of Ennismore, a creative hospitality company rooted in culture and community, with a global collection of entrepreneurial and founder-built brands with purpose at their heart. Ennismore is a joint- venture with Accor, formed in 2021.

title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description**

**We’re looking for a Accountant to join our team at The Hoxton, Poblenou!**

The Hoxton Poblenou in the city of Barcelona is our 11th Hoxton. The hotel boasts 240 bedrooms of different sizes, a large restaurant Four Corners with The Slice shop and La Bodega, a rooftop pool and our taqueria Tope, a bright and airy lobby, a multi-functional basement events space and The Apartment (our unique meetings & events concept).

**More about us...**

The Hoxton is a series of open-house hotels, each in a neighbourhood that we love. Ever since we opened our first hotel in Shoreditch, we’ve never just been about offering a bed for the night. We want to be more than that: proving style doesn’t need to be sacrificed for good value and providing a place where guests can hang out alongside the locals and submerse themselves in the neighbourhood with vibrant, welcoming public spaces.

Reporting to the Director of Finance, you will be you will be responsible to assist in managing the day-to-day operations of Accounting.

**What's in it for you...**

* A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.
* Type of contract: Fijo discontinuo.
* The opportunity to be part of the Finance function for an exciting hospitality concept that is new to Barcelona (and Spain).
* Join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand.
* The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
* Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and building a portfolio of brands.
* It’s ok not to be Ok, we have a confidential hotline for any support you require about anything and a network of mental health first aiders.
* Enjoy a free night at The Hoxton and a meal for two when you first start with us.
* Goes without saying, but we’ll feed you when on shift.
* Great discounts across the entire Ennismore family.
* Lots of opportunity to progress and switch it up as part of a global family of brands.
* Extra time off to volunteer with one of our partner charities.
* Regular team get togethers, from our team drinks to our (pretty special!) bi-annual parties – we know how to have a good time!
* An annual diversity and inclusion calendar of events creating opportunities for you to learn, celebrate and make a positive impact.

  
**Job Description**

**What you’ll do…**

* Comply with all applicable laws related to fraud and collection procedure.
* Generate and provide accurate and timely results in the form of reports and presentations.
* Analyse information and evaluate results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
* Balance credit card ledgers.
* Verify contracts for groups and perform credit reference checks for direct billed groups if necessary.
* Achieve and exceed goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
* Develop specific goals and plan to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
* Submit reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.
* Ensure profits and losses are documented accurately.
* Support supervisor with a strong accounting and operational control environment to safeguard assets.
* Complete period-end closing procedures and reports.

  
**Qualifications**

**What we’re looking for…**

* Previous experience in a similar role within the hospitality industry.
* Demonstrate knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.
* Keep up-to-date technically and applying new knowledge to your job.
* You have Excel skills; intermediate to advanced level.
* You are able to work in a fast-paced environment and cope with pressure.
* You jump out of bed every morning, fizzing with energy and jazzed about what you’re doing today.
* You are a bundle of ideas. They happen in the shower, on your bike, and in the office.
* You are humble. There are no egos, and no drama.
* You’re not precious. You appreciate some ideas work and some don’t. But we do like to try (almost) everything once.
* You like detail, a lot of detail.

  
**Additional Information**

*Sus datos serán tratados por The Hoxton, Poblenou (Middlebury Invest, S.L.) para posibilitar su participación en nuestro proceso de selección. Puede solicitar información adicional acerca del referido tratamiento o sobre el ejercicio de sus derechos, entre otros, de acceso, rectificación, supresión, oposición o portabilidad dirigiéndose a: The Hoxton, Poblenou, Avda. Diagonal, 205. 08018 Barcelona o a data@ennismore.com.*

title: Senior Business Consultant (Account Director)
description:
### **Description**

At Revolt we build brands the world wants more of.  
Revolt is a global brand communications agency specialising in positive impact, working with major brands, fast‑growing businesses and NGOs.  
  
Sat at the intersection of brand communications, impact and business, we help brands build their corporate reputations, brand equity and internal culture.  
  
We operate like a hybrid between a strategy consultancy and a creative agency: intellectually rigorous, creatively ambitious, and values‑driven  
  
Revolt is part of Anthesis, the world's leading specialist in sustainability, meaning everything we do is backed by substance and technical rigour.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Business Consultant to join our team. This is a hands-on role for someone who is confident leading and delivering projects independently while contributing to strategic discussions and commercial growth opportunities.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Business Director but will be expected to manage the day-to-day running of projects themselves. This role does not have direct line management responsibilities and requires someone who is highly organised, commercially minded, relationship-driven, and exceptionally strong in project management.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the day-to-day management and delivery of client projects and campaigns, ensuring work is delivered on time, within budget, and to a high standard.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, internal teams, and external partners, acting as a trusted point of contact throughout project delivery.
* Understand client objectives and translate them into clear project briefs, proposals, and scopes of work.
* Contribute to strategic discussions and support the development of client strategies, sustainability communications approaches, and project recommendations.
* Ensure all deliverables meet client objectives and quality standards.
* Manage project finances, including estimates, budgets, purchase orders, invoicing processes, and project profitability.
* Identify opportunities to grow existing client accounts and contribute to new business opportunities.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams and manage project workflows to ensure smooth and effective delivery.
* Proactively identify and resolve project or client challenges.
* Stay up to date with client sectors, industry developments, and market trends.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

  

* Strong relationship-building skills with clients, internal stakeholders, and external partners.
* Ability to understand client needs and translate them into clear actions and deliverables.

* Ability to contribute to strategic discussions and decision-making.
* Comfortable articulating strategic recommendations and client solutions.

* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify growth opportunities.
* Understanding of project profitability, budgeting, and commercial delivery.
* Experience preparing proposals and small to medium scopes of work.

* Exceptional project management skills with experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to independently run small to medium-sized projects with limited oversight.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Confident communicating with clients, senior stakeholders, and internal teams.

* Proactive and solutions-oriented approach.
* Ability to resolve project and client challenges effectively and calmly.

### **Job Benefits**

  

* Work within a highly motivated team in an innovative and rapidly growing global company
* Opportunity to have a direct impact and be a key part of the growth and development of the business and the team
* Competitive salary in line with, experience and skills
* Competitive benefits including flexible working, 25 days holiday and two volunteering days off and the day off for your Birthday!
* Cooperative, supportive and open working atmosphere.

### **About Anthesis Group**

**Our commitment to building and maintaining a diverse workforce**  
  
Anthesis has clients across all industry sectors and supports some of the world’s largest multinationals such as Reckitt, Cisco, Tesco, The North Face, and Target. The company brings together 1,300+ experts operating across 22 countries and 44 office locations with offices in Australia, Belgium, Brazil, Canada, China, Colombia, Finland, France, Germany, Hong Kong, Ireland, Italy, the Middle East, Netherlands, the Philippines, Singapore, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the UK, and the US.  
  
We encourage all employees to contribute their ideas, perspectives, and experiences to help us create an inclusive and equitable workplace. By embracing diversity and providing equal opportunities, we believe we can drive innovation, foster creativity, and achieve our shared goals. So, if you’re ready to be a part of something truly extraordinary, then we want you! Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.  
  
Together, we can continue to build a diverse and inclusive workforce where everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and thrive.  
  
If you require any reasonable adjustments to be made to your application process, or need this job advert in a different format, just let us know and we’ll be happy to help.

description:
**T'apassiona el món del lleure educatiu? T'agrada organitzar activitats, dinamitzar equips i impulsar projectes amb impacte social? Aquesta oportunitat és per a tu!**

Busquem una persona dinàmica, creativa i amb iniciativa, que gaudeixi treballant en equip, impulsant projectes i acompanyant equips de voluntariat.

**Quina serà la teva missió?**

Seràs una peça clau en l'organització i dinamització de projectes, activitats i trobades de lleure educatiu, fomentant la participació i el compromís dels equips de monitors i monitores i contribuint al creixement del MCECC.

Què faràs en el teu dia a dia?

* **Dinamitzar i acompanyar equips de monitors/es i voluntariat**, promovent la motivació, la participació i el treball en equip.
* **Idear, organitzar i coordinar activitats, trobades i projectes de lleure educatiu**, des de la planificació fins a l'execució.
* **Fer el seguiment dels projectes**, assegurant-ne el bon desenvolupament i la consecució dels objectius.
* **Gestionar els pressupostos i recursos econòmics** dels projectes, identificant oportunitats de finançament.
* **Avaluar les activitats i elaborar memòries**, proposant millores per continuar creixent.

Què t'oferim?

* **Contracte indefinit**,
* **Jornada de 20 hores setmanals**, amb horari flexible.
* **Centre de treball a Barcelona.**
* L'oportunitat de formar part d'un projecte educatiu amb valors i compromís social.
* Un entorn de treball col·laboratiu, vinculat al món de l'esplai i el voluntariat.

T'hi sumes?

Si tens experiència o vinculació amb el món del lleure educatiu, t'agrada treballar amb persones i et motiva transformar idees en projectes i experiències compartides, ens encantaria conèixer-te!

Inscriu-te i vine a formar part del MCECC!

  

Requisits imprescindibles:

* Bon nivell de català i castellà.
* Certificat negatiu de delictes sexuals actualitzat.
* Coneixements d'informàtica a nivell usuari: Office, Outlook...
* Experiència prèvia de 3 anys com a monitor/a de lleure.

Requisits valorables

* Formació universitària en àmbit social.
* Titulació monitor/a o director/a de lleure.

title: DIRECTOR/A GLOBAL COMUNICACION B2C
description:
Buscamos un/a Director/a Global de Comunicación B2C para liderar nuestra comunicación con el consumidor y acompañar la evolución de la compañía hacia una marca global, relevante, diferencial y deseable.
  
  
Trabajando estrechamente con la Dirección Creativa y de Marca, será responsable de convertir el posicionamiento y la visión creativa en una estrategia integrada de comunicación que conecte directamente con el consumidor.
  
  
¿Cuál será tu misión?
  
  
Definir y ejecutar la estrategia global de comunicación B2C.
  
  
Liderar PR, medios, social media, influencers, KOLs, celebrities y product placement.
  
  
Construir relaciones directas con medios, periodistas, editores, stylists, creators y perfiles culturalmente relevantes.
  
  
Liderar la estrategia de Instagram, TikTok y nuevas plataformas, entendiendo sus códigos, formatos y métricas.
  
  
Gestionar agencias y partners externos, asegurando calidad, coherencia y resultados.
  
  
Identificar oportunidades culturales, editoriales y de colaboración que aumenten la notoriedad, relevancia y deseabilidad de la marca.
  
  
Definir KPIs y medir el impacto real de las acciones de comunicación.
  
  
¿Qué buscamos?
  
  
Un/a profesional senior de comunicación B2C, idealmente procedente de sectores como eyewear, moda, lujo, beauty, accesorios premium o lifestyle, con:
  
  
Fuerte experiencia en PR, media, social e influencer marketing.
  
  
Excelente red de contactos y capacidad para construir relaciones.
  
  
Experiencia con celebrities, stylists y product placement.
  
  
Profundo conocimiento del entorno digital y social.
  
  
Experiencia internacional y sensibilidad cultural.
  
  
Perfil hands-on, conectado, creativo y muy orientado a la ejecución.
  
  
Buscamos a alguien que no gestione la comunicación únicamente a través de agencias: queremos una persona que conozca los canales, esté conectada con lo que ocurre culturalmente y tenga capacidad para hacer que las cosas sucedan.

title: FASHION PHOTOGRAPHER | TEEN&KIDS
description:
En MANGO vestimos de pasión todo lo que hacemos. Con origen en Barcelona y presencia en más de 120 países, inspiramos al mundo con creatividad, innovación y autenticidad.

Nuestro equipo multicultural es el motor de nuestro éxito. Nos enorgullece llevar la moda más allá, conectando nuestro estilo único con personas de todo el mundo.

Tu objetivo será participar en la creación y elevación de la imagen de las líneas de Teen y Kids de la mano de los equipos de estilismo y dirección de arte.

  
  

**PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES**

  

* Realizar las sesiones de fotografía con modelo con foco en Teen y apoyo a Kids (e-commerce, cápsulas, especiales, etc.).
* Seleccionar las fotografías para las fichas de producto de la web teniendo en cuenta las necesidades del cliente, las características de la colección, y la dirección de imagen.
* Trabajar el tratamiento de color junto al equipo de retoque y asegurar la calidad de la post-producción.
* Liderar los cambios de luz de temporada junto con el equipo creativo, y proponer y construir nuevas luces y tratamientos para colecciones especiales de forma proactiva y resolutiva.
* Asegurar el control de los sets de Teen y Kids y su correcto funcionamiento técnico en todo momento.
* Trabajar activamente con otros fotógrafos, estilistas, directores de arte, merchands, retocadores, productores, modelos, maquilladores para llegar a los objetivos de productividad e imagen de una forma colaborativa.
* Grabar y montar videos para ambas líneas tanto en e-commerce como en especiales.
* Participar en el uso de la IA en ambas líneas tanto en generación de imagen como en mejora de procesos.
* Velar por la imagen de Teen y Kids en todos los touchpoints de forma constante.

  
  

**SOBRE TI**

  

* Dominio técnico en fotografía e iluminación.
* Control de Capture One y Photoshop a nivel avanzado.
* Experiencia en fotografía digital y analógica.
* Trabajos previos en studio y en montaje de luces.
* Sensibilidad estética y gusto por la moda.
* Experiencia con modelos niños o jóvenes.
* Interés en grabación de video e IA generativa.

* Imprescindible un nivel alto de inglés.

* Curiosidad y capacidad para mantenerse al día con tendencias de moda, estilos creativos y novedades técnicas.

* Habilidades de comunicación, transparencia y trabajo en equipo.

* Capacidad de planificación, organización y orden.
* Exigencia visual, proactividad, resolución y responsabilidad individual.

* Capacidad de trabajar bajo presión y adaptarse a las necesidades de producción creativa.

**TUS BENEFICIOS:**

* Disfruta de un horario flexible y trabajo híbrido que se adapta a tus necesidades. En MANGO, apostamos por la conciliación de la vida profesional y personal.
* En MANGO, el fin de semana empieza el viernes a mediodía. Ofrecemos horario intensivo los viernes y vísperas de festivos.
* Planifica tus vacaciones según tus preferencias. En MANGO, valoramos tu tiempo y queremos que disfrutes de cada momento.
* Como parte del equipo de MANGO, tendrás descuento en todas nuestras líneas, ¡para que estés siempre a la última!
* Disfrutarás de My Mango Benefits, nuestra plataforma de beneficios, desde la que podrás adaptar tu compensación a tu estilo de vida con ventajas fiscales, además de acceso a un portal de descuentos en múltiples marcas y servicios.
* Paquete de retribución flexible con ventajas fiscales: seguro médico, formación, catering y programa de guardería.
* Transporte de empresa gratuito desde Barcelona y El Vallés.
* En MANGO, invertimos en tu crecimiento personal y profesional. Accede a una oferta de formación variada, mentorías personalizadas, programas de desarrollo continuo y oportunidades de promoción interna que te impulsarán hacia el éxito. A nivel técnico, podrás formarte en el uso de diferentes plataformas tecnológicas, así como participar en workshops, meetups, comunidades de prácticas, team buildings y company meetings.
* ¡Piensa en grande! MANGO te ofrece oportunidades internacionales en más de 120 mercados para expandir tu horizonte y crecer junto con nosotros a nivel global.

En MANGO, creemos en una cultura inclusiva donde la creatividad y la innovación nos inspiran a llevar la moda más allá. Por ello, tenemos el compromiso de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades para todas las personas, valorando la autenticidad de cada individuo.

title: Marketing & Content Specialist
description:
Descripción

#### **Sobre elrow y Monegros festival**

elrow y Monegros Festival son mucho más que eventos o festivales de música electrónica. Son comunidades globales que celebran la creatividad, la inclusión y el espíritu festivo, conectando a fans de todo el mundo a través de experiencias únicas, tanto online como offline. Nuestro reto es sorprender, inspirar y mantener viva la cultura y los valores de la marca en cada interacción y conversación.

Desde Barcelona al mundo, llevamos más de una década reinventando la forma de vivir la cultura y música electrónica, y ahora queremos llevar la marca al siguiente nivel, y para eso buscamos talento que se una a nuestra gran familia, y en concreto a nuestro equipo de Brand y Marketing.

#### **Sobre el Rol**

Este es un rol ideal para un/a profesional digital apasionado/a por las comunidades y la creación de contenido. Como Marketing& Content Specialist, eres el rostro y la voz diaria de elrow y Monegros en todos los canales sociales. Además de dinamizar y atender a las comunidades, ejecutas y publicas los planes de contenido definidos por el/la Social Media Manager, coordinando la entrega y publicación de los assets visuales junto al equipo creativo.

Participas activamente en la redacción de copys y te aseguras que cada publicación refleje el tono, energía y valores de las marcas. Reportarás directamente a la Social Media Manager, colaborando con todo el equipo de Brand y Creatividad para mantener el máximo nivel de frescura, impacto y coherencia en cada canal.

**Responsabilidades**

* Ejecutar los calendarios y planes de contenido definidos por el/la Social Media Manager: coordinación, publicación y control de posts diarios, stories, reels y acciones especiales.
* Publicar y programar contenidos en todas las redes sociales de elrow y Monegros (Instagram, TikTok, principalmente – así como Facebook, X, YouTube…en segundo plano), asegurando la correcta entrega de assets visuales/multimedia en colaboración con el equipo creativo.
* Colaborar en la creación y redacción de copy’s para posts, stories y campañas, manteniendo la voz y el tono característico de elrow y Monegros en cada comunicación.
* Preparar y revisar materiales visuales (vídeo, imagen, creatividades), chequeando entregas del equipo creativo antes de publicar y asegurando la excelencia y coherencia de cada output
* Gestionar y activar la comunidad digital, respondiendo, moderando y dinamizando comentarios, mensajes privados y menciones en tiempo real.
* Detectar y canalizar feedbacks, tendencias y situaciones críticas en nuestras comunidades de fans y seguidores, comunicando insights a la Social Media Manager y Head of Brand.
* Dinámicas y activaciones en redes sociales: idear, lanzar y dar soporte a concursos, retos, encuestas y colaboraciones con fans, influencers y artistas, promoviendo el engagement y el espíritu festivo de las marcas.
* Monitorizar reputación y conversaciones clave, reportando insights, oportunidades y riesgos al equipo de forma agil y regular.
* Formar parte activa del equipo de social media & content, proponiendo ideas para nuevos formatos, campañas sociales y contenidos innovadores.

Requisitos

* 2 - 4 años de experiencia previa como Community Manager y/o Content Creator o Social Media Executive en marcas de entretenimiento, música, festivales, lifestyle o cultura digital.
* Dominio avanzado de plataformas sociales, herramientas de publicación y monitorización (Meta tools, Notion, Creator Studio, Sprout, Discord…u otras relevantes).
* Excelente capacidad de redacción, creatividad en copys y formato breve tanto en español como en inglés.
* Conocimiento del ecosistema digital: redes sociales, contenido, cultura de internet, influencers, etc.
* Experiencia gestionando flujos de contenido (visual/copy), coordinación con equipos creativos y control de entregas diarias.
* Actitud proactiva, agilidad y empatía en la gestión de comunidades digitales, con ganas de innovar y sorprender cada día.
* Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, y gran orientación al detalle y coherencia de marca.

title: Store Manager Barcelona
description:
**Become our Store Manager and establish Hatstore in Barcelona**
----------------------------------------------------------------

#### **Help build Hatstore’s next international store**

2026 is an important year for Hatstore. Following our first international store launch, we’re taking the next step in our retail expansion and opening a new store in **Barcelona**.

Since launching in 2011, we’ve grown into one of Northern Europe’s leading e-commerce retailers for caps and headwear. Now we’re continuing to develop Hatstore as a brand and a place to meet, both offline and online. With our store in Barcelona, we want to create an inspiring destination for caps, fashion and a great customer experience.

For this exciting chapter, we’re looking for an **entrepreneurial, driven and hands-on Store Manager** who wants to help build our presence in Barcelona from the very beginning.

**About Hatstore**
------------------

Hatstore was founded on a genuine passion for caps, creativity and innovation—and those are still what drive us forward.

Today, we have more than 100 employees and sell to customers in 55 countries. Our range includes tens of thousands of caps, beanies and hats, including the option to create custom designs.

Our international retail expansion is an important part of Hatstore’s continued growth. We’re now looking for someone who wants to help make Barcelona an important part of our international store expansion.

**Your role as Store Manager**
------------------------------

As Store Manager of our new store in Barcelona, you’ll play a key role in establishing and developing Hatstore in the Spanish market.

You’ll be responsible for the store’s day-to-day operations, building and leading your team, and ensuring our customers have an experience that reflects the Hatstore brand.

You’ll also work closely with our head office in Sweden and be an important link between the local business and our international team.

This is an opportunity to be involved from the start, influence the way we work and lay the foundations for future Hatstore stores in other markets.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

**Store launch & development**  
Take part in planning, launching and developing our new store in Barcelona.

**Leadership & team**  
Recruit, onboard, develop and motivate the store team, and build a strong team culture.

**Sales & customer experience**  
Ensure a high level of service, create an inspiring store environment and actively work towards the store’s sales targets.

**Store operations & merchandise flow**  
Take responsibility for day-to-day operations, stock, merchandise flow, inventory and orders.

**Building the brand locally**  
Help build Hatstore’s local brand through social media, partnerships, events and other creative initiatives.

**Budget & performance follow-up**  
Manage the store’s budget and key performance indicators, and monitor and report results to our head office in Sweden.

**We believe you**
------------------

* Have experience in retail, for example as a Store Manager, shop manager, team leader or in a similar role
* Are a natural leader who enjoys developing people and building teams
* Have a strong customer focus and understand what makes a great in-store experience
* Are entrepreneurial, solution-oriented and used to taking responsibility
* Enjoy working hands-on and are ready to roll up your sleeves when needed
* Have a good understanding of retail and the local market in Barcelona
* Are comfortable with social media and enjoy creating content and building a brand
* Are proficient in English, as you’ll work closely with our head office in Sweden
* Are proficient in Spanish; Catalan language skills are an advantage
* Have a genuine interest in caps, fashion, sport and streetwear

You’re also someone who gets things done. You’re sociable, down-to-earth and confident in your leadership. You enjoy meeting people and building relationships, while also being clear and direct when needed.

An interest in American sports is an advantage, as a large part of our range is connected to MLB, NBA, NHL and NFL.

**What we offer**
-----------------

**A key role in Hatstore’s international expansion**  
You’ll be an important part of our continued international retail journey and help launch our new store in Barcelona.

**The opportunity to build something from the ground up**  
You’ll have plenty of scope to influence how the store develops, how the team works and how Hatstore establishes itself locally.

**International collaboration**  
You’ll work closely with our head office in Sweden and become part of a growing international team.

**Employee discounts**  
Enjoy attractive employee discounts across the Hatstore range.

**Annual wellness allowance**  
All employees receive an individual wellness allowance that can be used for activities such as sports and outdoor pursuits, or for spa, wellness and recovery.

**A growing and passionate organisation**  
Join us on an exciting growth journey where caps, creativity, entrepreneurship and people are at the heart of everything we do.

**Become part of Hatstore**
---------------------------

We’re looking for our next **Hatstar**, someone who wants to help make Hatstore a go-to destination for caps and headwear in Barcelona.

Does this sound like you? Apply today and become part of Hatstore’s international expansion.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Principal, Talent Marketing
description:
**About us**
------------

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing fintech, Moniepoint is trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of dollars in transactions monthly. Having built resilient, high-volume financial infrastructure that powers commerce across emerging markets, Moniepoint is embarking on its next phase of global scale.

**About this role**
-------------------

As our Senior Principal, Talent Marketing, you will be the strategic architect responsible for establishing Moniepoint's talent brand and candidate pipeline in new markets from scratch. Where Moniepoint is not yet an established consumer brand, you will solve complex talent acquisition problems by understanding how senior engineers, engineering managers, and technical leaders think, connect, and evaluate career moves across Europe. Working from a blank piece of paper with high autonomy, you will translate our global Employer Value Proposition (EVP) into localized, high-converting talent marketing strategies. You will bridge the gap between Talent Acquisition, Engineering Leadership, and Brand - combining developer community immersion, high-touch physical events, and targeted campaigns that turn brand discovery into qualified, closed engineering hires.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **1. Zero-to-One Market Entry & Tech Hub Architecture**

* **Define European Hub Talent Strategy:** Architect and lead the talent go-to-market strategy for Moniepoint's newest engineering hubs (principally Poland and Spain), crafting localized narratives that appeal to discerning software engineers.
* **Anchor the 'Founding Team' Narrative:** Position early European engineering cohorts as foundational builders, creating compelling narratives around technical scale, system complexity, and ownership that resonate with elite technical talent.
* **Navigate Market Nuances:** Diagnose and navigate country-specific developer dynamics—recognizing that developer communities in Poland, Spain, and the UK behave differently and require tailored engagement models rather than copy-pasted playbooks.

### **2. Developer Community, Ecosystem & Event Activation**

* **High-Impact Physical & Virtual Presence:** Conceive, curate, and lead our physical presence at key developer conferences, engineering meetups, hackathons, and university partnerships across target markets.
* **End-to-End Pipeline Activation:** Ensure events are never vanity exercises; architect end-to-end follow-up systems and talent nurture funnels that convert event attendees into active, screened pipelines for our TA partners.
* **Developer Platform Immersion:** Leverage deep knowledge of where engineers consume information (e.g., GitLab/GitHub communities, tech forums, Discord/Slack groups, Meetup, Eventbrite) to drive authentic engagement.

### **3. Strategic Hiring Campaigns & Technical Enablement**

* **Targeted Campaign Architecture:** Partner with TA leads and Engineering Directors to identify acute hiring bottlenecks and build agile, multi-channel marketing campaigns that address specialized, hard-to-fill tech disciplines.
* **Technical EVP Translation:** Translate technical architecture, distributed systems challenges, and fintech infrastructure realities into authentic, intellectually rigorous technical messaging that outshines local competitors.
* **Recruiter Enablement & Narrative Toolkits:** Equip our technical sourcing and recruitment teams with high-leverage narrative assets—outbound pitch decks, technical one-pagers, culture collateral, and messaging sequences that double recruiter outreach conversion.

### **4. Performance, Analytics & Optimization**

* **Hiring-Centric Metrics:** Discard vanity metrics. Evaluate every initiative against pipeline contribution, qualified applicant rates, candidate quality score, cost-per-hire, and time-to-fill.
* **Budget Oversight:** Own and allocate dedicated talent marketing budgets with extreme commercial discipline—scaling programs that drive measurable hires and rapidly decommissioning initiatives that underdeliver.
* **Paid Acquisition (Tactical Lever):** Oversee and strategically deploy paid recruitment marketing spend across relevant technical platforms and channels when targeted outbound and community channels require acceleration.

### **5. Strategic Leadership & Scalability**

* **Strategic Thought Partnership:** Serve as the trusted advisor to the Head of Talent Acquisition, VP of Engineering, and Brand Leadership on talent market intelligence, competitor positioning, and developer sentiment.
* **Playbook Documentation:** Establish and document Moniepoint's global talent expansion playbook, creating scalable frameworks that will be deployed across future international markets.
* **Mentorship & Functional Growth:** Provide strategic guidance to broader TA and brand team members, with the opportunity to mentor or direct junior talent marketing specialists as the function scales.

**Experience & Background**
---------------------------

* **8+ Years of Talent Marketing Leadership:** Experience leading talent marketing, technical recruitment marketing, or developer relations/advocacy, with substantial time dedicated to hiring software engineering and product disciplines.
* **European Market Expertise:** Demonstrated experience building talent brand presence and hiring pipelines across European tech ecosystems (particularly Central/Eastern Europe such as Poland, and Western/Southern Europe such as the UK or Spain).
* **Zero-to-One Market Entry Track Record:** Proven success entering new geographies or scaling talent brand where the employer brand was nascent or non-existent, creating playbooks from a blank sheet of paper.
* **Fintech & Scale Exposure:** Experience in hyper-growth fintech, high-frequency/payments infrastructure, or high-scale distributed systems environments.
* **International Collaboration:** Experience collaborating with international founding teams or distributed tech hubs across emerging and mature markets.

**Skills & Competencies**
-------------------------

* **Mastery in Event-Driven Pipeline Activation:** Extensive hands-on experience designing and executing physical and digital developer events and architecting the subsequent candidate nurturing journey that yields hires.
* **Deep Engineering Domain Fluency:** Genuine understanding of software engineering culture, tech stacks (distributed systems, backend, infra, DevOps), and developer channels (Meetup, Eventbrite, GitLab/GitHub, Reddit, tech conferences).
* **Comfort with Substantial Ambiguity:** High agency and entrepreneurial drive; ability to make decisive bets, test hypotheses, and build structure in fast-moving, high-growth environments.
* **Strategic Campaign Design:** Ability to connect high-level EVP strategy to pragmatic, sprint-based talent acquisition sprints that deliver on an aggressive hiring plan (500+ tech hires).
* **Paid Digital Campaign Optimization:** Direct experience running and optimizing paid digital recruitment advertising campaigns independently across social and developer networks.

**What success looks like in this role**
----------------------------------------

* **First 30 Days (Discovery & Immersion):** Map the competitive landscape and developer talent dynamics in Poland and Spain. Establish alignment with technical hiring leads (PEP, Engineering Directors) and TA leads to define immediate priority pipelines. Audit existing employer brand collateral and identify localized messaging gaps for European tech hiring.
* **First 90 Days (Initial Market Entry & Quick Wins):** Launch the first pilot physical event / developer meetup presence in Poland with a complete post-event pipeline conversion funnel. Roll out the European Recruiter Enablement Toolkit (localized pitch decks, outreach sequences, and technical one-pagers). Launch targeted marketing sprints for top 3 hardest-to-fill senior technical roles.
* **First 6 Months (Hub Establishment & Pipeline Ramp):** Position Moniepoint as a recognized, compelling engineering hub in Poland, supporting the identity and pride of the founding engineer cohort. Consistently contribute qualified, pre-warmed candidate pipelines directly supporting the ramp toward 500 tech/product hires. Prove multi-channel attribution showing which community and marketing initiatives are yielding quality hires.
* **Year One (Global Expansion Playbook):** Complete Moniepoint's International Talent Expansion Playbook, ready to be deployed across future tech hubs. Measurably decrease time-to-fill and increase direct outbound response rates across all European technical roles. Solidify Moniepoint's reputation as an employer of choice for Europe's most ambitious engineers.

**Why join us**
---------------

* **High-Impact Mission:** Play a career-defining role in building the engineering backbone of Africa's fastest-growing fintech as it scales globally.
* **True Ownership & Dedicated Resources:** Autonomy to build from scratch with dedicated budget backing and direct executive sponsorship.
* **Front-Row Seat to Tech Hub Creation:** Help build engineering hubs from their inception, shaping culture, talent standards, and brand identity.
* **Competitive Executive Package:** Competitive base salary (calibrated for Senior Principal level), performance bonuses, comprehensive private healthcare, and pension schemes.

#### Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
description:
**Barcelona / Hybrid**  
**Tendios**

At Tendios, we are building the intelligence layer for public procurement. Our platform helps companies identify and win public tenders, while helping public institutions improve procurement processes and tender management.

Tendios is at a turning point. Over the next three years we have the opportunity to grow from a local Catalan player into a global company, multiplying our revenue, our team and our customer base across many new countries. Events are where we meet our customers, build our brand and generate demand across the public procurement ecosystem. That is why field marketing is a key area at Tendios.

We are looking for an outstanding Senior Field Marketing Manager who will own our events strategy end to end, in Spain and internationally, and become one of the public faces of Tendios.

You will join the Marketing team, reporting directly to the Global Head of Marketing. This is an autonomous, high-ownership role at the intersection of brand, demand generation and public-sector relationships.

### **Your Mission**

Turn Tendios' events into a growth engine: build brand awareness, generate qualified pipeline and position Tendios as the reference in AI for public procurement, in Spain and in every new market we enter.

This role is not only about organising events. It is about owning the stage: designing memorable experiences, taking the microphone and building the relationships that open doors for Tendios.

### **Responsibilities**

**Events strategy and end-to-end management**

* Define and own the annual events calendar for Spain and international markets
* Manage every event end to end: concept, budget, organisers, vendors, logistics, stand production, onsite execution and follow-up
* Design and run Tendios' own events, from breakfasts and workshops to flagship forums
* Lead Tendios' event presence in new international markets

**Public speaking and brand representation**

* Act as a Tendios spokesperson: present, moderate panels and host our own events
* Identify and secure speaking slots and event sponsorships at key sector gatherings
* Represent Tendios in front of public-sector buyers, suppliers and the media

**Webinars**

* Own Tendios' webinar programme end to end: strategy, calendar, topics, speakers, promotion, delivery and lead follow-up
* Use webinars to reach new audiences in Spain and international markets
* Measure the impact of each webinar on registrations, attendance, leads and pipeline

**Strategic relationships for field**

* Manage relationships with event organisers, public entities, associations, chambers of commerce and speakers
* Turn these relationships into speaking opportunities, co-hosted events and webinars

**Internal collaboration**

* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success and Product so that every event serves commercial goals
* Equip the Sales team with the materials and plans they need before, during and after each event

### **Requirements**

We are looking for someone excellent, detail-oriented and passionate about events. Someone who feels at home both behind the scenes and on stage.

#### **Experience**

* 8+ years in event management, ideally in B2B or B2G
* Proven end-to-end management of events and webinars, in Spain and internationally
* Experience in public procurement: you understand how public tenders work and how the public sector buys
* Proven experience in public speaking.

SaaS, tech or GovTech experience is a strong plus.

#### **Skills**

* Excellent communication skills, written and spoken
* Great attention to detail: every event reflects the quality of our brand
* Autonomy and ownership: you set priorities, make decisions and deliver results
* Strong relationship-building skills
* Budget and vendor management
* Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM and event management tools

AI as a productivity ally

* You use AI tools in your day-to-day work to plan, create content, analyse results and work faster and better

#### **Languages**

* Spanish, English and Catalan: mandatory
* Portuguese, French and/or Italian: highly valued

Availability to travel 30–40%, including international travel.

**Success in this role will be measured by the impact of field marketing on business metrics and revenue funnel, as well as, brand.**

* **Pipeline generation:** leads, SQLs and pipeline generated or influenced by events and webinars
* **Revenue impact:** closed-won deals and revenue influenced by field activities
* **Brand presence:** speaking slots, sector visibility and Tendios' positioning at key events
* **Efficiency:** cost per lead and ROI for each event and webinar

#### **What we offer**

* Permanent contract with competitive salary + variable, reviewed every 6 months
* Flexible schedule and hybrid work (minimum 1 office day per week)
* 24 working days off + your birthday + 1 additional day
* A senior role leading a key area, with real influence on our international expansion
* Bright office in central Barcelona
* Growth-mindset culture, autonomy and a toxicity-free environment
* Immediate start

#### **Why join Tendios**

Tendios is at the beginning of its international journey, and field marketing will be decisive in it. Your mission will be to make Tendios the name everyone remembers at every public procurement event, in Spain and beyond. If you love events, feel at home on stage and want to help build a global company, we want to hear from you.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

  

* Strategic thinking and business acumen

* Change management and adaptability
* Intercultural sensitivity and global mindset
Commitment to ethical and inclusive hiring practices

------------------

  

This role reports to the Global Head of Talent, with dotted line to Global Head of HR Manufacturing and Industrial Operations.

title: Strategy & Transformation Specialist
description:
Quiénes somos

We are TK Airport Solutions, a business unit of TKE Group.

TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility, providing engineering — from design through installation, maintenance and modernization — for elevators, escalators, moving walkways, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators. TKE employs more than 50.000 people around the world, being present in more than 100 countries.

From our engineering and manufacturing site in Mieres, Asturias, TKAS offers a full portfolio of airport apron and gate mobility solutions. Our **passenger boarding bridges** connect terminals to aircraft safely and efficiently. Our **ground support equipment** covers preconditioned air, ground power units and potable water units for aircraft turnaround. Our **advanced visual docking guidance systems (A-VDGS)**, including the LiDAR-based Apron Vision, ensure precise and safe aircraft docking. Our **digital solutions** — MAX Automate, MAX Monitor & Control and MAX Maintenance Manager — bring AI and remote operation to the apron.

We also provide **modernization and service** programs, including upgrades and spare parts that extend equipment life and performance, and we adapt this same engineering expertise to **seaports**, with our Seaport Passenger Boarding Bridges (SPBB) for ferry and cruise terminals.

Our equipment is used at more than 370 airports in over 100 countries, and TK Elevator boarding bridges have carried over 1.8 billion passengers worldwide.

Joining TKAS means working on real engineering challenges at global scale, combining German engineering heritage with a strong local team in Asturias, and contributing to safer, smarter and more sustainable airport infrastructure.

**Qué esperamos**
-----------------

**Your mission :** Support the Head of Strategy and the CEO Office in defining, tracking and delivering the company’s strategic initiatives. You’ll provide high-quality analysis and reporting, and use data to challenge initiative owners so that initiatives move forward, are properly prioritised and deliver the expected impact.

**What you’ll do:**

**Analysis and reporting (c. 50%)**  
Half of your time will go into turning information into decisions. You’ll prepare the management reports, dashboards and materials that committees and senior leadership use to steer the business. You’ll also run ad hoc analyses whenever a strategic question comes up, from market sizing and benchmarks to business cases for new initiatives. Working closely with the Head of Strategy, you’ll help shape executive presentations that are clear, well-grounded and ready to support key decisions.

**Strategic initiative tracking (c. 50%)**  
The other half is about making sure strategy actually happens. You’ll manage the portfolio of strategic initiatives as you would a project, keeping a clear view of owners, milestones, KPIs, risks and status. You’ll meet regularly with directors and initiative owners, not just to collect updates but to ask the right questions: what is being done and why, what impact it is having, and what is holding progress back. When something goes off track, you’ll raise it with the Head of Strategy and the CEO Office, always bringing a proposal on how to get it back on course.

**A quién buscamos**
--------------------

You have 2–4 years of experience, ideally in strategy consulting, working on strategy, transformation or operations projects. You hold a degree in Engineering, Business Administration or a similar field, and your English is strong. A master’s degree is a plus, but not a requirement.

You’re highly analytical. You work comfortably with advanced Excel and build executive-level PowerPoint presentations, and experience with Power BI or an equivalent tool is highly valued. You know how to synthesise complex information and turn it into a clear, compelling storyline.

You’re also well organised. You track milestones rigorously and can manage several workstreams at once without losing sight of priorities.

Above all, you have the presence and confidence to challenge directors without creating friction. You’re results-oriented, proactive, and you don’t wait for problems to escalate before acting on them.

**Qué ofrecemos**
-----------------

* The opportunity to join an international team working on high-impact, technically demanding projects within the airport mobility sector.
* Hybrid working model: on-site in Mieres (Asturias) with partial remote work.
* Professional development within a specialized, expanding technical environment, as part of the TK Elevator group.
* Terms and conditions to be discussed based on candidate profile.

title: Global Medical Training Specialist
description:
**Location** Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain **Job ID** R-262841 **Date posted** 26/10/2026

  

**This is what you will do:**

Alexion operates as a matrix organisation committed to serving patients with rare diseases. The **Global Medical Training Specialist**, within the **Global Medical Training and Field Capabilities** organisation, will support the design, delivery and execution of high-quality learning and development initiatives for global and local medical teams. Working with therapeutic area and functional partners, you will translate learning needs into practical, engaging and compliant training solutions, coordinate delivery and continuously improve learner impact. Digital tools, including AI, will be used as a workbench to accelerate content development, strengthen learning design and improve efficiency, while business needs, learner experience and training quality remain the primary focus.

**You will be responsible for the following:**

* **Learning needs and planning:** Partner with therapeutic area and functional stakeholders to identify learning needs, clarify outcomes and build practical delivery plans aligned with medical priorities.

* **Learning design:** Design engaging, audience-appropriate learning experiences and materials using adult learning and instructional design principles across live, virtual and self-directed formats.

* **Delivery and facilitation:** Coordinate and deliver high-quality training sessions, workshops and learning programmes, including facilitator preparation, learner communications and delivery logistics.

* **Programme execution:** Manage assigned initiatives from brief through implementation, ensuring clear milestones, stakeholder alignment, compliant review, timely delivery and effective use of resources.

* **Launch readiness:** Support the development and execution of launch learning plans that build the knowledge, skills and confidence required by medical teams.

* **Quality and compliance:** Maintain high standards for scientific accuracy, learner experience, accessibility and compliance, identifying and resolving quality issues with relevant stakeholders.

* **Measurement and improvement:** Gather learner feedback and use available data to assess participation, effectiveness and opportunities to improve future learning interventions.

* **AI-enabled workbench:** Use approved AI and digital tools to support research, drafting, content adaptation, quality checks and learner personalisation, applying appropriate human oversight and company standards.

* **Therapeutic area focus:** Work within a specific therapeutic area under the guidance of the relevant Global Medical Director, while sharing approaches and learning across the wider medical training team to strengthen consistency and scale.

**You may be required to support the following tasks:**

* **Learning communications:** Develop clear, audience-focused communications that build awareness, readiness and participation in learning initiatives.

* **Learning platforms and resources:** Support the organisation, publication and maintenance of learning resources across approved platforms, ensuring materials remain current and easy to access.

* **Vendor and stakeholder coordination:** Coordinate inputs, timelines and deliverables with internal partners and external vendors to support efficient programme execution.

* **Training data and reporting:** Maintain accurate programme records and prepare concise updates on delivery status, participation, feedback and agreed measures of impact.

**You will need to have the following:**

* Bachelor’s degree and/or tertiary qualification in clinical science, education, learning and development or a related field.

* Minimum 12 months’ experience supporting the design, delivery or coordination of learning and development initiatives, preferably within the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.

* Understanding of adult learning principles and the ability to translate learning objectives into practical, engaging training experiences.

* Strong organisation and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables, stakeholders and timelines.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence working across diverse global and cross-functional teams.

* Comfort using digital learning tools and approved AI applications as part of day-to-day training design, development and delivery.

* Commitment to quality, accuracy, compliance and continuous improvement.

**We would prefer for you to have the following:**

* Experience supporting medical, scientific or launch learning programmes in a global matrix organisation.

* Experience with instructional design, facilitation, virtual learning or learning management systems.

* Practical experience using AI tools to improve the speed, quality or personalisation of learning content and workflows.

* Fluency in one or more additional languages to support global training initiatives.

description:
**Who are we**

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

### **About the Team**

We are looking for a **Senior Account Manager to join our EMEA team**, which focuses on strengthening relationships with existing customers and driving sustainable revenue growth through retention, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.

In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. This includes protecting customer retention, supporting successful renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from Lokalise over time.

You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers. You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise's capabilities to their business objectives, localisation workflows, and international growth plans.

You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. You will be measured primarily on **account expansion through upselling, cross-selling, and broader customer adoption and gross revenue retention across your portfolio** .

  

### **What You Will Do**

* **Own account commercial outcomes:** Take responsibility for the full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.
* **Protect retention and renewal outcomes:** Monitor account health, customer engagement, product value, and commercial risks to identify potential retention challenges early and coordinate effective action with internal teams.
* **Drive account expansion:** Identify and execute upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities, leading commercial conversations and negotiations with a focus on achieving and surpassing sales quotas.
* **Develop account strategies:** Create and maintain clear account plans based on customer goals, stakeholder priorities, product adoption, business risks, renewal plans, and opportunities for broader collaboration.
* **Lead consultative customer conversations:** Advise customers on how to improve their localisation and content workflows, connect their needs to Lokalise's solutions, and articulate clear business value and return on investment.
* **Navigate complex enterprise sales processes:** Coordinate multi-stakeholder opportunities, procurement activity, contract negotiations, and legal discussions, ensuring progress toward successful commercial outcomes.
* **Partner cross-functionally and maintain accurate reporting:** Work closely with Customer Success and Solutions Architecture to support retention and expansion, collaborate with Product, Finance, and Legal to resolve customer needs, and maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, pipeline updates, and forecasts.
* **Use AI to elevate your work:** Proactively explore and apply AI tools and approaches to improve customer research, account planning, decision-making, productivity, and go-to-market impact.

  

### **What You Must Have**

* **Full account lifecycle ownership:** +5 years of experience owning the commercial lifecycle of strategic or enterprise customer accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling in a B2B SaaS environment.
* **Proven commercial outcomes:** A track record of protecting customer revenue, achieving gross revenue retention or comparable retention targets, and generating measurable account expansion.
* Ability to understand complex SaaS products, with **experience selling to business, marketing, and sales stakeholders**, and translating product capabilities into clear commercial value.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a remote, international organisation.
* Experience engaging and influencing C-level and senior stakeholders, including the ability to lead strategic conversations and align solutions with business priorities.
* Strong commercial skills, including experience identifying growth opportunities, negotiating contracts, and navigating complex procurement or legal discussions.
Competency using AI tools to accelerate customer research, synthesis, account planning, and decision-making, with a proactive mindset toward adopting new AI-enabled ways of working.  

### **It's a Plus If You Have**

* Experience engaging technical stakeholders (e.g., IT, engineering, product) in addition to business buyers.
* Experience selling localisation, translation management, or other workflow software.
* Experience working with procurement processes such as RFPs, security reviews, or complex enterprise buying committees.
* Familiarity with structured sales methodologies or account planning frameworks.

  

### **Our Benefits**

Competitive salary and employee stock options.

Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.

Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office.

Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.

️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.

Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.

Health insurance to keep you covered.

Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.

Great startup culture: remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.
