title: Head of YouTube (Strategy, Scripting & Team Lead)
description:
We're hiring a **Head of YouTube** to lead Richard Yu's channels and creative team. Richard teaches people how to build businesses selling digital and physical products through "AI Arbitrage"

### **✅ The challenge**

Our immediate goal is to grow the business channel from ~90,000 to 200,000+ subscribers in six months and bring average views per video above 100,000. These are aggressive goals. We want someone excited by that challenge, with a clear approach to choosing what to make, testing ideas and getting good videos out consistently.

You'll grow the top of the funnel by reaching new viewers who fit our audience. You'll also plan content for viewers who are getting to know Richard, learning about our offers and deciding whether to buy. Ultimately, we want this channel to grow the business, so views and subscribers need to translate into an audience we can serve.

You'll be responsible for what we make, why we make it, how we package and produce it, and whether it worked. You'll work directly with Richard and the leadership team to set direction, goals and KPI's and lead, hire and manage a creative team underneath.

**This is a senior creative strategist and operator role**.
  
  
You will write first-person, long-form scripts yourself, as well as review and improve other writers' work. You should be equally comfortable setting channel direction, giving specific feedback and getting videos published.

### **✅ What you'll own**

* **Strategy and ideation:** own the channel's growth goals, metrics and KPIs. Turn them into a clear plan for topics, formats and ideas, based on what our audience cares about and what we can learn from videos that perform well above their channel's usual results. Plan videos that bring in new viewers, build trust and help the right people take the next step.
* **Testing and learning:** build structured tests with a clear hypothesis, a useful comparison and defined success measures. Decide which tests are worth running, make sense of the results and apply what you learn to the next videos.
* **Packaging:** titles, thumbnail concepts and briefs, A/B tests, and repackaging decisions informed by CTR, retention and traffic sources.
* **Scripting:** write full scripts when needed, and edit and quality-check every script before Richard films it. Build strong hooks, story structure, pacing, curiosity and payoffs that keep people watching. Deliver the title's promise in a natural voice, with concrete examples and verified claims.
* **Production:** give editors specific feedback from the first cut, set clear standards and make sure each video meets them.
* **Analytics:** review what worked, what didn't and what to change next. Track subscriber growth, views and audience quality alongside the channel's contribution to leads and sales, working with the wider marketing team. Be clear about which results we can attribute to YouTube and where we’re still making assumptions.
* **Team:** hire, onboard and manage editors, designers and writers. Coach people to improve and write procedures and checklists that help the team make good decisions independently.

### **✅ Who will do well here**

You have a deep passion for YouTube (storytelling and psychology), and an understanding of channel growth. You can explain why a topic, format, title, thumbnail or script works: what earns the click, what keeps someone watching and what makes them return. You can turn that understanding into work that performs.

You are excited about taking on ambitious goals and being responsible for the results. You track progress honestly, work out what's holding us back and come with ideas for fixing it. You learn quickly, ask for feedback and change your approach when the evidence calls for it.

Strong business judgment, an understanding of marketing funnels and experience in Infopreneurship, online education or Edutech are major advantages. We’ll weigh that experience heavily. We’ll also consider an exceptional YouTube leader who can learn our audience, offers and funnel quickly.

This is a full-time role for someone who wants to focus on one business and take responsibility for both the creative work and the team.

### **✅ Hiring process**

Application, Zoom call, paid test project, final interview, offer. For your application, share existing work you are allowed to share; no new script or channel audit is required at this stage.

### **✅ How to apply**

Review Richard’s business YouTube channel and browse the other channels/accounts linked there for context.
  
  
**IMPORTANT TO BE CONSIDERED YOU MUST SHARE A 3–5 MINUTE LOOM/VIDEO COVERING:**

**1. Your background and motivation:** Briefly introduce yourself, your role on the YouTube channels you’ve worked on and the results you’re most proud of. What excites you about this opportunity, and why do you want this particular role working with Richard Yu?

**2. Your growth philosophy:** How do you approach growing a business YouTube channel like ours? Which metrics matter most, and why?

**3. Your read on our channel and your first 30 days:** What are we doing well, and what most needs to improve to reach 200k+ subscribers in six months and average over 100k views per video? Briefly explain your reasoning and what you would focus on in your first 30 days. Tell us what you can judge from the public channel and what you’d need to learn from our analytics or team. One or two meaningful observations are enough.

**4. Your leadership:** What creative teams have you led? Share one brief example of a difficult leadership decision, how you handled it and what happened.

Keep it conversational and focus on what matters most. You don’t need slides, a detailed audit or a strategy deck. We want to understand you, your judgment and how you work. Please check that your Loom link is accessible.

 **Requirements**  

* + - * + - * + Deep passion for YouTube and demonstrated understanding of storytelling and channel growth. Show us published long-form work and explain what you contributed.
              + Strong creative judgment across topics, formats, ideation, titles and thumbnails. You can explain why people click, keep watching and return.
              + Deep understanding of a winning script: hooks, narrative structure, pacing, curiosity, clear explanations and satisfying payoffs. Ability and willingness to write complete first-person, talking-head scripts and improve another writer's work.
              + A structured approach to testing: clear hypotheses, useful comparisons, defined success measures and sound interpretation of results.
              + Ownership of goals, metrics and KPIs. Strong command of CTR, average view duration, retention graphs, traffic sources and channel growth metrics, with examples of how you used them to make decisions.
              + Experience managing editors and/or designers, setting clear standards, giving specific feedback and helping people improve.
              + You learn quickly, ask good questions and take direct feedback well. You can get up to speed on a new audience, subject and business model.
              + Strong business judgment and experience with marketing funnels, infopreneurship, online education or edusoftware are highly valued. A record of connecting content to leads or sales is a strong advantage. These are not prerequisites for an exceptional YouTube candidate who can learn this side quickly.
              + Fluent spoken and written English is essential. You must be able to write natural, compelling English scripts and communicate clearly with Richard and the team.
              + Confidence using without over-reliance on AI tools, particularly Claude/Codex. You still take responsibility for the voice, accuracy and claims in the finished work.
              + Full-time availability and at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern working hours.
              + Remote: we welcome candidates across the United States, Canada, the UK, Europe, Mexico, Central America and South America, including Spain, Portugal, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Brazil, Panama, Colombia, Argentina and Costa Rica. Exceptional candidates elsewhere are also welcome. What matters is strong YouTube judgment, fluent English and reliable overlap with US Eastern working hours.

  
**Benefits**  

* + **A meaningful challenge.** Help grow a brand with audacious goals, including taking our business channel to 200k+ subscribers in six months and averaging over 100k views per video. Your work will directly shape how we reach people, earn their trust and grow the business.
  + **Real ownership and influence.** We value input from everyone, and few things are off-limits to thoughtful questioning. Bring your perspective, question assumptions and propose better approaches. We listen to good reasoning and are willing to change direction when the evidence supports it. Your ideas and what you learn through testing can influence the broader business.
  + **A team invested in your growth.** We want this to be one of the biggest personal and professional growth experiences of your life. You’ll work directly with Richard and the rest of the leadership team, get honest feedback and take on challenges that stretch your thinking, creative judgment and leadership. We set high standards, and we’re here to help you reach them.
  + **$75,000–$150,000 USD annually plus performance bonuses for exceptional results, in a fully remote, full-time role with reliable overlap with US Eastern working hours.**

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
description:
Terra’s Creative team is a tight-knit, collaborative group that thrives on solving diverse creative problems for our clients. title: Senior Amazon Content Strategist
description:
**About Us**  
Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms.

Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.  
As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.

The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C.

The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption.

A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms.

The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility.

**Tasks**
---------

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Content Audits & Quality Assessment**  

* Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short.
* Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements.
* Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy.

**Content Strategy Development**  

* Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus.
* Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour.
* Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category.
* Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on.
* Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction.

**AI & Agentic Discoverability**  

* AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search.
* Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations.
* Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery.

**Testing & Performance Monitoring**  

* A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent.
* Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation.
* Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy.

**Creative Briefing & Review**  

* Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and

marketplace advertising content.  

* Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction.
* Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery.

**Client Management**  

* Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders.
* Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams.
* Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements.
* Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice.
* Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business.

**Quality & Output Review**  

* Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements.
* Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy.

**AI-Enabled Working**  

* AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy.
* Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team.

**Requirements**
----------------

**What You Bring to the Role**

* Proven experience in Amazon content strategy and execution (listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store, Amazon Posts), ideally within an agency or managed services environment.

* Working knowledge of content requirements across at least one other marketplace or major retailer platform (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C.

* Experience running content audits — analysing reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries and customer/AI-agent queries — and scoring content quality (e.g. IDQ or equivalent) against best-in-Class standards.

* Experience translating audit findings into content strategy: comms objectives, key messaging, messaging hierarchy, and content requirements for imagery and copy.

* Experience developing or briefing A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups, working closely with designers.

* Experience designing and running A/B tests to determine the most effective executional approach, and setting up performance monitoring (e.g. Amazon Compass or equivalent) to track results.

* Strong understanding of how AI assistants and platform shopping agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Rufus)surface and rank product content, and how content should be structured to support this.

* Confident, credible client-facing communicator — comfortable presenting strategy, leading feedback conversations, and owning estimates and proposals.

* Experience briefing creative teams for paid social/display advertising, across both static and video formats.

* Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools for research, auditing and content production, not just familiarity in principle.

* Strong copywriting and content editing skills, with a close eye for brand and platform compliance.

* Comfortable reviewing and giving constructive feedback on the work of SEO and design peers.

**Desirable**

* Experience across multiple international marketplaces or retail media platforms.

* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, to collaborate effectively with the SEO Executive.

* Experience contributing to new business pitches or proposals.

* Category experience relevant to Luzern's enterprise brand client base.

**Benefits**
------------

**What We Offer**  

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Hybrid Working Model
* Great working environment with a passionate, collaborative team
* Continuous learning & career development
* The opportunity to work with some of the world's leading brands across the most exciting marketplaces

We are committed to equal opportunities and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

* **The Agile Boutique Studio:** Best for autonomous, execution-focused strategists who love working closely with founders and driving rapid list growth for 7-figure brands.

This is a strategic, hands-on role for someone who understands how to turn customer and performance data into actions that improve revenue, retention, engagement, and customer lifetime value.

Depending on the client, your scope may include email and SMS marketing, lifecycle automation, retention strategy, subscription growth, customer journeys, experimentation, and cross-functional team leadership.

Key responsibilities

* Own lifecycle and retention strategy across email, SMS, subscription, and other customer touchpoints based on business needs.
* Analyze customer, campaign, retention, and revenue data to identify opportunities and determine what should be tested or optimized.
* Develop and execute experiments around offers, messaging, segmentation, customer journeys, subscription conversion, retention, and lifecycle engagement.
* Build and optimize lifecycle programs, including campaigns, automated flows, onboarding, post-purchase, winback, cancellation/save journeys, and other retention initiatives.
* Translate data and customer behavior into clear strategic recommendations and actionable plans.
* Own performance against key business outcomes such as revenue, retention, customer lifetime value, subscription take rate, churn, or lifecycle program performance.
* Work directly with clients, founders, or senior stakeholders to present performance, recommendations, and strategic priorities.
* Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams including copywriters, designers, project managers, developers, and other marketing specialists.
* Provide clear briefs, direction, feedback, and quality control to ensure execution aligns with strategy and brand requirements.
* Troubleshoot lifecycle marketing, CRM, subscription, or customer journey issues and provide practical solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, systems, and workflows, including the use of AI and automation where appropriate.
* Monitor account/customer health and proactively identify risks, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Help build scalable playbooks, processes, and best practices that improve lifecycle and retention performance across the business.

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, retention marketing, CRM, growth marketing, email/SMS marketing, subscription growth, or a closely related field.
* Strong understanding of DTC/ecommerce, consumer, subscription, or digital businesses and how customer retention contributes to revenue and profitability.
* Proven experience using data to make strategic marketing or growth decisions rather than simply executing predefined campaigns.
* Strong experience with lifecycle marketing platforms such as Klaviyo or comparable CRM/marketing automation tools.
* Hands-on understanding of customer segmentation, automated journeys/flows, retention programs, experimentation, and performance optimization.
* Experience owning measurable business outcomes such as revenue, retention, churn, LTV, conversion, subscription growth, or lifecycle performance.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate performance data into clear recommendations and next actions.
* Comfortable working directly with clients, founders, CMOs, or senior stakeholders and communicating recommendations with confidence.
* Strong project ownership and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail.
* Able to work cross-functionally and direct or collaborate with creative, project management, development, and marketing teams.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills suitable for client-facing work.
* Self-directed, commercially minded, proactive, and comfortable operating in fast-moving environments.
* Strong attention to detail and ownership mentality; you check your own work and take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve marketing workflows, analysis, content development, or operational efficiency is a plus.

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive USD compensation based on experience and client requirements.
* Remote flexibility – work from anywhere while collaborating with international teams.
* Opportunities to work with international companies across ecommerce, DTC, subscription, and digital businesses.
* High-ownership roles with exposure to strategy, experimentation, and business growth.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**What we're building**
=======================

We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer — providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams.

**Why join Shadow?**
====================

* **Product Ownership** You'll ship production code daily and help steer key product and technical decisions.
* **Shape the Engineering Culture** You'll influence how we work—tools, processes, standards, and hiring.
* **Work with Challenger Consumer Brands** Talk directly to customers (CEOs, CMOs, VP's) of fast-growing consumer brands—some doing $80M–$500M in revenue.

**The agency behind the product**
=================================

Shadow is built alongside Darkroom — a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the data you build with is real marketing data at real volume from day one — not a synthetic demo.

**This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).**

**The role**
============

You’ll own features end-to-end at Shadow, from the first conversation with a user to the polished screen in production. You’ll design in Figma and in code, and ship it yourself.  
You’ll work forward-deployed. You’ll sit with the subject-matter experts who use Shadow every day, like media buyers, strategists and creatives, to learn how they actually work and where they get stuck. Then you’ll turn what you learn into features that fix it.  
You’ll also keep Shadow feeling like one product. As new features land, you’ll make sure every screen, from dashboards to agent conversations, follows the same system and meets the same bar.

**Core Tech & Tools**

* **Languages & Frameworks:** Python, Node.js, React (TypeScript)
* **Datastore:** PostgreSQL
* **Cloud & Infra:** Google Cloud Platform, Airflow, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes
* **ML/AI:** LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering

**What you'll do**
==================

* Own features end-to-end: find the problem, shape the solution, then design, build and ship it.
* Embed with subject-matter experts to learn their workflows and challenges firsthand.
* Turn what you learn into product: agent conversations, performance and creative dashboards, the marketing calendar, and whatever comes next.
* Own UI/UX consistency across the whole app. Keep the design system current in Figma and React, and hold every new screen to it.
* Sweat the details, including type, spacing, motion, loading and empty states.
* Prototype fast, in code, in Figma or with AI tools, and put ideas in front of experts within days.
* Invent interaction patterns for agentic work. That means streaming answers, showing the agent’s reasoning, approving changes before they touch a live ad account, and admitting when data is missing.
* Turn dense, multi-channel data into screens a marketer can read in seconds.
* Bring the new Shadow brand into the product, working with our brand partners.

**Must haves**
==============

* Shipped product UI you’re proud of, plus a portfolio or live work that shows both the design and the code.
* Strong React, TypeScript and CSS (Tailwind a plus). You can own a frontend codebase, not just individual components.
* Real visual and interaction design skill: typography, layout, color, motion and micro-interactions.
* Curiosity about how other people work. You can spend a day with a media buyer and come back with the real problem, not just a feature request.
* A systems mindset. You notice when two screens solve the same problem differently, and you fix it.
* Equal comfort in Figma and in your editor, and the judgment to know when to skip Figma.
* Taste for data-dense interfaces. Your dashboards, tables and charts stay calm under a lot of information.
* Daily use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, with opinions on how AI products should feel.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You’d rather ship and learn than polish in private.
* Clear writing. You can explain the why behind a design to engineers, experts and non-designers.
* Most people who fit this have 5+ years across design and some experience with frontend engineering.

**Nice to haves**
=================

* Forward-deployed, solutions or customer-facing work, or research with expert users.
* You’ve built a design system that other engineers rely on.
* Data visualization work in D3, Visx, Recharts or hand-rolled SVG.
* Motion work, such as spring animation or Framer Motion.
* Experience with LLM APIs, streaming interfaces or agent products.
* Time spent around marketing, ecommerce or analytics tools, or running ads yourself.

**What we offer**
=================

* **Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every employee exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------

We are an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Marketing Manager - Global
description:
**About Hub OS**

Hub OS is transforming how hotels operate. We're not just another communication tool. We're a complete operations system that manages everything from housekeeping and maintenance to guest requests and interdepartmental workflows, all in one platform.

Since 2015, we've helped 2,000 properties across 80 countries deliver great guest experiences with maximum efficiency. Our clients include iconic brands like Accor, IHG, Minor Hotels, Hesperia World and Eurostars Hotels, among others.

With headquarters near Barcelona and teams in the US, Australia, Japan, Singapore, Thailand and UAE, we're a truly global company with a collaborative culture.

Ready to shape the future of hotel operations? Join us!

**About the role**

Marketing is one of the best ways for us to grow, and we want to build it the right way. That's why we're looking for a Marketing Manager. Reporting to the VP of Growth, you'll own marketing end to end: strategy, brand, demand generation, content, customer stories, sales materials and events.

Our goal is simple. We want more hotels to know us, trust us and ask for a demo. You'll be responsible for building our brand and our visibility, turning that into inbound leads, and giving our Sales team the stories and materials that help them close deals faster.

This is a hands-on role. You'll define the strategy, and you'll also create, publish and measure the work yourself, using AI tools to move fast. You'll be our first dedicated marketing lead with a global scope, with a clear path to lead a team as the company grows.

You'll play a critical role in shaping how the hotel industry sees Hub OS.

**Your mission:**

Marketing Strategy & Brand

* Define and own the annual marketing plan, with clear goals, budget and calendar
* Define our ideal customer profiles, value proposition and positioning against competitors
* Build key messages for each type of customer and market
* Define our narrative style and tone of voice across all channels
* Own the brand guidelines and templates, so the whole company communicates in a consistent way
* Decide what we do in English and what we adapt to other languages and markets
* Follow what our competitors say and do, and share it with Sales and Product

Demand Generation & Visibility

* Own our website: landing pages, the path to "Book a demo" and continuous conversion improvement
* Lead our SEO strategy and our visibility in AI tools, so we are found and recommended when buyers search
* Own our presence on review and reputation sites such as HotelTechReport, G2 and Trustpilot, including a steady flow of new customer reviews
* Lead our LinkedIn strategy and company page
* Run email marketing and nurturing for leads who are not ready to buy yet
* Use paid channels in a focused way when they help amplify what already works
* Plan co-marketing activities with our technology and referral partners
* Organize our own webinars and online events when they make sense

Content Creation

* Create and run our blog, with a clear editorial line and a regular publishing rhythm
* Write white papers, guides and thought leadership content
* Create LinkedIn posts that get attention and move readers to act
* Produce our quarterly newsletter: product news, new features, partner and integration updates, spotlights on lesser-used modules and hotelier interviews
* Make sure every piece of content has a clear goal and a clear next step for the reader

Customer Stories & Sales Enablement

* Lead our customer success stories from start to finish: choose the hotel with Sales and Customer teams, contact the hotelier, run the interview, collect the data and write and design the story
* Collect testimonials and video quotes from happy customers
* Create and keep up to date the materials Sales uses in demos, events and meetings, such as decks, one-pagers and product sheets
* Work with Sales to understand what helps them win deals and shorten the sales cycle

Product Content & Adoption

* Review, edit and publish content for our Help Center, which is hosted in HubSpot. The Quality team owns the accuracy of the content, and you own the quality of the writing and the publishing
* Create content that explains the benefits of each module and feature, and how to set them up
* Produce product videos, including editing and AI voice-over
* Create campaigns and materials that help customers adopt modules they do not use yet, supporting upsell

Events & Trade Shows

* Be the owner of our trade shows and events from a marketing point of view, including the results
* Manage the relationship with event organizers: registration, event portal content and sponsorship options
* Own the stand design, merchandising, team outfits, catering needs and event materials
* Prepare pre-event meetings and outreach with the Sales team
* Measure the ROI of every event and recommend if we should continue or not
* Work closely with the Partnerships & Events Manager, who leads the production and logistics of each event

Data, HubSpot & Reporting

* Own the marketing setup in HubSpot: forms, workflows, email, lists, dashboards and attribution
* Define with Sales and RevOps what a qualified lead is, how leads are scored and how they are handed over
* Track and report on awareness (traffic, brand searches, LinkedIn growth, AI visibility), lead generation (inbound leads, demo requests, conversion by channel) and sales impact (content usage, customer stories, reviews, sales cycle)
* Find where visitors and leads drop off, and use data to decide what to do next
* Share clear reports with leadership: what works, what does not and what to change

Budget, Vendors & Tools

* Manage the marketing budget
* Choose and manage freelancers and agencies for specific projects, only when the impact is clear
* Own our marketing tools and AI stack, and keep looking for better ways to work

Cross-functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Quality, Product, RevOps and Partnerships & Events
* Align with regional teams across different time zones

**Required qualifications:**

* Proven experience in B2B marketing, ideally in SaaS or hospitality tech
* Experience building and running demand generation, from strategy to results
* Excellent writing skills in English, with the ability to create content that is clear, interesting and persuasive
* Hands-on experience with SEO and website optimization
* Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM and marketing automation tool
* Analytical mindset: comfortable with data, KPIs, attribution and reporting
* Daily use of AI tools for content, design, video and productivity
* Experience with LinkedIn as a B2B channel
* Basic design skills to create presentations, one-pagers and visuals with tools like Canva or Figma
* Experience with trade shows or events is a strong plus
* Fluent in English (written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus
* Organized and able to manage many projects at once

**You'll thrive in this role if you…**

* Are ambitious and see this role as a big step in your career
* Enjoy being both the strategist and the one who gets things done
* Love telling a good story and turning it into real business results
* Make decisions with data, and are not afraid to test, learn and change direction
* Are curious about new tools and always looking for smarter ways to work with AI
* Enjoy talking to customers and learning what makes them successful
* Are proactive and take action without waiting to be asked
* Enjoy collaborating across teams, regions and time zones
* Value autonomy and ownership, and enjoy the freedom to prioritize
* Would like to grow into a leadership role and build a team in the future

**What's waiting for you?**

Impact & Growth

* Join a market leader that's growing globally
* Build our marketing function from the start, with real ownership
* Work on projects that directly affect company growth
* A clear path to lead a marketing team as the company grows

Flexibility & Balance

* Flexible working hours that respect your personal life
* Choose your work style: office-based, hybrid, or fully remote
* A company culture that genuinely values work-life balance and well-being

Team & Culture

* Collaborate with a fun, cohesive, and diverse team
* Annual company offsite and team-building activities
* Work with talented professionals across multiple countries and time zones
* A supportive environment where ideas are heard and innovation is encouraged

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive salary aligned with your experience, responsibilities and market standards
* Performance-based incentive plan tied to company and individual success
* Professional development plan

Our Commitment

* We're an ethical company that guarantees equal opportunities for everyone
* We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees
* We believe different perspectives make us stronger and innovation thrives in inclusive teams

Sueldo: 30.000,00€-45.000,00€ al año

Beneficios:

title: Senior Talent Acquisition
description:
**Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 3,000 consultants and experts across 30 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence.

AI does not replace people; it elevates us to where no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will develop more than skills—you will cultivate judgment. Your expertise will deepen with every system you architect, client challenge you solve, and deployment that builds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates.

**What You'll Architect**

You will join Intake, Keyrus' international Talent Acquisition team: a cross-border team that advises Keyrus entities worldwide, combining market intelligence with strategic recruitment to help leaders make smarter, data-driven hiring decisions. In this role, you combine advisory and sourcing skills, using AI-enabled tools and talent data to find, assess and attract the people who build intelligent systems for our clients.

* Partner with Managing Directors and senior stakeholders across Keyrus entities, turning business plans into clear hiring strategies backed by real market data

* Source, engage and attract top talent in Data, AI and Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), with a primary focus on the French market and support for other EMEA markets when needed

* Recruit the profiles that power intelligent systems: AI and ML engineers, data engineers, data scientists, data architects and AI consultants

* Use AI-enabled sourcing and talent intelligence tools (e.g. LinkedIn Recruiter and Talent Insights, AI sourcing platforms, ATS automation) to identify and reach the right talent faster and more precisely

* Combine these tools with advanced human sourcing methods: headhunting, X-ray and Boolean search, growth hacking and deep networking

* Produce talent market insights on skills availability, salary trends, and competitor activity to guide where and how Keyrus hires

* Build and maintain talent pools in our core technologies, so entities can staff new client projects quickly

* Lead and deliver recruitment projects, managing the full recruitment cycle from intake to offer

* Run competency-based interviews that assess both technical depth in data and AI and consulting skills, with human judgment at the heart of every hiring decision

* Strengthening the Keyrus employer brand with data and AI communities through content, networking and community engagement

* Share your expertise in AI-enabled recruitment and help grow TA capabilities across the group

**Who You Are**

* You think beyond filling roles: you understand what the business is trying to achieve and recruit with that in mind

* You are a trusted advisor to senior leaders, confident enough to challenge a brief with data and propose alternatives

* You are fluent in the language of data and AI, and understand the roles you recruit for well enough to have credible conversations with engineers and consultants

* You use technology to work smarter, and you know where automation adds value and where a human conversation makes the difference

* You thrive in a cross-border team, working remotely across countries, cultures and markets

* You build genuine, long-term relationships with candidates and stakeholders

* You keep improving how we recruit, and share what works with the wider team

**What You Bring**

Qualifications/Certifications

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Business, **Psychology,** or a related field, or equivalent by experience

* 5+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally with a headhunting background

Technical Skills

* Proven success sourcing and hiring technical profiles in Data, AI, and Digital

* Experience recruiting for the French market

* Advanced sourcing skills: headhunting, Boolean / X-ray search, LinkedIn Recruiter

* Hands-on use of AI-enabled recruitment and talent intelligence tools in your daily work

* Fluent English and French (written and spoken)

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience recruiting in other EMEA markets

* Any additional language (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch)

* Background in Resource Management (in-house, MSP or RPO), ideally with nearshore/offshore recruitment experience

* Experience recruiting EPM profiles

* Experience with recruitment analytics and reporting dashboards

* Experience recruiting for consulting firms or professional services

**What Makes You Successful**

* Clear, persuasive communication with candidates and senior stakeholders across cultures

* The ability to influence hiring decisions with market data and a well-argued point of view

* Commercial awareness: you understand how a consulting business runs and why the right hire at the right time matters

* The judgment to combine AI-driven efficiency with personal, high-quality candidate experience

* High energy, curiosity and the drive to keep raising the bar on how Keyrus recruits

**Rewards – What We Offer at Keyrus**

* A full-time contract

* Benefits and package depending on your location

* A team that supports and guides you from day one

* Plenty of challenges and opportunities to keep developing your skills

* An environment built on trust, openness and collaboration

**What We Stand For**

* Collective Intelligence — Collaboration across expertise, functions, and geographies makes it possible to combine know-how and deliver more comprehensive responses to client challenges.

* Reliability — The ability to deliver complex projects with rigour is one of the pillars of our client relationship.

* Pragmatism — Prioritising concrete impact and measurable value over abstract technological discourse.

* Entrepreneurial Spirit — Curiosity, energy, and freedom are the foundations of our culture; they enable initiative and sustained innovation.

**Our Hiring Process**

We keep our process clear and respectful of your time:

* Interview with the Intake Manager: a deep dive into your recruitment experience, sourcing approach, and use of AI and data in your work

* Initial conversation with the Intake team: to get to know you, your motivations, and tell you more about us

* Practical exercise: you walk us through your sourcing and market-mapping strategy for a Data & AI role

* Final conversation with Intake leadership

**ABOUT KEYRUS**

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental AI to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. This is the discipline we call being an Architect of Intelligence. Designing the Operating System of an intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence.

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated Model (HOM), we architect reliable:

* Intelligence Foundations,

* Human in Command governance,

* and Performance Steering,

To create intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capabilities and performance compounds over time.

With 30+ years of expertise and 3,000 employees across 30 countries, we help organizations go beyond transformation: to build adaptive, resilient, and continuously improving intelligent organizations.

AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

Keyrus is listed on Euronext Growth Paris. (ALKEY – ISIN Code: FR0004029411 – Reuters: KEYR.PA – Bloomberg: ALKEY: FP).

title: Personal Assistant to the Director of Policy, Development and Advocacy (PDA)
description:
The Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal) is a cutting-edge institute addressing global public health challenges through research, translation into policy and education. ISGlobal has a broad portfolio in communicable and non-communicable diseases including environmental and climate determinants, and applies a multidisciplinary scientific approach ranging from the molecular to the population level. Research is organized in five programs: Climate, Air Pollution, Nature and Urban Health; Environment and Health over the Lifecourse; Global Viral and Bacterial Infections; Malaria and Neglected Parasitic Diseases and Maternal Child and Reproductive Health. ISGlobal is accredited with the Severo Ochoa distinction, a seal of excellence of the Spanish Science Ministry.

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

ISGlobal is seeking a motivated Personal Assistant to provide administrative and secretarial support to the Director of the Policy, Development and Advocacy (PDA) Department. The position will play a key role in managing the Director’s agenda, correspondence, travel and events, ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the Director’s activities.

The Personal Assistant will report to the Director of PDA and work in close coordination with the Head of Director’s Office, contributing to the effective functioning of the Area and to clear, timely communication with ISGlobal’s departments and external partners.

In parallel, this person will contribute to the organization of the PDA team’s internal events, coordination meetings and retreats, and to the logistics of high-level visits and external events.

### **MAIN DUTIES**

* Provide day-to-day secretarial and administrative support to the Director of PDA.
* Manage the Director’s agenda and the scheduling of meetings, appointments, calls and videoconferences, and monitor the Director’s email and calls, flagging urgent matters.
* Prepare and circulate meeting agendas, supporting documents and minutes, and follow up on agreed actions and deadlines.
* Draft, proofread and format correspondence, briefing notes, presentations and reports in English, Spanish and Catalan.
* Plan and organise the Director’s national and international travel, including visas and invitation letters, and prepare travel reports and expense justifications for the Accounting Department.
* Support the organisation of internal events (coordination meetings, retreats) and of external events and high-level visits, including logistics and communications to participants.
* Provide administrative support in the management of purchases, supplies and service requests for the PDA team, as well as in procedures for new staff, interns and visitors, keeping documents and files organised and confidential.
* Support the development of processes and templates for the Director’s Office, and perform other tasks as requested by the Director of PDA.

**AUXILIAR TASKS**

This job description reflects the present requirements of the post but may evolve at any time in the future as duties and responsibilities change and/or develop providing there is appropriate consultation with the post-holder.

This job description is not a definitive or exhaustive list of responsibilities but identifies the key responsibilities and tasks of the post holder. The specific objectives of the post holder will be subject to review as part of the individual professional assessment process.

### **SKILLS**

* Time management and ability to meet deadlines under pressure.
* Discretion, confidentiality and professionalism.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Must have self-motivation, eagerness to grow professionally and commitment to self-development.
* Clear written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills at all levels.
* Teamwork and collaboration.
* Proactivity and autonomy.
* Attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

description:

### **What You'll Do**

* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Enablement, Strategy, and Marketing teams to ensure optimal orchestration and execution of global marketing programs
* Build and maintain a complete and accurate account and contact database

### **Requirements**

title: Solutions Marketing Manager (Remote)
description:
This role manages product marketing for document databases (MongoDB), MySQL, and MariaDB.  
  
Percona is fully remote, and open source in our identity.

**Location**: Remote (EMEA or Americas preferred, for core-hours overlap with the team)

**Reports to**: Director of Solutions Marketing (Solutions Marketing is Percona's product marketing function)

**Why this role exists**
------------------------

Percona sells support, services, and expertise alongside database software. Our software and our services combine to provide users and customers with secure open source databases, free of vendor lock-in. On this team, we help communicate the value and relevance to the people involved in deciding to use our solutions. The right person for this role thinks in use cases and buyer needs, not only product features.

You don’t need to come from a product marketing background. If you've done technical content, developer relations, solutions engineering, or technical writing in the database or infrastructure space, and you can translate complex technology into clear messaging, we want to hear from you.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

Initial focus (document databases like MongoDB, MySQL, and MariaDB):

* Technical product messaging and positioning for Percona’s MongoDB related offerings, MySQL, and MariaDB support and expertise.
* Use case and value based messaging for all feature messaging for GTM
* Competitive positioning
* Partner with Services and Consulting so your messaging connects to the support, consulting, and managed services that customers actually buy alongside the software.

Across the portfolio (ongoing):

* Coordinate with Product on roadmap inputs for your portfolio areas. Translate VOC from support, consulting, and sales into positioning updates and product feedback
* Own launch plans for releases, features, and service offerings in your areas. Contribute to launches, enablement, and messaging that span multiple database technologies.
* Build and maintain competitive landscapes for your primary areas, and contribute to the broader Percona competitive view. Track ecosystem trends across your portfolio areas (community surveys, conferences, mailing lists, analyst reports).

* Build sales and CS enablement: competitive comparison docs, pitch decks, one-pagers, FAQ docs, and other materials that connect technology to the use cases buyers care about.
* Engage with the open source database community. Represent Percona's perspective at events and in public content.

**Must-haves:**

* **Strong communicator.** Can write for technical buyers (DBAs, SREs, platform engineers) and economic buyers (VP Eng, CTO, CISO). Clear and concise internally too.
* **Stakeholder skills**. Builds trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Services. Responsive, organized, follows through.
* **Technical foundation**. Comfortable in technical conversations about databases, infrastructure, and operations. Can learn complex technology quickly and translate it into clear messaging. **Can work in, or can** ***learn*** **to work in GitHub**. Understanding of use cases that drive these buyers: migrations, high availability, performance, cost, compliance, and AI or vector workloads.
* **Open source mindset.** Understands transparent work, respects community, and describes licenses honestly, including when software is source-available rather than open source. Has worked in or engaged with open source in some meaningful way.
* **Adaptable.** Willing to work across multiple database technologies when the team needs it.
* 3+ years in a technical marketing, developer relations, solutions engineering, technical writing, or product marketing role. (The specific title matters less than what you've done.)

**How we work**
---------------

Percona is fully remote with a global team. Open source is the foundation: our software is built in the open where licenses allow, our community relationships are real, and transparency is the default.

You'll partner closely with teammates covering other database technologies and have direct access to Product, Engineering, Sales, and Consulting

Occasional travel (3-6 events a year) for database community conferences, partner meetings, and internal offsites (for example Percona Live, KubeCon, and MySQL or MongoDB community events).

**Compensation**
----------------

Competitive with market for remote-first infrastructure and open source companies. Adjusted for location. We share the salary range for this role early in the conversation.

**Why Percona?**

At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.

Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.

Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work-from-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology.

If you love the idea of working with a high-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open-source database space, let’s talk!

Connect with us and stay up to date on our latest news and developments by following us on LinkedIn and Twitter. We look forward to connecting with you!

title: Generative Content Creator

--------------------

* Stay Ahead of AI Advancements: Research, test and bring emerging image, video and audio models to the team to continuously speed up our creative workflows.

----------------

* Node-Based AI Pipelines: Experience building custom pipelines in ComfyUI for precision that presets can't give.

* 3D Software and AI Integration: Familiarity with Blender, Cinema 4D or Maya, and incorporating 3D assets into AI pipelines.
* Game UI and Gameplay Motion: Ability to create mock gameplay, game UI and interactive mechanics using a mix of AI generation and After Effects motion graphics.
* Performance Marketing Experience: A background in UA video ads or marketing creatives for mobile games.

**(We will only contact candidates with portfolio links)**

N-iX is a global software development company founded in 2002, connecting over 2,400+ tech professionals across 40+ countries. We deliver innovative technology solutions in cloud computing, data analytics, AI, embedded software,IoT, and more to global industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Join us to create technology that drives real change for businesses and people across the world.

Currently, we are looking for experienced Interim Head of Information Security who will shape and lead Client`s security strategy. In this role you report to the VP IT & Infrastructure and collaborate closely with Engineering, Legal, and Compliance teams.

This role offers the opportunity to further develop the client's Information Security function into a proactive, engineering-aligned capability that supports secure software development ("secure by design"), ensures readiness for audits such as PCI-DSS and SOC 2, and strengthens company resilience in an evolving threat landscape.

We are looking for a leader with strong technical credibility, a pragmatic mindset, and experience working in software-driven environments.

The position is temporary ( 4–6 months), and we are open to both full-time and part-time arrangements.

#### **Responsibilities:**

* Ownership and continuous improvement of overall security posture, ensuring transparency of the security risk landscape through clearly defined and measurable KPIs.
* Definition and proactive evolution of the company's information security strategy in alignment with business objectives and the evolving threat landscape. In close collaboration with Engineering, integration of security into software development (SDLC) and platform operations, promoting secure-by-design principles across the organization.
* Establishment of pragmatic security standards and guardrails, providing clear, risk-based guidance to support prioritization of security initiatives and enable teams to implement secure solutions effectively.
* Preparation of the organization for regulatory and audit requirements such as PCI-DSS and SOC 2 by translating compliance expectations into practical and scalable controls.
* Strengthening of capabilities for detecting and responding to security threats by promoting appropriate logging, monitoring, and alerting practices across applications and infrastructure.
* Evaluation and implementation of security technologies aligned with architecture and engineering workflows, including contributions to build-versus-buy decisions to ensure scalable and maintainable solutions.
* Acting as a trusted advisor by collaborating with internal stakeholders and representing company in security-related interactions with customers, partners, and auditors when required.

#### **Requirements:**

#### **Professional Experience**

* 7+ years of relevant professional experience in Information Security or closely related fields.
* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent knowledge gained through proven practical experience.
* Experience working with software development organizations, with a strong understanding of how modern applications and platforms are built and operated.
* Proven background in Information Security or Security Engineering roles, ideally within cloud-based or SaaS environments.
* Familiarity with common security standards and frameworks such as PCI-DSS and SOC 2, or comparable approaches.
* Experience in environments handling sensitive (payment-related) data is a strong advantage.
* Exposure to emerging topics such as security considerations in AI-enabled environments is a plus.

#### **Technical Competencies**

* Strong technical foundation supported by hands-on experience.
* Solid understanding of modern application architectures, APIs, identity and access management concepts, and typical vulnerabilities affecting distributed systems.
* Ability to confidently discuss architecture decisions with engineering teams.
* Experience evaluating security tooling and approaches that integrate effectively into modern development workflows, including a clear understanding of how logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities contribute to improving security posture.

#### **Leadership & Personal Skills**

* Strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes, with a clear motivation to improve the organization's security posture.
* Experience leading and developing small teams.
* Clear and effective communication skills across both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with the ability to build trust across the organization.
* Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; German is considered a plus.
* Structured and transparent working style with a focus on measurable progress. A team-oriented mindset that fosters constructive dialogue and promotes a culture where security is understood as a shared responsibility.

**We offer\*:**

* Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
* A competitive salary and good compensation package
* Personalized career growth
* Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
* Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
* Education reimbursement
* Memorable anniversary presents
* Corporate events and team buildings
* Other location-specific benefits

* not applicable for freelancers

title: Senior Data Analyst - Acquisition
description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

**Our vision**

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

**About us**

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

**WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission**

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience. By joining us as a Senior Data Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your business sense and analytical thinking to help us meet our high delivery standards.

**HOW you will contribute to the company**

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).

* You will proactively use data to identify opportunities to grow our business or improve our processes.
* You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them.
* You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed.
* You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt).
* You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform.

**WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane**

**Within one month:**

* You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.
* You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.
* You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations.

**Within 3 months:**

* You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers.
* You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).
* You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.

**Within 6 months:**

* You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap.
* You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform.
* You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.

**And beyond**: **the data team will continue growing with the company**

Which means:

* Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members
* Increased accountability in project leadership
* Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.

**Who are we looking for?**

You’re the right candidate if you:

* Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)
* Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools
* Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team
* You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders
* Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly
* Are fluent in English (French is a plus)

**What does the recruitment process look like?**

* A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager
* A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min)
* A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min)
* An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min)

**What do we do to make your work life easier**

Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

You’ll have a competitive compensation package

You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

*We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.*

**Who are we looking for ?**

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

* To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)
* To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
* To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)
* Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

**Important information for candidates**

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

**Applications through official channels only** : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

**Always verify the sender's email address**: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

**We will never ask you for payment or financial information**

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to **not respond** and to **report it to us immediately**.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

**Données personnelles**

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : **dpo@pennylane.com.**  
Notre data policy  
  
**Personal Data**

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to **dpo@pennylane.com**. Learn more  
  
**Personenbezogene Daten**

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an **dpo@pennylane.com** schreiben. Mehr erfahren

**Datos personales**

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a **dpo@pennylane.com**. **Más información**
