title: Regional Security Manager (Temporal)
location: San Fernando de Henares, MD, Spain
description:
**Everything you are looking for and more**

At InPost, we are looking for a Regional Security Manager to lead and drive our security strategy across Spain and Portugal, ensuring the protection of our people, assets, facilities and operations.

Reporting to the Security Director Iberia, you will play a key role in strengthening security standards across our network, managing risks and ensuring business continuity in a dynamic logistics environment. You will oversee physical and electronic security, lead security teams and external providers, manage the departmental budget, and ensure compliance with applicable legislation and InPost Group standards.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on operational responsibility, including security systems management, incident investigations, site audits and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

Based in San Fernando de Henares (Madrid), you will travel frequently across Spain and Portugal, covering approximately 50% of the Iberian territory. Availability outside regular working hours and on-call support will also be required.

**What responsibilities and objectives will you have?**

* **Security Strategy & Risk Management:** Define and implement the security strategy for the assigned Iberian territory, aligned with InPost Group objectives. Identify, assess and mitigate risks across facilities, transportation and operational processes, ensuring business continuity and resilience.
* **Team Leadership & Workforce Management:** Lead, develop and coordinate security specialists, security guards and auxiliary personnel. Manage workforce planning, schedules, shift coverage, substitutions and team allocation to ensure service continuity and operational efficiency.
* **Budget & Provider Management:** Prepare and monitor the annual security budget, optimising costs without compromising protection. Act as the main point of contact for external security providers, overseeing service levels, performance, contractual requirements and continuous improvement initiatives.
* **Physical & Electronic Security:** Ensure that warehouses, operational hubs and other facilities meet InPost's minimum security standards. Oversee the design, implementation, commissioning and maintenance of CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, alarm and intercom systems, ensuring reliability, interoperability and availability across all sites.
* **Security Systems Administration:** Administer security platforms across the network, including user permissions, access rights, system audits and periodic health checks. Apply basic IP networking knowledge to support connectivity between sites and security devices.
* **Governance & Compliance:** Ensure compliance with applicable Spanish, Portuguese and EU legislation, corporate security policies and relevant international standards, including TAPA and ISO. Develop and implement security procedures, policies and projects across the assigned territory.
* **Audits & Continuous Improvement:** Plan and conduct security audits across facilities, identify gaps, implement corrective action plans and monitor progress. Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to incident reduction, audit compliance, service quality and system availability.
* **Incident & Crisis Management:** Lead incident reporting, assessment, investigation and resolution, coordinating root cause analysis and corrective actions. Manage critical security incidents, coordinate investigations and ensure timely communication with relevant stakeholders. Act as a 24/7 security point of contact for the assigned network.
* **Institutional Relations:** Coordinate with law enforcement agencies, judicial authorities and regulatory bodies, managing official requests and supporting investigations when required.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Operations, Transportation, Quality, IT, Loss Prevention and Facility Management to embed security into everyday processes and protect the entire logistics value chain.
* **Reporting & Stakeholder Management:** Prepare executive reports and communicate security performance, risks, incidents and improvement plans to regional and Group leadership, ensuring clear and effective communication in Spanish and English.

**Well, what will the requirements be?**

* At least 3–5 years of experience in senior security roles, preferably within logistics, retail or large-scale physical security operations.
* University degree in Security, Criminology, Engineering, Law or a related field.
* Valid Spanish Director de Seguridad (TIP) licence is required.
* At least 4 years of hands-on experience implementing, configuring and administering CCTV, access control and intrusion detection systems.
* Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams, managing security budgets and coordinating external security providers.
* Strong knowledge of security risk assessment, incident investigation, crisis management, business continuity and corrective action planning.
* Working knowledge of basic IP networking to troubleshoot connectivity between sites and security devices. Experience managing security systems across multiple facilities is highly valued.
* Knowledge of private security legislation and relevant security standards, such as TAPA and ISO 28000.
* Proficiency in Excel for data analysis and reporting. Experience with Power BI or similar data visualisation tools is an advantage.
* High level of English (C1) and fluent Spanish, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, international teams and external authorities.
* Strong leadership, negotiation and decision-making skills, with a proactive approach to risk prevention, problem-solving and continuous improvement.
* Willingness to travel frequently across Spain and Portugal (approximately 40%, typically 2–3 trips per month) and provide out-of-hours and on-call support.

***Nice to have***

* ASIS CPP/APP, TAPA, ISO 28000 or other relevant security certifications.
* Wicklander–Zulawski training or other investigation-related qualifications.
* Training in crisis management and emergency response.
* A Master's degree in Private Security or Security Management.
* Experience in logistics environments or dedicated corporate physical security departments.

**What do We Offer?**

* Language platform

* Wellbeing programme

* Flexible working hours

* Online platform for lifelong learning

* Competitive salary

* Flexible remuneration services can be contracted

**Why join us?**

At InPost, you will play a key role in shaping how millions of customers interact with last-mile delivery solutions. You will work in a fast-growing, innovative environment where your contributions directly support the company’s expansion and market presence. Our culture is built around five key behaviours, driven by a strong “Go Go Go” mindset focused on speed and determination.

* **CHAMPION THE CUSTOMER:** We put the customer at the center of everything we do and strive to exceed expectations.

* **OWN IT:** We take responsibility, act with initiative, and proactively drive solutions.

* **DARE TO DISRUPT:** We embrace innovation, ambition, and continuous learning to grow and improve together.

* **MAKE IT HAPPEN:** We adapt quickly, learn constantly, and move forward with Smart execution.

* **WIN TOGETHER:** We achieve great results through collaboration, recognition, and a shared winning mindset.

**Inclusive Culture**

InPost has an Equal Opportunities Plan that promotes equality at all levels. We aim for equality in the company's workplaces, focused on promotion, as well as gender equality, diversity, equity and inclusion of people regardless of their abilities and conditions.

title: Executive Chef
description:
**Job Ref:** ZES1005

**Branch:** Zest Hotel and Resort

**Location:** Zest Hotel and Resort, Illes Balears Spain

**Salary/Benefits:** Competitive Salary

**Contract type:** Permanent

**Hours:** Full Time

**Posted date:** 06/10/2026

**Closing date:** 23/11/2026

**About ZEST Hotel Resort Ibiza**

ZEST Hotel Resort is where dynamic energy meets effortless luxury. Designed for those who seek both indulgence and authenticity, we create a space where creativity thrives and every moment is a celebration of the senses. From vibrant days by the pool to elegant evenings under the stars, ZEST pulses with movement, music, and connection. Our approach to luxury is relaxed yet refined, stylish, welcoming, and always inspiring. Here, pleasure is an art, and every stay is an unforgettable experience.

ZEST Hotel Resort is a new luxury resort in Cap Negret, Ibiza, scheduled to open in April 2027. With 206 rooms and seven villas, destination dining, wellness facilities, and a Beach Club, we are building a team that will bring warm, thoughtful hospitality to every part of the guest experience.

  

**About the Role**

Lead the culinary vision behind one of Ibiza's most exciting luxury resort openings.

As we prepare for opening, we are looking for an exceptional Executive Chef to join our Executive Leadership Team and help shape the culinary identity of this landmark resort.

This is an opportunity to do much more than lead a kitchen. We are seeking a culinary leader who can create memorable dining experiences, develop innovative concepts, build an outstanding brigade, and establish a food culture that celebrates the energy, creativity, and natural abundance of Ibiza.

Reporting to the Director of Food Beverage, the Executive Chef will have overall responsibility for the culinary strategy, food quality, and kitchen operations across the resort.

Working closely with the Food Beverage leadership team and wider resort stakeholders, you will help define and deliver the culinary vision of ZEST across restaurants, bars, Pool Club, in-room dining, banqueting, and special events. You will play a key role in translating the ZEST brand into exceptional dining experiences while balancing creativity, operational excellence, team development, and commercial performance.

As part of the pre-opening team, you will help establish kitchen infrastructure, recruit and develop the culinary team, create menus and concepts, and ensure operational readiness ahead of launch.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and deliver the overall culinary vision and food strategy for ZEST Hotel Resort Ibiza.
* Create innovative menus and dining concepts that combine Mediterranean and Ibicenco influences with contemporary international cuisine.
* Champion local, seasonal, and sustainable ingredients, building strong partnerships with Ibizan and Balearic suppliers and producers.
* Lead all culinary operations across restaurants, bars, Pool Club, in-room dining, events, banqueting, and employee dining facilities.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and inspire a high-performing culinary team, creating a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Establish kitchen structures, operational standards, recipes, procedures, and working practices ahead of opening.
* Collaborate closely with the Director of Food Beverage on concept development, menu engineering, pricing strategies, and guest experience enhancement.
* Drive food quality, consistency, creativity, and presentation standards across all outlets.
* Manage food costs, labor productivity, purchasing, inventory controls, and departmental budgets to achieve financial objectives.
* Lead seasonal menu development and adapt offerings to reflect market trends, guest preferences, and Ibiza's operating seasons.
* Embed sustainability, responsible sourcing, waste reduction, and environmental best practices throughout the culinary operation.
* Ensure full compliance with HACCP, food safety, hygiene, health and safety, and all regulatory requirements.
* Monitor guest feedback, culinary trends, and competitive positioning to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
* Support resort events, VIP experiences, brand activations, and special culinary collaborations.
* Contribute to all pre-opening activities, including kitchen design reviews, equipment selection, supplier sourcing, training programs, and operational readiness planning.

**Experience Qualifications**

* Culinary degree or professional qualification in Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
* Significant leadership experience as an Executive Chef, Executive Sous Chef, or senior culinary leader within a luxury hotel, resort, lifestyle brand, or high-end multi-outlet operation.
* Demonstrated success managing multiple restaurants and diverse culinary concepts within a complex hospitality environment.
* Strong understanding of Mediterranean cuisine, local sourcing, seasonality, and international food trends.
* Proven experience developing successful restaurant concepts, menus, and guest dining experiences.
* Strong commercial acumen with expertise in food cost management, labor control, purchasing, budgeting, and profitability.
* Experience recruiting, developing, and leading large culinary teams.
* Previous hotel or resort pre-opening experience is highly desirable.
* In-depth knowledge of HACCP, food safety regulations, and Spanish/EU compliance requirements.
* Fluent in English and Spanish.
* Valid EU work authorization or the appropriate Spanish work permit.

Key Competencies

* Creative and visionary culinary leadership.
* Passion for exceptional food quality and guest experiences.
* Strong commercial and business acumen.
* Inspirational leadership and team development skills.
* Operational excellence and attention to detail.
* Innovation, adaptability, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management abilities.
* Alignment with ZEST values, culture, and service philosophy.

  

**Benefits**

At ZEST, we believe exceptional culinary experiences are at the heart of unforgettable hospitality. As Executive Chef, you will have the opportunity to create and lead a food program that becomes a defining part of the guest experience and a benchmark within Ibiza's luxury hospitality scene.

* Competitive executive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to join the Executive Leadership Team of a landmark luxury resort.
* Be part of a pre-opening project and shape the culinary identity from day one.
* Creative freedom to develop concepts, menus, and experiences that reflect the ZEST brand.
* Opportunities for professional growth, development, and industry recognition.
* Employee recognition and engagement initiatives that celebrate success and performance.
* The opportunity to make a lasting impact on one of Ibiza's most exciting luxury hospitality destinations.
* Work within a culture driven by the ZEST Effect, where passion, creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do.

**Why Join Us?**

This is far more than a traditional Executive Chef role.

You will join the team responsible for launching one of Ibiza's most exciting new luxury lifestyle resorts, helping define its culinary identity, dining concepts, guest experiences, and long-term reputation from day one.

If you are excited by the opportunity to build something exceptional from the ground up and create culinary experiences that guests remember long after they leave, we would love to hear from you.

**ZEST Hotel Resort Ibiza is an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.**

title: CISO AI
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a forward-thinking security leader to become our AI CISO. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI security at a global scale, protecting our models, data, and infrastructure from emerging threats while fostering responsible and ethical AI innovation.

**About the job**

**Job purpose**

Your purpose is to build and run a holistic AI security program for AXA. You will establish the governance, risk management framework, and security controls to protect our AI/ML models and data, ensuring that AXA's use of AI is not only powerful but also secure and trustworthy.

**Main missions**

Your mission is to build the program around the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, adapted for AI:

* Govern: Develop and follow implementation the Group's AI Security Strategy, in line with responsible AI principles and emerging regulations (e.g., EU AI Act). Establish policies for secure AI development, data usage, and model governance
* Identify: Lead risk assessments methodology design on AI models and systems, focusing on unique threats like data poisoning, model evasion, adversarial attacks, and prompt injection. Ensure a consolidate inventory of critical AI assets
* Protect: Define security standards and architecture patterns for the AI/ML lifecycle, from secure data acquisition and feature engineering to model training and deployment. Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of models and training data
* Detect: Oversee the implementation of monitoring mechanisms to detect model drift, anomalous behavior, and security attacks against AI systems. Define AI-specific incident precursors for the SOC
* Respond & Recover: Define and test the incident response playbook for AI-specific security events, such as a compromised model or a severe data leak through a Generative AI service

**Expected skills & experience**

We are looking for someone with the following experience and skills:

**Experience**

More than 10 years of experience in Information Security or a related field, with demonstrated experience in a leadership role focused on data science, AI/ML, or the security thereof.

**Technical skills**

* Good understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle
* Knowledge of common AI frameworks
* Familiarity with AI-specific security threats (adversarial ML, etc.) and controls
* Knowledge of data privacy and emerging AI regulations is essential

**Soft skills / transversal skills**

Profile

* Fluent in English. Outstanding oral and written communication skills with proven ability to develop and present concise information
* Strong multi-cultural understanding
* Experience of interacting with Directors and all levels of management
* Team player and able to collaborate, influence and guide others

Strategic Mindset

* A passion for innovation balanced with a pragmatic, risk-based approach. Ability to think strategically and establish a new function in a complex, global organization
* Maintains a wider perspective, aligns actions and contributes to the enhancement of the overall organizational strategy, including outputs from benchmarking activities and reviews
* Understands and articulates the projected direction of the organization and how changes to it might impact the group
* Is aware of trends in the external environment and key differentiators vis-à-vis competition and uses this information to anticipate how these changes would impact the organization

Leadership / Stakeholder Management / Communication:

* A visionary leader capable of navigating ambiguity and influencing a wide range of stakeholders to adopt new security paradigms in a matrix organization
* Ability to build consensus and drive collaboration between highly technical data science teams, business units, AXA Group functions, and AXA entities.
* Exceptional ability to communicate in English, translating complex AI security concepts into clear, actionable guidance for diverse audiences from developers to senior executives

**Where will you be in the organization?**

**The department / team**

* The division: As the thematic CISO for Artificial Intelligence within Group Security, you will be AXA's leading expert on AI security. You will partner with data science teams, innovation hubs, and local CISOs to ensure our AI initiatives are secure, trustworthy, and compliant.

  

* The department / team: Operating within a global matrix structure, you will use your leadership and influence to embed security into the entire AI lifecycle across all AXA entities. Your mission is to make "secure AI" a core principle of every project, ensuring our innovation is built on a foundation of trust.

**What we offer**

We bring together the expertise, cultural diversity and creativity of over 8,000 employees worldwide and we’re committed to equal opportunities in all aspects of employment (gender, LGBT+, disabled persons, or people of different origins) and to promoting Diversity & Inclusion by creating a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect, and where individual differences are valued.

description:

Convertir la estrategia de testing del Creative Strategist / Head of Growth en un flujo constante y fiable de assets publicados. **About us**

Do you live to create? Looking for your next big challenge? How about a breath of fresh air? As part of the Omnicom Agencies Group, the 14 Agency network handles all global advertising for CUPRA and SEAT car brands. With offices in 11 countries and counting, 14 is a place for those who like to bend the rules. It's a place for rock'n'roll. At the heart of Barcelona, and beyond.

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for a Social Media Strategist to join the CUPRA Global Social Strategy team. Someone with an insatiable curiosity about digital culture, platforms, and communities, and the ability to translate all of that into strategy.

Someone who experiences the internet beyond their feed; who understands the lore, knows what's behind the screenmaxing, and recognizes when something is "that's so AI." Someone who scrolls with curiosity, knows how to separate the noise from the signals that matter, and connects what's happening online with what's happening in the real world.

Your challenge will be to transform this constant reading of culture into strategic opportunities for CUPRA. Because knowing what's happening online is good; understanding what it means for the brand and what to do with it is what makes the difference.

**Responsibilities**

***1. Social Media Strategy***

Develop social strategies aligned with CUPRA's positioning and objectives.

Define opportunities, territories, and strategic approaches to build a relevant and distinctive social presence.

Translate brand and business challenges into actionable strategies, briefs, and recommendations.

Contribute to evolving the role of social media within CUPRA's global strategy.

***2. Cultural & Audience Intelligence***

Identify cultural shifts, behaviors, communities, and conversations relevant to the brand.

Analyze platforms and audiences to understand what motivates them, how they engage, and what they expect from brands.

Transform cultural and social insights into strategic perspectives and opportunities for CUPRA.

Distinguish between a trend that deserves attention and an opportunity that warrants a brand response.

***3. Strategic Development & Measurement***

Develop strategic frameworks and criteria to guide social media decisions.

Work with Social Creative, Content Planning, and Data to connect strategy, ideas, and results.

Evaluate the contribution of social media initiatives to brand objectives, incorporating lessons learned into future strategies.

Present and defend strategic recommendations to teams and stakeholders.

***Profile we are looking for:***

Experience in Social Media Strategy, Digital Strategy, or brand and communications strategy.

Solid knowledge of the main social media platforms and their codes.

Curiosity about contemporary culture, communities, entertainment, and audience behavior.

Ability to transform information into insights and insights into a clear strategic direction.

Critical thinking, independent judgment, and the ability to construct and defend a point of view.

Ability to connect brand, business, culture, and social media without resorting to generic approaches.

Good communication and presentation skills, autonomy, and the ability to work in a team.

Advanced English; experience with global brands is a plus.

Demonstrable experience understanding social media and internet culture.

**In short**: someone who not only understands what's happening on social media, but also what it means for CUPRA and what the brand should do about it.

title: Director, Supply Chain Strategy
description:
**Role highlights:**

* Director, Supply Chain Strategy
* Location: FInland, Germany or Spain
* Department: Global Supply Chain
* Reports to: Global Director Supply Chain
* Employment type: Permanent
* Workplace model: Hybrid
* Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

**Why this role matters - The mission**
---------------------------------------

We are seeking a strategic, commercially and legally strong Director, Supply Chain Strategy to shape how ICEYE secures, de-risks and scales the supply base behind the world's largest multisensor satellite constellation.

You will own ICEYE's global supply chain strategy: how we assess and manage supplier risk, which suppliers we develop as long-term partners, and where we vertically integrate through partnerships, licensing, joint ventures or acquisitions. You will also define and own our supplier portal landscape, the digital backbone of how we collaborate with suppliers. Finally, you will own how ICEYE meets local content requirements, supporting our local entities as they select and onboard in-country suppliers.

This role is for a leader who moves comfortably between the boardroom and the engineering bench: credible with executives, investors and partners, and equally credible with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing and supplier engineers.

**Who we are**
--------------

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defense and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

**Your day-to-day responsibilities**

### **1. Global supply chain strategy**

* Define and own ICEYE's global supply chain strategy, aligned with company, program and production roadmaps, and translate it into a multi-year plan with clear priorities, targets and KPIs.
* Establish and run a structured supplier risk assessment framework covering financial health, capacity, single and sole sourcing, geopolitical and export control exposure, security and compliance.
* Build and maintain a supplier risk heat-map across all critical commodities and suppliers, and use it to drive mitigation plans, dual sourcing and inventory strategies.
* Own supplier due diligence for new and strategic suppliers, including ownership and security screening, ESG and compliance checks, in close cooperation with Legal, Security and Quality.
* Lead supplier development programs that lift capability, quality and capacity of strategic suppliers, and grow a resilient, sovereign-capable supply base for defense and dual-use customers.

### **2. Strategic partnerships & ventures**

* Identify, evaluate and execute vertical integration opportunities where owning or controlling critical technologies, processes or capacity creates strategic advantage.
* Support the negotiation of long-term and strategic supply agreements, including pricing, capacity reservation, IP, liability, security and exit terms.
* Structure and negotiate license agreements and joint venture agreements with industrial and technology partners.
* Act as the M&A lead in the vertical integration domain: build the target pipeline, lead technical and operational due diligence, shape business cases and drive post-merger integration of acquired capabilities into the supply chain.
* Work closely with Corporate Development, Finance and Legal, and present recommendations to the executive team and board.

### **3. Supplier portals**

* Define and own ICEYE's supplier portal strategy, roadmap and architecture.
* Lead the selection, implementation and continuous improvement of supplier portals for onboarding, qualification, forecasting, order collaboration, document exchange and performance scorecards.
* Ensure portals integrate with ERP and PLM, and meet ICEYE's information security and export control requirements.
* Drive supplier adoption and use portal data to improve visibility, risk monitoring and decision making.

### **4. Local content & local supply**

* Own ICEYE's approach to local content, industrial participation and offset requirements in customer programs and sovereign missions.
* Assess local content obligations early in bids and contracts, and translate them into sourcing plans with clear targets and tracking.
* Support ICEYE's local entities in identifying, assessing, selecting and onboarding local suppliers, applying ICEYE's risk assessment, due diligence and qualification standards.
* Develop local suppliers so they can meet ICEYE's technical, quality and security requirements, and integrate them into the global supply base and supplier portals.
* Report on local content performance and compliance to program teams, local entity leadership and customers.

### **5. Leadership & organization development**

* Build, lead and develop a team of supply chain strategy, strategic sourcing and supplier management professionals, including managers.
* Define the operating model, workflows and governance for strategic sourcing and supply continuity across electronics, mechanical, electromechanical and specialty process categories.
* Develop hiring profiles, succession plans and long-term talent strategies to scale the organization.
* Foster a culture of urgency, technical rigor, proactive risk management and high accountability.

### **6. Securing serial supply continuity**

description:

**FX Senior Product Manager - Hedging conversion**

**Ebury Madrid Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week**

As Ebury scales globally, we are evolving from a delivery-led organisation into a **platform-led product** company - building shared foundations that allow teams to move faster, operate safely in regulated environments and deliver high-quality client experiences across channel

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to own one number: the share of Ebury's clients who convert into hedgers — and to build the journeys, workflows and decision tools that get them there.

Ebury has a real hedging business. Thousands of clients already hedge with us, they're our most valuable and stickiest, and Hedge works. The problem isn't proof of concept — it's rate. For every client who converts, several more carry the same currency exposure, would benefit from the same forward, and never get there.

Here's the honest reason why. Hedging isn't a product you sell; it's a conclusion a client reaches once they can see what their international business is actually exposed to. Today that seeing happens in a CPM's head and a spreadsheet, one client at a time. The client can't see their own exposure clearly, the CPM can't see it at scale, and so the conversation that should be obvious either happens late or never happens at all.

This role builds the layer that changes that: guided journeys and lifecycle workflows that carry a client from unaware exposure to a first hedge to a standing policy — and the decision tools that let both the client and their CPM understand the client's international business well enough to make the right call, not just the next call.

You'll sit at the intersection of product, data, and commercial, working closely with:

* CPMs and Sales teams who convert clients today
* Data and Analytics
* Design and Engineering
* Compliance and Risk
* Clients directly

**What you'll do**

You will own the end-to-end conversion journey into hedging, backed by a dedicated squad of developers, including:

**Journeys & Lifecycle Workflows**

* The path from spot client Hedge-active policy client, and every drop-off point along it
* Guided, staged journeys rather than one-off prompts: the right message, to the right client, at the moment their exposure is real to them
* Triggered workflows off real events, a new currency pair, a large invoice, a rate move against them, a forward maturing
* Understanding what separates the clients who convert from the ones who don't, and building for the difference

**Decision Tools for Clients**

* Showing a client what their international business is actually exposed to, in their own numbers and their own currencies
* Exposure views, scenario and impact modelling, MTM and forward comparisons a finance lead can act on without training
* Turning "should I hedge?" into a question the client can answer for themselves, with confidence
* Balancing honesty about risk against simplicity of decision, the goal is a well-made decision, not a sold one

**Tooling for CPMs**

* Giving CPMs a portfolio-level view of client exposure, trades and performance, so they know who to talk to and what to say before the client asks
* Surfacing the signals that make a conversation timely: unhedged exposure, changing trade patterns, policy lapses
* Learning from the conversations that already convert clients, and productising them

**Repeat Hedging & Policy**

* Turning a first hedge into a second and a third
* Moving clients from ad-hoc trades onto a standing hedging policy they run every month
* Statements, notifications and review moments that build the habit and prove the value after the fact

**Experimentation & Measurement**

* A cadence of A/B tests across the journey, not a feature backlog
* Reading results honestly, including the ones that kill your own ideas
* Building the measurement so conversion, and what's driving it

**What success looks like (12-18 months)**

* Spot-to-hedger conversion rate is measurably higher, and you can attribute the lift
* A meaningful share of new hedgers convert through product journeys rather than a CPM conversation
* CPMs work from exposure signals in a tool instead of instinct and spreadsheets, and cover more clients as a result
* Clients can articulate their own FX exposure — and clients who hedge once come back without being called
* More hedgers move onto hedging policies rather than trading ad hoc
* Product — not people — becomes the primary driver of hedging conversion

**What makes this role hard**

* You're changing behaviour, not shipping features. The instrument already exists and works; the reason more clients don't use it is understanding, trust and habit.
* It's a two-sided problem. Clients and CPMs need different views of the same truth, and building for one badly makes the other worse but the CPMs must know what the client can see to have consultative conversations
* The baseline isn't zero. There's an existing business and an existing way of converting clients, you have to improve on it without disrupting it.
* Exposure is genuinely hard to model. Client data is incomplete, trade history is a proxy for intent, and being confidently wrong about someone's exposure destroys trust instantly.
* You're helping non-experts make decisions with real financial consequences. Oversimplify and you mislead; don't simplify and nobody acts.
* You'll navigate real-world complexity: regional and regulatory nuance, credit and margin implications, and client segments with genuinely different needs.

**Who we are looking for**

Prior FX or hedging experience is a plus, not a requirement. We're looking for someone who can move a hard conversion number in a complex, regulated environment — with strong agency, sharp analytical instincts, and a real feel for why people do and don't act.

**Must-have:**

* 4+ years of product management experience, including at least one role owning conversion, adoption or engagement outcomes end-to-end
* Strong analytics and experimentation skills — funnel analysis, cohort and retention analysis, designing and interpreting A/B tests
* Experience designing lifecycle journeys or triggered workflows, and the messaging that carries them
* Fluent English (daily collaboration with global commercial, tech and Legal/Compliance/Risk stakeholders)

**Nice-to-have:**

* Familiarity with foreign exchange, hedging or other asset classes
* Experience in fintech or regulated financial products
* Experience building internal or advisor-facing tooling alongside client-facing product
* Localisation awareness

**Core Capabilities**

* **Strong Product Fundamentals** — breaks down ambiguous problems into clear product opportunities; comfortable working across UX, data and operations; focused on outcomes, not just delivery.
* **Funnel & Journey Thinking** — instinctively looks for where clients fall out and why; designs staged journeys rather than isolated features; sizes the opportunity before designing the fix.
* **Two-Sided Design** — builds for clients and the internal teams serving them at once; understands the trade-offs between automation and human judgement.
* **Behavioural Instinct** — thinks in triggers, incentives and habit loops; understands that conversion is earned, not shipped.
* **Analytical Depth** — partners with Data rather than outsourcing the thinking; can build the exposure and funnel view themselves and defend it.
* **Commercial Awareness** — understands how product decisions land in revenue and margin; prioritises on business impact, not just user feedback.
* **High Agency & Pragmatism** — comfortable operating in under-defined environments; bias to action; doesn't wait for perfect structure.
* **Deep Customer Curiosity** — regularly speaks to clients and CPMs; uses it to inform decisions, not just validate them.

**Why Ebury?**

This is a **fixed-term appointment** with an initial duration of 4 years. Depending upon performance and organisational needs, the appointment may be extended up to a possible maximum duration of 8 years.

  

**Location**
  
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands with a resident assignment to ESAC, Villanueva de la Cañada, Spain.

**Description**
---------------

The Directorate of Human and Robotic Exploration Programmes (D/HRE) is a programme directorate within the ESA matrix structure. Through a partnership between humans and robots, D/HRE is dedicated to exploring destinations in space where humans are already living and working —– or will live and work in the future —– for the purpose of scientific research, economic development, international cooperation and public inspiration.

The Science Operations Department (SCI-S), within ESA’s Directorate of Science (D/SCI), hosts the scientists and engineers who oversee the space missions from study to the end of operations, develops the science operation systems for the missions and operates the missions in space, and archives and curates their data during operations and beyond. The Department provides support to D/HRE for the data curation, archiving and dissemination of its planetary missions (e.g., Rosalind Franklin Mission and other Mars or Lunar experiments). Its main objective is to maximise the scientific output of the missions for the benefit of humankind.

You will be assigned as Archive Scientist for HRE missions under the direct responsibility of the Chief Exploration Scientist and functionally reporting to the Head of the Science Archives Development and Operations Section, also known as the ESAC Science Data Centre (ESDC) in the Data Science and Archives Division within the Science Operations Department (SCI-S).

You will have further functional reporting lines within the mission(s) you will support, initially with the ESA ExoMars Rosalind Franklin Mission (RFM) and Mars Analog Sample Laboratory archiving work.

**Duties**
----------

You will be responsible for the definition and specification of the Scientific Archive for the supported HRE missions, initially the ESA ExoMars Rosalind Franklin Mission (RFM) and Mars Analog Sample Laboratory archiving work, and for the follow-up and monitoring of its implementation and operation with the goal to maximise the scientific return of the missions. You will work in close collaboration with the planetary mission project scientists, the other mission archives scientists, the ESDC Software and Data Systems Architect and the members of the Planetary Science Archive User Group.

  

As Archive Scientist, your specific responsibilities will include:

  

* ownership of use cases and drivers for the mission archives, including:
  + interfacing with the Project Scientist, the Science Operations Centre (SOC) team, other archive science leads and other archive scientists, as well as the external stakeholders, such as the instrument teams and the mission scientific community, to provide the science use cases that drive the mission archive and determine the priorities for implementation;
  + providing scientific support and steering the development and operations of the archives for the supported HRE missions, providing the ESDC development team with an archive user requirements document as a baseline for implementation;
* chair and coordinate a mission-level Data Archive Working Group (DAWG);
* monitoring the implementation, testing and expected performance of the archive based on use cases gathered by the mission team and derived requirements; in particular, defining and performing the end user acceptance testing of the different archive versions prior to their release to the scientific community;
* with the help of the instrument operations scientists, supervising and coordinating the definition and provision of science data products and any higher-level data products from the community or instrument teams as needed, including liaising on submission schedules and content;
* liaising with any internal and external providers to ensure the completeness of all levels of data products with maximum science quality, contributing to the optimisation and refinement of the archive products when possible;
* encouraging and contributing to the science exploitation of the missions’ data products through archive usage;
* participating in archive scientist meetings and user groups and sharing ideas and proposals for the strategy and promotion of the ESA science archives;
* supporting the scientific community on archive- and data product-related questions.
  

As a scientist, you will be required to actively pursue personal scientific research, publishing articles using archival data, and to actively participate in ESA research activities.

**Technical competencies**
--------------------------

Experience in science data management and archiving systems

Experience working with planetary science data in a research setting, preferably including data from surface/in situ planetary missions

Experience in coordinating the scientific community and managing multiple interfaces at international level within a large multidisciplinary team.

Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions

**Behavioural competencies**
----------------------------

Result Orientation
  
Operational Efficiency
  
Fostering Cooperation
  
Relationship Management
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Forward Thinking

**Education and professional experience**
-----------------------------------------

A PhD in a relevant domain is required for this post, together with one year of relevant professional experience.

**Additional requirements**
---------------------------

The following are assets for this position:

  

* Experience in promoting science to the wider scientific community and general public;
* Understanding of user needs in relation to complex software systems;
* Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions;
* Experience in agile and DevOps methodologies, human factor engineering (UX design) and associated technologies and their use in modern software engineering.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusiveness**
  
ESA is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

At the Agency we value diversity, and we welcome people with disabilities. Whenever possible, we seek to accommodate individuals with disabilities by providing the necessary support at the workplace. The Human Resources Department can also provide assistance during the recruitment process. If you would like to discuss this further, please contact us via email at contact.human.resources@esa.int.

  

**Important Information and Disclaimer**
  
In principle, recruitment will be within the advertised grade band (A2-A4). However, if the selected candidate has less than four years of relevant professional experience following the completion of the master’s degree, the position may be filled at A1 level.

Applicants must be eligible to access information, technology, and hardware which is subject to European or US export control and sanctions regulations.

During the recruitment process, the Agency may request applicants to undergo selection tests. Additionally, successful candidates will need to undergo basic screening before appointment, which will be conducted by an external background screening service, in compliance with the European Space Agency's security procedures.

Note that ESA is in the process of transitioning to a Matrix setup, which could lead to organisational changes affecting this position.

The information published on ESA’s careers website regarding working conditions is correct at the time of publication. It is not intended to be exhaustive and may not address all questions you would have.

  

**Nationality and Languages**
  
Please note that applications are only considered from nationals of one of the following States: Austria, Belgium, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the United Kingdom and Canada, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania and Slovakia.

According to the ESA Convention, staff shall be recruited on the basis of their qualifications, taking into account an adequate distribution of posts among nationals of the Member States.

The working languages of the Agency are English and French. A good knowledge of one of these is required. Knowledge of another Member State language would be an asset.

description:

Develop meaningful and mutually beneficial relationships between people practices and commercial business success across our European major markets. **Please note: We may close this vacancy early if we receive an overwhelming response or our business requirements change.**

* Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.

We are expanding our Corporate Information Security Team and look forward to welcoming new colleagues and leaders. We are looking for a **Head of Information Security Architecture** **(m/f/d)** .

Reporting to the Global CISO, you will define how security is embedded across Liebherr’s IT, OT, cloud, data, digital products and emerging technology landscape. You will own the information security architecture strategy, target state, principles and governance, translate business risks and regulatory obligations into scalable architectural direction, and drive Security by Design from idea through to operation.

The role leads the Information Security Architecture team and acts as the enterprise-level security architecture authority in close partnership with Enterprise Architecture and all Corporate Information Security domains.

The working location for this position will be in Madrid city where we are currently setting up a new office. We operate a hybrid model, requiring at least 40% of the working time on-site on a weekly basis.

**Creating passion: your responsibilities**
-------------------------------------------

**Principles, standards and reference architectures:**

* Define, maintain and govern information security architecture principles, standards, patterns, reference architectures and reusable blueprints.
* Provide integrated architectural direction across identity and access, cloud, network and Zero Trust, infrastructure, endpoint, data protection, security monitoring, OT and Product Security.
* Contribute to the information security architecture strategy and roadmap, aligning security architecture with business and CIS priorities.
* Define security architecture guardrails for AI and emerging technologies, partnering with key stakeholders to ensure secure-by-design solutions aligned with risk, policy and regulatory requirements.

**Security by Design and architecture governance:**

* Establish and drive Security by Design, embedding proportionate security requirements into initiatives from idea, investment and design through implementation and operation.
* Establish and chair the information security architecture decision, and governance process, including architecture intake, design reviews, decision rights, approval criteria, escalation paths and exception management.
* Design a scalable, risk-based engagement model that supports delivery teams without making Information Security Architecture a bottleneck.

**Risk, regulatory and threat alignment:**

* Translate business risk, cybersecurity risk, regulatory obligations and security policies into architecture principles, patterns and technical control requirements in collaboration with Security GRC and accountable control owners.
* Ensure architecture decisions reflect relevant threats, attack paths, systemic risks and lessons from security operations, incidents, assurance activities and vulnerability exposure.
* Advise senior management on strategic security risks, architectural trade-offs, residual risk and major technology decisions.

**Stakeholder leadership and architecture community:**

* Provide enterprise-level architectural authority and coordination for IT, OT, product engineering, business and Corporate Information Security stakeholders.
* Build strong partnerships with Enterprise Architecture, technology platforms, engineering teams, divisional security functions and relevant governance bodies. Team leadership and performance.
* Lead and manage the Information Security Architecture team, including organizational design, hiring, objectives, performance management, succession and capacity planning.
* Define and report meaningful KPIs and KRIs covering standards adoption, review outcomes, exceptions, technical debt, Security-by-Design effectiveness and target-state maturity.

**Contributing your strengths: your qualifications**
----------------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Proven ability to establish Security by Design, architecture governance, standards and target-state architectures.
* Strong leadership and ability to translate business, risk and regulatory requirements into clear architecture decisions and guardrails.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture and security architecture frameworks such as TOGAF and SABSA, and security standards such as NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001 and IEC 62443.
* Professional fluency in English is required; German language skills are an advantage.
* Willingness to travel internationally (up to 30%) as required by project work.

Preferred certifications Relevant certifications are advantageous, for example: CISSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, ITIL, COBIT, and cloud or technology-specific architecture certifications across Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.

At Liebherr, we believe people are at the heart of our success. As part of our international team, you’ll enjoy a secure role in a family-owned company that values innovation, collaboration, and long-term career growth:

title: Head of Global Marketing
description:
**Location:** Shoreham By Seas, West Sussex (3 days Office/ 2 Day Remote)

**Department:** Global Marketing

**Join an Award Winning Team. Work with World-Famous Brands.**
--------------------------------------------------------------

Are you a strategic marketing leader with a passion for building global brands, delivering commercially focused campaigns and developing high-performing teams?

We're looking for a talented and commercially minded Head of Global Marketing to lead our Global Marketing team. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution within an award-winning international company while working alongside some of the world's most recognised brands, including Disney, Warner Bros., Netflix, Nintendo and Minecraft.

If you enjoy turning insight into integrated global marketing strategies, leading creative and digital excellence, and partnering across sales, product development and licensing, we'd love to hear from you.

### **The Opportunity**

As our Head of Global Marketing, you'll lead the Global Marketing team and report to the Senior Vice President of Global Licensing, Marketing & Product.

You'll set the global marketing vision and create the strategic framework within which the team delivers. As a key member of the senior leadership team, you will make clear, commercially grounded decisions and work as a peer to leaders across Sales, E-commerce, Product Development and Licensing to align priorities, resolve issues and drive sustainable growth for Paladone and WeCool Toys.

This is a leadership role for someone who creates clarity, sets direction and empowers others to deliver. You will establish clear accountabilities, delegate effectively and empower your leaders and teams to be responsible for outcomes stepping in where your judgement, influence adds the greatest value.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

Set and communicate the global marketing vision, strategy, annual priorities and investment plan, ensuring activity supports the Group's commercial objectives and long-term growth ambitions.

Build a high-performing leadership culture within Marketing by defining clear ownership, delegating decision making and holding the team accountable for delivery, quality and commercial impact.

Lead through others: coach and challenge your team, remove barriers and provide timely direction without becoming the default owner of day to day execution.

Act as the senior marketing partner to Sales, E-commerce, Product Development and Licensing, building shared plans, agreeing priorities and making balanced decisions where customer, brand and commercial needs compete.

Use consumer insight, market trends, performance data and commercial understanding to identify opportunities, assess risk and make confident strategic choices.

Own global brand positioning and marketing governance, setting the standards, decision rights and performance expectations that guide delivery across all markets and channels.

Ensure the team delivers joined-up global launch strategies and toolkits that enable strong execution by regional, channel and commercial teams.

Sponsor the evolution of digital, e-commerce, content, influencer and channel marketing, setting outcomes and empowering subject-matter leads to determine the best route to delivery.

Oversee the strategic value of trade shows, events, agencies and external partners, approving major investment and ensuring ownership sits with the appropriate team lead.

Maintain senior relationships with licensors and partners, ensuring the team operates within brand requirements while maximising joint promotional opportunities.

Create an effective operating rhythm for Marketing, with clear plans, decision points, performance reviews and escalation routes that enable pace and accountability. While this role focuses on leadership and strategic direction, the successful candidate will also enjoy staying close to key launches, campaigns and commercial priorities, providing hands-on guidance where their expertise can add the most value.

Define the measures of success for the function, review performance and ROI, and redirect resources decisively where activity is not delivering the required commercial value.

### **What You'll Bring**

**Essential**

Proven experience operating at Head of or equivalent senior leadership level, setting strategy and achieving results through a multi-disciplinary marketing team.

A strong record of building accountability, developing leaders, delegating effectively and creating the conditions for teams to take ownership and deliver.

Sound judgement and the confidence to make timely, evidence-based decisions, communicate trade-offs and remain accountable for outcomes.

Credibility as a peer-level partner to senior Sales, E-commerce, Product Development and Licensing leaders, with the ability to influence, challenge constructively and build shared ownership.

Broad expertise across digital, social, content, PR, influencer, event and retail marketing. Able to operate strategically whilst remaining sufficiently involved to guide, challenge and support delivery when required

Strong commercial acumen and experience using consumer insight, analytics, ROI, budgets and forecasts to prioritise investment and drive profitable growth.

**Desirable**

Experience working with licensed consumer products, entertainment, toys, gifts or a similarly fast-paced international product business.

Experience managing websites, content ecosystems, creative production workflows and digital asset libraries.

Experience with project-management and workflow tools such as Monday.com or an equivalent platform.

We know great candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited by the opportunity and believe you could make a positive contribution, we'd love to hear from you.

### **Why Join Us?**

At Paladone, we believe our people are at the heart of our success. We foster a collaborative, supportive and inclusive culture where ideas are valued, achievements are recognised and development is encouraged.

As a growing international business, we offer opportunities to learn, develop and make a meaningful impact. Whether you're looking to take the next step in your career, broaden your experience or build new skills, you'll be supported every step of the way.

You'll also have the opportunity to work alongside some of the world's most recognisable entertainment, gaming and consumer brands while being part of a business that continues to evolve and grow.

### **Who Are Paladone & WeCool?**

Paladone is an award-winning global wholesale giftware company, creating innovative lifestyle products that put a smile on customers' faces worldwide. Alongside our own branded ranges, we work with some of the world's most recognisable licences, including Disney, Harry Potter, Marvel and DC Comics.

In recognition of our continued growth, culture and international success, Paladone was proud to be named Employer of the Year and International Business of the Year at the 2025 Sussex Business Awards.

WeCool Toys is a global designer and manufacturer of dynamic toys, crafts and compounds, managing end-to-end production, packaging and distribution. As part of Paladone Group Holdings, WeCool plays a key role in our international growth strategy.

### 

### **What We'll Offer in Return**

* Flexible hours and hybrid working
* 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
* Additional wellbeing days and Christmas closure
* A shorter working day on your birthday
* Regular company-funded social events and activities
* Health and wellbeing support, including Mental Health First Aiders
* Paid medical appointment time, free eye tests and flu vaccinations
* Cycle to Work scheme
* 35% staff discount on Paladone & WeCool products
* Retail savings, tech and furniture schemes
* Discounted legal services and access to financial advisers
* NHS Top-Up plan
* Annual pay reviews and bonus opportunities
* Long service awards, peer recognition and refer-a-friend scheme
* Funded training, professional qualifications and ILM leadership programmes
* Access to Litmos and LinkedIn Learning

### **Ready to Apply?**

If you're excited by the opportunity to join an award-winning global business and help shape our continued success, we'd love to hear from you.

Click Apply and submit your CV and covering letter.

We aim to respond to all applicants within 10 working days.

*Paladone welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know and we'll be happy to support you.*

**Selection Process**

We're committed to providing a fair and transparent recruitment experience. The process for this role is expected to include:

* An introductory call with HR
* An interview with the Hiring Manager
* A business-focused presentation task
* A final conversation with a senior leader

We look forward to learning more about your experience and approach throughout the process.

title: Head of Performance Creative
description:
**Role Objective**
**AtlasBrands is looking for a Head of Performance Creative (Meta) to serve as the "CEO" of our primary acquisition channel.**
Because Meta represents 100% of our customer growth, you will take complete, end-to-end ownership of the channel and leading with an obsessive, direct-response creative strategy while cross-functionally overseeing media buying execution.
  
  
You are a world-class performance creative lead who stays deeply in the trenches, studying market trends and competitor ads to craft high-converting hooks and concepts. Your core objective is to build and scale a pod-based creative department that powers rapid revenue expansion while maintaining strict unit economics, total account stability, and proactive resolution of ad rejections and account risk across high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Operating as a strategic player-coach, you will transition current lead oversight, build custom tracking dashboards, and recruit an A-player team that executes with speed and autonomy.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Channel Onboarding & Transition: Audit active ad accounts, creative pipelines, and team members to deliver a clear execution plan. Fully assume Meta decision-making (budgets, launches, creative) and seamlessly transition the incumbent lead into a dedicated Creative Strategist role.
* Brand Scaling Systems: Execute staged growth targets for existing brands at first-rebill break-even or better. Establish a standardized launch protocol for new brands to reach scale rapidly while maintaining a near-perfect success rate.
* Retention & Margin Optimization: Shift brands from first-rebill break-even to first-purchase break-even as they mature, sustaining performance month-over-month. Proactively flag risks ahead of time with actionable recovery plans.
* Ad Rejection & Account Health Management: Rapidly troubleshoot and resolve ad rejections, policy flags, and disablements inherent to high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Set up and manage redundant account architecture (backup BMs, ad accounts, payment methods) to guarantee zero downtime and keep spend scaling uninterrupted.
* Pod Architecture & Department Building: Grade current team members and design final pod structures. Fully staff every pod with top-tier talent so strategists own creative direction end-to-end.
* Analytics & AI Operations: Build custom AI-driven live dashboards (using Claude) tracking spend, acquisition costs, payback periods, creative win rates, and rejection rates. Lead concise weekly executive syncs that require zero prep from leadership.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Proven $100K+/Day Scale: Track record taking DTC brands to aggressive scale, directly responsible for managing $100K+ daily Meta ad spend across catalog depth (6–10+ distinct SKUs).
* Direct-Response Mastery & In-the-Trenches Mindset: Obsessed with studying winning market trends, analyzing competitor ads, and turning consumer psychology into high-velocity creative concepts.
* Operational Resilience in High-Risk Verticals: Hands-on experience resolving policy flags, ad rejections, and account risks in supplement/health categories while keeping spend live via backup account infrastructure.
* High-Tempo Work Ethic (60+ Hrs/Wk): Hyper-ambitious operator who thrives under high pressure, brings a history of 60+ hour work weeks, and wants to grind alongside an elite team pushing toward 9 figures.
* Full Channel Ownership & Execution: Operates as a true "CEO of Meta"—building A-player creative pods, overseeing media buying alignment, and executing with extreme speed and autonomy.
* AI-Driven Automation: Leverages modern LLMs (Claude, GPTs) and automated data workflows to streamline creative analysis, build tracking dashboards, and scale output.

**Working Hours & Culture**

* Role Timeline: Full-time leadership hire.
* Async-First: Global, remote-first team setup requiring core daily overlap with US EST business hours for team syncs and cross-functional alignment.

**How To Apply & What To Expect**
At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.

title: Head of Growth - DTC/eCommerce

* Finding new winning angles and audiences

* Fast-moving, highly analytical, and obsessed with finding what works

**Strong bonus points**

* Experience scaling supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or other DTC consumer brands

This is
**not**
a fit if:
  
  

* You've managed less than $250K/month in ad spend
* Your background is primarily organic social or influencer marketing
* You're primarily a creative strategist who doesn't understand media buying
* You're primarily a media buyer who relies on someone else for all creative strategy
* You've worked mainly in B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or non-eCommerce environments
* You're looking for a role where someone else tells you what to do

**We want someone who can walk into an eCommerce brand, look at the numbers and the creative, figure out what's broken, and start making it better immediately.**
**Schedule**

* Fully remote
* Full-time
* Minimum 6-hour overlap with US Eastern Time (10:00 AM–4:00 PM ET)
* Direct collaboration with the founders
* Significant ownership and autonomy
* Possible equity upside for strong performance

title: Licensing Manager, Israel & MENA

**Overview** WildBrain CPLG is a world-leading entertainment, sport and brand licensing agency with 20 offices worldwide. We are looking to add to our talented team of innovators that can help us manage some of the most profitable and enduring brands in the world! We believe that our partnerships are about clarity, openness, and trust, and we are widely known for our straightforward approach.

WildBrain CPLG is looking for a commercially driven Licensing Manager to join its MENA team in Dubai, reporting to the Commercial Director, MENA.

The Licensing Manager will take primary responsibility for managing and developing WildBrain CPLG's licensing business in Israel. This will include growing existing licensee relationships, identifying and securing new partners, and building relationships with key retail and commercial contacts.

The role will also support the wider MENA commercial team by developing business cases and pitches, maintaining sales materials, conducting retail visits and providing relevant market intelligence. In addition, the Licensing Manager will support the development of selected location-based entertainment opportunities across the region.

This is a hands-on commercial role for someone who can independently manage existing partnerships, develop new business in Israel and provide practical support to the wider regional growth plan.

* Develop and implement the licensing strategy for Israel, aligned with regional priorities and licensor objectives.
* Manage and grow existing licensee relationships while identifying and securing new partners.
* Conduct market, retail and category analysis to identify gaps and new business opportunities.
* Develop commercial proposals and lead negotiations for new deals, renewals and amendments.
* Build and maintain relationships with key local retailers to improve retail placement and identify opportunities for licensed products.
* Help expand WildBrain CPLG’s portfolio by identifying opportunities to represent additional brands in Israel.
* Manage account performance and coordinate with Finance on reporting and payments.
* Own the Israel territory forecast, regularly reviewing revenue expectations, account performance and the commercial pipeline.
* Work with Creative Services and Product Development on product submissions and approvals, and with Legal on contract execution.

* Provide regular updates on the Israeli licensing and retail landscape.

title: Director of Creative Performance
description:
**Department:** Marketing

**Reports To:** Head of Growth

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Location:** Remote

**Base Salary:** $170,000–$190,000 + bonus

**About Bask & Lather**

Bask & Lather is a rapidly growing beauty and haircare company dedicated to helping consumers achieve healthier hair and feel confident in their natural beauty. Rooted in a scalp-first philosophy, product efficacy and authentic storytelling, we serve customers across DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and national retail. Our mission is to help customers grow it and keep it too.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Director of Creative Performance to lead our paid acquisition creative function. You will turn customer insights and performance data into compelling ads, build a disciplined testing and learning process, and develop a reliable pipeline of creative that can sustain profitable spend.

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will own creative strategy, briefs, production coordination, quality assurance, and creative performance analysis. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring analytical depth, creative judgment, and strong execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Creative strategy and testing:** Build a prioritized roadmap for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other active acquisition channels. Define customer audiences, objections, product benefits, hooks, formats, and hypotheses for each test.
* **Production and delivery:** Translate strategy into clear briefs, scripts, demonstrations, and channel-specific assets. Manage the production calendar, feedback, approvals, and delivery against agreed deadlines.
* **Creative learning and iteration:** Review results with Growth, identify why concepts perform, and turn findings into the next briefs. Expand winning concepts and diagnose weaker executions before deciding whether to revise or retire them.
* **Creators and partners:** Manage performance creative agencies, UGC partners, freelancers, and production vendors. Improve quality, turnaround time, and cost efficiency while building dependable production capacity.
* **Team and resources:** Lead assigned creative resources, establish clear ownership, and manage approved production budgets. Recommend staffing, partner, and capacity changes to the Head of Growth.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

You will own the paid acquisition creative roadmap and production priorities within approved resources. Growth owns media budgets, campaign execution, and spend allocation; you will jointly define testing conditions, evaluate results, and recommend which concepts merit additional investment.

Partner with Brand and Design to uphold brand standards, and with Product Development and the appropriate reviewers to ensure product education and claims are accurate. Coordinate with Integrated Marketing, Ecommerce, and Retention around launches, offers, customer insights, and reusable assets. Organic social, brand campaigns, and lifecycle creative are partner functions with separately agreed priorities.

**Creative Operations and Accountability**

* Maintain a searchable asset library with consistent naming, concept tagging, performance history, usage rights, and approval records.
* Plan production capacity against the testing roadmap and budget. Flag delivery risks early, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain backup partners for critical needs.
* Establish a consistent review process for product accuracy, demonstrations, brand alignment, platform specifications, and creator permissions before launch.
* Use AI and workflow automation where they improve research, ideation, briefing, reporting, or production efficiency, with human review for accuracy and quality.
* Run a weekly creative review covering results, lessons, fatigue, production status, budget, next tests, owners, and deadlines. Bring recommendations supported by evidence and clear hypotheses.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

During onboarding, you and the Head of Growth will establish baselines, consistent metric definitions, and numerical targets. The scorecard will track:

* **Creative effectiveness:** The share of original concepts that meet agreed acquisition or profitability targets at a defined spend threshold, the spend sustained by winners, and their useful lifespan.
* **Testing and learning:** Original concepts tested, meaningful hypotheses validated, and the speed at which learning becomes new creative. Track original concepts separately from asset variations.
* **Operating performance:** Brief-to-launch time, on-time delivery, cost per tested concept, budget adherence, and production capacity against the approved roadmap.
* **Diagnostic metrics:** Channel-appropriate hook and hold rates, CTR, conversion, CPA, ROAS, and fatigue indicators. Interpret these in the context of spend, audience, placement, attribution, and offer.

Acquisition and profitability outcomes are shared with Growth. Creative output volume alone will not define success.

**Required Experience and Capabilities**

* 8+ years of relevant experience in performance creative, creative strategy, or growth marketing, including leadership of creative teams or external production partners.
* A demonstrated record of developing ads that supported profitable acquisition for a consumer product brand. Beauty, personal care, or wellness experience is strongly preferred.
* Deep working knowledge of Meta and TikTok creative, with experience adapting concepts for YouTube and other acquisition channels.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to distinguish a creative insight from an attribution, media, audience, or offer issue.
* Hands-on skill in briefing, scripting, product demonstrations, UGC, editing feedback, and translating customer objections into effective creative.
* Experience managing production budgets, agencies, creators, timelines, and competing priorities. You set clear expectations, surface risks early, and follow through.

**Portfolio and Results Standard**

Be prepared to walk through examples showing the original hypothesis, your contribution, testing approach, spend supported, performance results, and subsequent iterations. We want to understand what you built, how you measured it, and what you learned. Share team and budget scope where possible, using anonymized information when needed.

**Compensation and Benefits**

Base salary of $170,000–$190,000, plus annual performance bonus tied to agreed role and organizational goals. Comprehensive benefits and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Bask & Lather is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities and for other legally protected needs. Applicants who need an accommodation during the hiring process may request assistance from our recruiting team.

title: Director of Creative (Remote US)
description:

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a Director of Creative to lead our Performance Design department — a team that sits at the intersection of creative craft and performance marketing. This is not a traditional Director of Creative role. In this role, you will often wear two different “hats”. You'll be equally responsible for the strategic & financial direction of the department and the day-to-day development of the people and work within it. You'll inherit a team with strong momentum, an established methodology, and a clear positioning — and your job is to scale it.

This role reports to senior leadership and manages the full Performance Design team, including designers, project management, and motion contractors.

**Creative Leadership & Output**

* Own the creative vision and quality standard for the Performance Design department
* Ensure all work meets both craft and conversion benchmarks — great looking and built to perform

* Build systems and workflows that help support excellent creative output for our clients both internally and externally.

**People Management & Team Development**
