**Financial Ownership**

* Own and manage the department P&L - helping to make all budgeting decisions around staffing, tech investments, and other investments for the department.
* Monitor margins, manage resourcing decisions with financial impact in mind, and ensure the department operates as a profitable, scalable business unit with monthly revenue targets and direct margin goals.

**AI & Technology Integration**

* Lead adoption of AI creative tools across the team
* Identify where emerging technologies can sharpen output and improve efficiency
* Build AI into real production workflows — not just as a proof of concept

**WHAT YOU OFFER**

**Experience & Background**

* 5+ years in creative roles within performance marketing, paid media, or growth-focused agency environments
* Proven track record in managing creative teams and balancing creative quality with business outcomes
* Comfortable presenting department strategy and financial projections to VPs and CMOs, just as much as reviewing a creative brief

**Business Acumen**

* Strong understanding of how a creative department operates as a business
* Direct experience managing or having visibility into P&L, margin, and resourcing decisions
* You think like an owner and make decisions with financial impact in mind

**AI & Tools**

* Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — generative image, AI-powered video, design analytics, or similar
* Knows how to integrate AI into real production workflows, not just demo it
* Experience with platforms like EyeQuant, Creatify, or Superside is a plus

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communicator with executive presence who can translate creative thinking into business language
* Track record of building trust with both creative practitioners and senior leadership

**What Success Looks Like:**

In the first 90 days, you've built strong relationships across the team and key internal stakeholders, identified gaps in methodology and workflow, and begun making your mark on the department's output.

Within six months, you're running the department with full confidence — driving creative quality, owning margin targets, making smart resourcing decisions, and positioning Performance Design as a competitive differentiator in new business conversations.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in the US is $160,000-$185,000 USD. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.
* Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle

  + Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents
* Benefits to Support the Whole Person:

  + Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace
  + Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, fertility support through Carrott, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
  + Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave
  + Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
  + Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

Directive is a remote-first company. This role operates 100% virtually from your home office. We collaborate through Zoom and Slack. You will need a reliable setup, high-speed internet, and a professional working environment capable of running Adobe Creative Suite and video production software without interruption.

title: Director of Design Execution
description:
### **About Switch**

At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. Led by Founder & CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world.

We believe that innovation isn't just about technology—it's about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world's most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity.

**The Role: Director of Design Execution**
------------------------------------------

The Director of Design Execution provides enterprise leadership for the practical execution, technical coordination, and field validation of data center designs across Switch's project portfolio. This role leads the team responsible for translating design intent into solutions that are safe, constructible, commissionable, operable, maintainable, and repeatable.

You will lead Design Execution from post-design handoff through construction, commissioning, turnover, and operational readiness while providing technical support throughout the infrastructure lifecycle. You will establish engineering governance, execution standards, decision and escalation processes, and feedback mechanisms that improve reliability and consistency across regions.

This role leads a team of technical subject matter experts and manages supporting third-party consultants and contractors. You will also partner closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to improve project delivery and turn field experience into standards and lessons learned for future projects.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead and develop the Design Execution team, including technical subject matter experts and supporting third-party consultants and contractors.
* Set team priorities, allocate resources, establish performance expectations, and provide coaching and development.
* Lead Design Execution activities across the project lifecycle, including design handoff, construction, commissioning, turnover, operations support, infrastructure improvements, and end-of-life planning.
* Establish and maintain the engineering governance framework for post-IFC execution, including handoff requirements, engineering decision management, escalation pathways, design-change oversight, performance metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Translate design intent into practical field execution requirements that support constructability, commissioning, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Oversee resolution of construction and field engineering issues, including complex procedure reviews, critical equipment concerns, and technical event support.
* Oversee engineering solutions for upgrades and retrofits that increase capacity, availability, efficiency, reliability, or operational capability across existing data centers.
* Provide technical leadership for electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including transformers, generators, UPS systems, power distribution, HVAC and cooling systems, controls, and related critical infrastructure.
* Review and interpret construction drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, specifications, submittals, and other engineering documentation.
* Partner with Design Engineering to translate field experience, operational feedback, commissioning results, and lessons learned into improved standards and future designs.
* Coordinate with Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, and other stakeholders to maintain consistent technical and execution standards across projects.
* Manage engineering consultants, vendors, contractors, and other external technical resources supporting Design Execution.
* Establish processes, procedures, and tools that enable consistent execution and support customer and project requirements across data center campuses.
* Establish and monitor Design Execution performance metrics and provide project, risk, and program updates to senior leadership.
* Lead assigned engineering projects and programs and ensure delivery against schedule, budget, quality, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate maintenance windows and implementation activities with facility leadership to minimize operational disruption.
* Ensure Design Execution activities comply with applicable codes, regulations, Switch requirements, and safety standards, including NFPA 70E requirements where applicable.
* Support Operations during turnover, customer-impacting events, near misses, and other complex technical situations.
* Identify systemic issues, recurring field challenges, and opportunities to improve execution, reliability, efficiency, and cost.
* Build strong working relationships across Operations, Finance, Legal, Construction, Commissioning, Design Engineering, and other stakeholders.
* Maintain an active field presence to understand conditions firsthand and validate that solutions can be executed as intended.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* You lead technical teams with clear expectations, accountability, coaching, and consistent follow-through.
* You make sound engineering decisions while balancing safety, reliability, constructability, cost, schedule, and operational impact.
* You can make informed recommendations when technical information is incomplete or conditions are changing.
* You identify design and execution risks early and develop practical solutions before they affect project or operational outcomes.
* You communicate complex engineering issues clearly to technical teams, business partners, and senior leadership.
* You build alignment across Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, and external partners.
* You establish standards and governance that improve consistency without creating unnecessary barriers to execution.
* You use field experience, data, root cause analysis, and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
* You develop internal talent while holding consultants, contractors, and other external resources accountable for quality and results.
* You are comfortable spending time in the field to understand problems firsthand and validate solutions.
* You demonstrate the judgment, accountability, collaboration, and leadership expected under Switch's Culture Codes.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive engineering experience supporting industrial, commercial, or mission-critical facilities such as data centers, power generation, or oil and gas facilities.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, technical professionals, consultants, or comparable resources.
* 4+ years of project management experience supporting data center engineering or comparable mission-critical infrastructure.
* Deep understanding of electrical and mechanical systems used in mission-critical environments, including power distribution, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, cooling systems, HVAC, controls, and fire protection.
* Experience leading or supporting construction, commissioning, turnover, operational readiness, retrofit, or infrastructure improvement activities.
* Experience managing engineering projects, consultants, contractors, and other external technical resources.
* Experience reading, interpreting, and reviewing construction drawings, specifications, submittals, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, and MEP documentation.
* Experience with EPMS, SCADA, BMS, or comparable monitoring and controls systems.
* Strong knowledge of safety requirements and applicable OSHA standards for multi-megawatt or mission-critical facilities.
* Working knowledge of NFPA 70E and electrical safety requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute solutions for complex engineering and operational problems.
* Strong project and program management, prioritization, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience using engineering, project management, calculation, data analysis, and collaboration tools.
* Ability to support after-hours or weekend activities when required for critical projects, maintenance windows, commissioning, or operational events.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Professional Engineer registration or other relevant professional engineering certification.
* Experience leading enterprise or multi-region engineering programs within data centers or other mission-critical environments.
* Experience establishing engineering governance, technical standards, design-change processes, or post-IFC execution frameworks.
* Experience supporting root cause analysis, fleet optimization, lifecycle management, and infrastructure reliability programs.

We recognize that qualified candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If your experience aligns with the core responsibilities of the role, we encourage you to apply.

### **Why Switch?**

* A Culture of Karma – We are self-motivated by karma, ensuring our actions contribute to a positive, supportive and forward-thinking environment.
* Industry Leading Designs – Work with the most advanced data center technology on the planet and be a part of emerging technology development.
* Flexibility & Remote Opportunities – Whether in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, we offer the technology and support to keep teams connected and productive.
* Career Stability & Growth – In this expanding industry, we invest in our people, providing opportunities & advancement in a stable, growing company.
* Generous Benefits Package - Switch provides comprehensive coverage for you and your family that can be tailored to fit your personal needs, and more!

### **Join Us & Make a Difference**

This is more than a job—it's a mission. If you're ready to be part of a culture that values innovation, karma, and limitless potential, we want to hear from you.

Apply Now and Let's Build the Future Together.

title: Director of Product Design
description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Director of Product Design to lead and grow our Product Design function. Product Design at Beacon is a shared function that serves the entire business: the hardware experience of our EEG headbands and other devices, the mobile apps that participants and patients use at home, the web applications that clinical teams and trial sponsors rely on, the printed materials that guide patients and site staff, and the design of internal business processes across logistics, support, and clinical operations. In this role you'll lead a team of three senior product designers, set the vision for how design works at Beacon, and plan the function's growth as the company scales. We expect this role to stay close to the craft. You'll model best practices directly alongside the team, not just direct it from above. This role reports directly to Beacon's VP of Platform.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs located in Boston, New York City, and Paris. For this position, candidates based in the Boston or surrounding area are preferred

**What success looks like:**

As a successful Director of Product Design at Beacon, you'll...

* Lead and coach a team of three senior product designers, helping each of them grow their craft, expand their impact, and build a clear path forward in their careers.
* Craft, iterate, and execute on a vision for what product design should be at Beacon, and translate that vision into a concrete plan for how the function grows alongside the business.
* Operate as a player-coach, particularly in your first year: taking on design work yourself where it sets the standard, demonstrating the practices you want to see, and raising the bar by example rather than by directive.
* Own prioritization across the full breadth of Beacon's design surface, from device and mobile to web, print, and business process, making the tradeoffs that determine where a small, senior team spends its time and ensuring no single designer becomes a bottleneck for the company.
* Build the cross-functional connections that design depends on, partnering closely with Device Engineering, Platform, Clinical Operations, Logistics, Support, and Quality to bring design into decisions early rather than at the end.
* Establish the processes, standards, and shared systems that let design scale: a coherent design language across hardware and software, reusable patterns, and design reviews that improve quality without slowing delivery.
* Ensure design's contribution to Beacon's regulated products is rigorous and well-documented, partnering with Quality and Regulatory on usability and human factors work for our cleared devices.
* Own the headcount plan, budget, and vendor relationships for the function, and make the case for investment in design with the same rigor you'd bring to a design problem.
* Develop a deep understanding of everyone Beacon serves: patients using our devices unsupervised at home, the clinical staff and healthcare providers who care for them, the site teams running trials, and the sponsors who rely on the insights we deliver. Build the research practice that keeps that understanding current.
* Develop an equally deep understanding of how Beacon itself operates, so that design serves our internal teams as well as our external users, from device provisioning and logistics through support and scientific services.
* See around corners: anticipate where design debt, inconsistency, or unowned experience problems are accumulating, and address them before they become urgent.

**What you will bring:**

* 10+ years of product design experience, including 4+ years managing and developing designers.
* Experience building or substantially maturing a design function. You know what the first eighteen months of that work actually look like.
* A portfolio that spans both hardware and software experiences. You're comfortable moving between a physical device, a mobile app, a data-heavy web application, and the printed material that ties them together.
* You have experience and familiarity working in the medical device space, clinical diagnostics, real-world-data, pharma/biotech or other related fields.
* You've worked in a regulated industry before, and have successfully navigated the tension between fast-paced iterative design and strict design controls. Familiarity with usability engineering and human factors practice (e.g. IEC 62366, FDA human factors guidance) is a strong plus.
* You're genuinely energized by coaching senior individual contributors. You can give feedback that a strong, experienced designer will respect and act on.
* You're comfortable being hands-on without defaulting to it. You know the difference between modeling the work and doing the work because it's easier than delegating it.
* Experience designing service and business process experiences, not just product interfaces. You've improved how an organization operates, not only what it ships.
* You bring strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align partners around decisions, tradeoffs, and evolving plans, including in regulated or quality-sensitive environments.
* You demonstrate a bias towards simplicity, avoid misallocating complexity, and try to impose structure at the right time - not too early or too late.
* You're comfortable working in a highly asynchronous remote work environment, and have demonstrated success doing so in the past.

The base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $215,000, depending on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

title: 21GRAMS- Director, Product Design (UI)
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

**21GRAMS, a Real Chemistry subsidiary, is an advertising agency born to make healthcare more human.** Not just in our work, but in how we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. We believe in being good to each other and hard on the work, and in creating work that makes a meaningful difference for patients, caregivers, healthcare professionals, and brands.

#### **Job Summary**

The Director, Product Design is a senior design leader responsible for setting the product design vision, raising the quality of the work, and building the conditions for teams to deliver cohesive, accessible, and effective digital experiences. This role leads complex engagements across websites, platforms, products, services, and connected ecosystems, translating user needs, brand strategy, business goals, technology constraints, and healthcare requirements into clear experience direction.

This is not solely an execution role. The Director is accountable for design strategy, client leadership, team development, resourcing, design operations, and measurable experience outcomes. They remain close enough to the work to guide critical decisions, facilitate discovery, critique design, and step into high-impact moments while enabling senior designers to lead day to day.

#### **What You Will Do**

**Design Vision and Product Strategy**

* Own the product design vision and experience strategy across a portfolio of complex client engagements, connecting user needs, brand intent, business objectives, and technical feasibility.
* Partner with Experience Strategy, UX, Product Management, Creative, Technology, Data, Medical, Strategy, and Account leadership to frame opportunities, define roadmaps, and establish measurable outcomes.
* Lead discovery and definition activities, including stakeholder alignment, experience principles, journey framing, service blueprints, value propositions, prioritization, and product or platform planning.
* Identify opportunities that extend beyond the immediate brief and turn them into clear, decision-ready recommendations for clients and agency leadership.

**Design Excellence and Delivery**

* Set and uphold a high bar for interaction design, visual design, responsive behavior, content hierarchy, prototyping, motion, and end-to-end experience coherence.
* Guide teams from early concepts through detailed design, validation, launch, and optimization, ensuring that strategic intent is maintained through implementation.
* Oversee scalable design systems, component libraries, pattern governance, and documentation in Figma, working with engineering partners to improve quality and delivery efficiency.
* Build accessibility into the work from the start, applying WCAG 2.2 AA principles and inclusive design practices rather than treating compliance as a final review step.
* Use qualitative research, analytics, usability findings, and business measures to evaluate design decisions and recommend iteration.

**Client and Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Act as a trusted senior design partner to clients, clearly articulating experience strategy, design rationale, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to executive and working teams.
* Lead high-stakes presentations, workshops, critiques, and decision-making sessions, creating alignment across internal and external stakeholders.
* Partner with project and account leadership on scope, staffing, schedules, assumptions, and change management; surface delivery risks early and propose practical solutions.
* Represent Product Design in new-business opportunities, estimates, proposals, capability presentations, and pitch work.

**People Leadership and Practice Development**

* Manage, coach, and develop product designers across levels through clear expectations, actionable feedback, growth plans, and regular career conversations.
* Create an environment where designers can do their best work, with strong critique, psychological safety, accountability, and thoughtful delegation.
* Partner with Experience leadership on hiring, staffing, performance management, succession planning, and capability development.
* Improve the Product Design practice through reusable methods, templates, standards, training, and responsible adoption of emerging tools, including AI-enabled workflows.
* Contribute to a culture of collaboration across Product Design, UX, Creative, Technology, and Strategy, reducing silos and improving continuity from concept through launch.

#### **What Success Looks Like**

* Clients see Product Design as a strategic partner, not only a production capability.
* Teams have clear experience direction, decision criteria, and an appropriate level of design leadership from discovery through delivery.
* Creates a more consistent, accessible, and high-quality experience across the portfolio.
* Designers receive strong coaching, understand what is expected of them, and demonstrate measurable growth.
* The practice becomes more scalable through better systems, methods, staffing decisions, and cross-functional ways of working.
* Experience recommendations connect to defined user, client, and business outcomes.

#### **What You Should Have**

* 10+ years of experience in product design, experience design, interaction design, or a related discipline, including 3+ years managing and developing designers.
* A portfolio demonstrating leadership across complex, multi-channel digital products or platforms, from strategy and concept through detailed design and launch.
* Experience leading multiple workstreams or a portfolio of client engagements in an agency, consultancy, product organization, or similarly complex environment.
* Deep fluency in human-centered design, interaction design, visual systems, prototyping, responsive design, information architecture, and design systems.
* Strong working knowledge of Figma and modern collaborative design workflows; familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud and prototyping or motion tools is helpful.
* Practical knowledge of accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA, and the ability to guide teams in designing inclusive experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with engineering, product, research, content, analytics, strategy, creative, and account teams.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, storytelling, critique, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience defining design outcomes and using research, usability testing, analytics, and performance data to improve experiences.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, making informed trade-offs, and balancing strategic leadership with hands-on guidance when the work requires it.

#### **This Position Is a Strong Fit If**

* You can move between the 30,000-foot view and the detail that determines whether an experience actually works.
* You are direct, low-ego, generous with feedback, and able to challenge the work while supporting the people doing it.
* You bring structure to ambiguity, anticipate needs, and help teams make better decisions faster.
* You care about craft, but judge success by the quality, usefulness, accessibility, and impact of the experience.
* Our Company values – *Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always* and *Accountability with an “I”* – really speak to you.
* You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
* You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
* You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

#### **Preferred Experience**

* Healthcare, pharmaceutical, patient support, medical technology, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Experience with privacy, consent, regulated content, and design considerations for patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.
* Experience supporting business development, scoping, estimating, and presenting capabilities or pitch work.
* Experience leading enterprise websites, authenticated platforms, service ecosystems, omnichannel programs, or AI-enabled experiences.

  

**Pay Range:** $140,000 - $155,000  
This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. title: Director, Brand & Creative Marketing
description:
As a Director of Brand & Creative Marketing, will own the evolution of MongoDB's global brand identity and creative expression. MongoDB isn't just about logos or design systems—it's about driving real business outcomes, translating our complex technical offerings into stories and experiences, and fostering pride and loyalty among all audiences. This is your chance to shape the creative future of one of the fastest-growing enterprise companies in the world.

You will lead and influence all aspects of MongoDB's brand visual expression. You are an articulate champion for design, passionate about quality and craft, and an experienced leader of diverse teams who can elevate ambitious work while delivering outstanding business results. Reporting to the VP of Corporate Marketing, you will work with peer leaders in Marketing and Product to transform the MongoDB brand to drive mindshare and market share with developer and executive audiences.

You are responsible for leading a team of creative professionals and collaborating with marketing, product, and sales to develop marketing plans, analyze results, and identify opportunities. You are also responsible for meeting budget requirements by forecasting and managing expectations.

### **What you'll do:**

Strategic Impact & Vision

* Develop and articulate a bold, clear, and compelling brand strategy that enhances MongoDB's market differentiation, emotional resonance, and business impact with audiences ranging from developers to senior executives
* Translate MongoDB's business priorities into powerful creative concepts and brand campaigns. Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to craft ideas that move both our brand and the business forward
* Identify and resolve strategic challenges by innovating bold, creative solutions that drive transformation and brand loyalty

title: General Manager
description:
**Job Title:** General Manager  
**Company:** Teletask  
**Location:** US, Remote  
**Employment Type :** Full-time

**About Teletask**

Teletask powers public sector communication. Government and public health agencies use our automated text, voice and email outreach, two-way texting and digital workflows (surveys, e-signature, scheduling) to reach the families they serve. Our largest footprint is WIC (Women, Infants & Children) nutrition programs, where Teletask messaging drives appointment attendance for over 6 million participants across 38 US states, with more than 100 million messages sent each year.

Teletask is part of Solen Software Group, which acquires and holds vertical market software businesses for the long term. The business is now at an inflection point and looking for a General Manager who will lead its next chapter of growth and build the commercial engine, team, and operating infrastructure to match the product.

**The Opportunity**

This is a general-manager role for someone who knows the industry from the inside. You will own the business's P&L, its growth, its product direction, its most important customer relationships, and its team, reporting to a Solen Portfolio Leader or Operating Partner and working within Solen's business systems and targets.

**What You Will Own**

**Business Performance**

* Own the full P&L: revenue, gross margin, EBITDA, net revenue retention and cash.
* Run a monthly operating cadence (KPIs, forecast vs. plan, actions) and report it to your Solen Portfolio Leader.
* Move the business up a Business Health Score (BHS) tier and improve its Rule of 40 through deliberate trade-offs between growth and profitability.
* Deliver the business's EBITDA growth as its contribution to Solen's Yearly Operations Goal (YOG), our portfolio-wide EBITDA growth target.
* Lead budgeting and forecasting with ROI discipline on every initiative and hire.

**Organic & Inorganic Growth**

* Grow ARR at a double-digit rate every year through new logos, expansion, pricing and retention.
* Own the pipeline from first contact to signed agreement across agency directors, state IT and operations leaders, and procurement officers.
* Build the sales playbook: ICP, outreach, discovery, proposal framework and RFP responses, with a repeatable path from local agency to statewide contract.
* Own pricing: re-evaluate customer usage, then set packaging, contract terms and price increases on the existing customer base.
* Cut churn by finding at-risk accounts early and running retention plays.
* Map the acquirable companies in the industry; source and qualify add-on targets and support integration.

**Industry Vision & Product Roadmap**

* Own a 1–3 year thesis on where the industry is heading: regulation, workflows, buyers and technology.
* Turn the thesis and customer needs into a roadmap ranked by ROI and by development effort vs. time-to-market.
* Partner with product and engineering leads on delivery; find adjacent workflows the business can serve.

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Personally own executive relationships with the top accounts, including renewals, escalations and major expansions.
* Hold growth, NRR and logo-retention targets.
* Coordinate client services, onboarding and product so customers adopt more and expand.
* Represent the business at WIC, public health and government technology conferences and associations to build brand and pipeline; work with Solen Marketing on materials and web presence.

**Team, AI Leverage & Value Creation Plan**

* Lead a team of 5–10. Hire, develop and, where needed, replace people so that 90%+ of key seats are held by A players, and build the documentation and cross-training that keep the business running through any leadership change.
* Drive AI adoption across every function and build revenue-generating AI capabilities into the product.
* Own and deliver the multi-year value creation plan (VCP) that drives the business's contribution to the YOG.

**Who You Are**

* **Hands-on industry operator.** Real depth in the industry; equally comfortable in a strategy session, a customer escalation and a roadmap trade-off.
* **Player-coach.** Gets outsized output from a small team through systems, not headcount.
* **Commercially credible.** Sells, retains and expands accounts personally.
* **Numbers-driven owner.** Applies ROI discipline to every roadmap item, initiative and hire, and thinks in years, not quarters.
* **Principled.** Lives the Solen-isms and the Solen Principles of Transformation, and runs the business on Solen's business systems.

**Requires Qialifications**

* 8+ years in operations, sales, business development or general management, including 5+ years in the industry or selling into it.
* Fluent in how government health and human services programs operate, who buys, and how they are funded.
* Has owned a P&L or a functional budget and can speak to its figures and the monthly metrics they reported.
* Documented multi-year revenue growth that they personally owned, with before and after numbers.
* Has personally closed and expanded major accounts; can provide customer references in the vertical.
* Has hired and, where needed, replaced direct reports.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience buying or selling B2B software to customers in the industry.
* Has led price increases, packaging changes, churn reduction or product repositioning.
* Has sourced, diligenced or integrated an acquisition.
* Visible in the industry through speaking, associations, analyst relationships or a recognized network.
* Has built and delivered a multi-year operating or value creation plan with stated targets.
* Has deployed AI in a business function or product.
* Understands how state and local health department procurement works: RFPs, statewide contracts and reseller channels.

**What Success Looks Like**

**First 90 days**

* Meet the top state and local agency accounts, take over founder-held relationships, and surface upsell opportunities and at-risk accounts.
* Map the customer base by program (statewide WIC, local WIC, public health, other), usage, price per participant, expansion potential and risk.
* Learn the P&L and set up the monthly operating cadence.
* Assess the team against key seats, name any gaps, and identify processes that depend on a single person.
* Build the first outbound sales playbook: ICP, outreach, discovery questions and proposal framework, starting with WIC states not yet served.
* Draft the first industry thesis and a shortlist of AI opportunities, building on the AI features already in the product.

**First 12 months**

* ARR growing at double digits, in line with the VCP target, with new states won and local agencies converted to statewide contracts.
* BHS tier improved and EBITDA contribution to the YOG on track.
* A usage-based pricing strategy agreed with your Portfolio Leader and applied at renewals.
* An ROI-ranked roadmap in delivery.
* Key seats held by A players, with onboarding materials and documented processes so no critical function depends on one person.
* An outbound sales motion in place alongside a qualified list of add-on targets.
* Value creation plan agreed and on track.

**Who You Will Work With**

You run the business day to day and report to a Solen Portfolio Leader or Operating Partner. You have real decision rights, exercised within Solen's business systems and against the targets agreed with your Portfolio Leader (BHS, YOG and the VCP). You will see the company's financials, product strategy and customer relationships from day one. You will lead a team of 5–10 across sales, client services, product and operations and work closely with product and engineering leads. You will also draw on Solen's functional leads in marketing, pricing, finance, talent and AI.

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of a profitable software business and its P&L from day one, accountable to your Portfolio Leader.
* Autonomy to build the commercial engine, the processes and the team, within Solen's business systems and targets.
* A long-term horizon: Solen buys and holds, so there is no forced exit.
* Direct coaching from your Portfolio Leader, plus access to the portfolio, best-practice guilds and functional leads across vertical software.

**Recruitment Disclaimer**

Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.

***We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.***

Director of Partnerships & Licensing

**Athlete Entrepreneur Index™ | The Lonely Entrepreneur**

**Build the commercial relationships behind a new platform at the intersection of sports and business.**

The Lonely Entrepreneur is developing the Athlete Entrepreneur Index™ (AEI), an annual index recognizing athletes for what they build as entrepreneurs and business owners.

AEI combines an annual AEI 100, the Great Eight business evaluation framework, and year-round content, education and professional resources. Our focus is athletes as business leaders—their ownership, operating achievements and entrepreneurial impact.

We’re seeking an entrepreneurial sales professional to turn this platform into paid partnerships and licensing agreements, beginning before the public launch.

The opportunity

You will work directly with founder and CEO Michael Dermer to develop and close commercial relationships with organizations that serve athletes, advise business owners or want to align with athlete entrepreneurship.

This is a hands-on sales role. You will build relationships, create opportunities, develop proposals and close business. You should be comfortable introducing a new offering, identifying its strongest commercial applications and helping shape a repeatable sales process.

What you will sell

* **Founding partnerships and sponsorships:** relationships with organizations seeking year-round association with AEI.
* **Professional and organizational licenses:** use of AEI resources and the Great Eight framework within a firm’s advisory, educational, marketing or client programs.
* **Association and institutional agreements:** access for members, athletes, students and other defined communities.
* **Sponsored access:** arrangements in which a company, donor or alumnus funds access for a school, program or community.

Who you will approach

Potential customers include financial institutions, wealth management firms, private capital firms, family offices, sports agencies, brands, professional associations, universities and influential high school athletic programs.

You will identify both the people who can champion AEI and the decision-makers who control budgets.

What you will do

* Prioritize prospects and develop a focused outreach strategy.
* Use existing prospect research while building your own relationships and pipeline.
* Secure meetings and lead discovery conversations.
* Translate AEI’s value into clear proposals tied to each buyer’s objectives.
* Negotiate and close paid agreements, involving Michael in key conversations.
* Maintain accurate pipeline records, forecasts and next steps.
* Bring buyer feedback into the development of offers, messaging and sales materials.
* Coordinate with the team to ensure commitments can be delivered.

What we’re looking for

* A demonstrated record of personally closing sponsorships, partnerships, licensing agreements or comparable business sales.
* Experience selling to senior decision-makers and navigating multiple stakeholders.
* The ability to generate opportunities independently and carry them through to a signed agreement.
* Strong business writing, presentation, negotiation and follow-through.
* Comfort working in an early-stage environment where the opportunity is substantial and the sales playbook is still developing.
* Relationships in sports, financial services, brands or professional associations are valuable.

How success will be measured

Success means signed agreements, revenue collected, a qualified pipeline and commercial relationships that can renew and expand.

AEI’s credibility is fundamental to its value. Commercial relationships must preserve the independence of its methodology, rankings and selection decisions. Inclusion and placement are never for sale.

Working arrangement and compensation

We are open to discussing full-time, part-time or fractional arrangements based on experience and fit. Compensation structure will be discussed with qualified candidates and will include meaningful incentives tied to results.

To express interest

Please share your background and two or three examples of relevant agreements you personally originated and closed. Include the type of buyer, your role in the sale and the approximate agreement size where you can disclose it.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $250,000.00 per year

* Flexible schedule

description:
**ABOUT PER SCHOLAS:**

For 30 years, Per Scholas has been on a mission to drive mobility and opportunity in the ever-advancing technology landscape by unlocking the untapped potential of individuals, uplifting communities, and meeting the needs of employers through rigorous tech training. By teaming up with dynamic employer partners, ranging from Fortune 500 companies to innovative startups, we're forging inclusive tech talent pipelines, fulfilling an ever-increasing need for skilled talent. With national remote training and campuses in 20+ cities and counting, Per Scholas offers no-cost training programs in the most sought-after tech skills, spanning Cloud, Cybersecurity, Data Engineering, IT Support, Software Engineering, and more. To date, 30,000+ individuals have been trained through Per Scholas, propelling their professional trajectories into high-growth tech careers with salaries three times higher than their pre-training earnings. Learn more by visiting PerScholas.org and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

**Per Scholas candidates must reside in one of the following states, provided the position does not carry a specific office location requirement:** AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, MD, MA, MI, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TX, WA, WI.

**Position Title:** Director, National Recruitment (Digital Strategy and Applicant Experience)

**Reports To:** VP, National Recruitment, Applicant Process and Tech Integration

**Location:** National / Remote

  

**Role Summary**

Per Scholas is seeking a Director to lead our Digital Strategy and Applicant Experience team and serve as a key architect of our national recruitment and admissions model. Reporting to the VP, National Recruitment, Applicant Process and Tech Integration, the Director will help translate enrollment goals and organizational priorities into a digital strategy, operating model, and execution roadmap. You will lead, coach, and grow a dedicated team across content, web, and applicant support, and manage the learner's digital journey, from first ad impression through enrollment - centralizing work to streamline processes while simultaneously increasing conversion. This role is a force multiplier; you will support moving the recruitment and applicant process to a more scalable, tech-enabled model. You will drive the strategy for paid media, web presence, content governance, and digital support operations, ensuring our ecosystem is high-performing, consistent, and efficient. The Director will partner closely with MarComms on brand, enterprise messaging, and creative standards; with IT on technical architecture, integrations, security, and deployment; with campus leaders on local implementation and adoption; and with external agencies to execute priorities. Within approved priorities and budgets, the Director will independently establish strategy, make operating decisions, and remain accountable for performance, consistency, and continuous improvement across the recruitment and admissions funnel.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Paid Media & Campaign Strategy**

* Strategic Direction: Own end-to-end campaign planning and creative direction, ensuring digital media spend is optimized toward high-converting initiatives.
* Efficiency & Performance: Monitor performance targets, and reallocate investment and recommend corrective action based on performance.
* Agency and Campaign Leadership: Direct internal contributors and external agencies responsible for campaign execution, media buying, and creative production. Own briefs, review cycles, quality standards, and performance management.
* Capacity Building: Build repeatable campaign processes that support changing course offerings, enrollment priorities, and an expanding market footprint without sacrificing speed, quality, or measurement.

**Learner-Facing Website & Conversion**

* Conversion & UX Ownership: Direct strategy for conversion optimization and user experience (UX) to ensure our digital front door drives enrollment.
* Experimentation: Lead testing of landing pages, copy, forms, and other key conversion points, documenting results and incorporating successful practices into national standards.
* Course Launch Governance: Establish clear responsibilities, service levels, and review cycles for course launches and updates across National Recruitment and Admissions, in partnership with campuses, product, MarComms, IT, and external partners.

**Digital Learner Journey & Process Design**

* End-to-End Journey: Oversee the national applicant experience across paid media, the website, application, email, SMS, and applicant support channels, including forms, automation logic, segmentation, lead routing, timing, and escalation paths.
* Content Production: Lead the creation, deployment, and ongoing optimization of recruitment-specific email and SMS copy, templates, landing pages, forms, FAQs, scripts, and automated sequences. Ensure work aligns with MarComms brand and messaging standards.
* Quality Assurance: Establish testing, approval, monitoring, and quality-assurance practices that ensure communications are accurate, coordinated, accessible, and delivered as intended.
* Funnel Improvement: Identify friction, abandonment, and communication gaps across the recruitment and admissions funnel and lead cross-functional improvements that increase conversion and strengthen the applicant experience.
* Innovation: Evaluate and implement appropriate technology and automation that make the recruitment and admissions experience more scalable, responsive, and effective.

**Content Governance & Lifecycle Management**

* Standardization: Own the standards, review cycles, and approval workflows for all digital applicant-facing content.
* Accessibility & Quality: Ensure recruitment content meets accessibility, brand, legal, and compliance requirements, as well as defined performance benchmarks.
* Digital Inventory: Maintain a centralized inventory of recruitment and admissions digital assets, including owners, approval status, performance, and scheduled review dates

**Team Leadership & Resource Management**

* Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop Digital Strategy & Applicant Experience team, with clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Manage agencies and vendors: Manage relationship, deliverables, performance and coordination with internal teams for external digital marketing and applicant journey vendors.
* Cross Functional Partnership: Work collaboratively with stakeholders across multiple functions and levels within the organization.

**Applicant Support Operations**

* Service Standards: Oversee national support channels and build a unified operation with clear service standards, replacing fragmented inbox-based work.
* AI Integration: Deploy AI-driven solutions, including website chatbots, to resolve routine inquiries and free staff for high-touch applicant work.
* Escalation Management: Own resolution paths for complex applicant and technical issues so they don't route back to campuses or leadership

  

**What You'll Bring**

* Leadership & Coaching: Proven experience leading and mentoring a team, providing direct coaching, and managing service standards across distributed or national operations.
* Strategic Operations: Proven track record of auditing and designing workflows that remove administrative burden and create operational efficiencies.
* Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of digital systems, including web CMS, automation platforms (email/SMS/Hubspot), and CRM systems (Salesforce preferred).
* Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in using performance data (conversion metrics, campaign ROI, funnel analytics) to inform strategy and make real-time, high-stakes decisions.
* Paid Media and Growth Marketing: Demonstrated experience leading paid-media strategy, budget allocation, channel and campaign analysis, structured experimentation, conversion optimization, and ROI-based decision-making.

title: Director of Marketing
description:
**Lumenci is hiring a remote Director of Marketing to lead US marketing for a full-lifecycle intellectual property platform. In this hands-on, senior individual contributor role, you will own IP industry events, demand generation, ABM, content, and brand for our patent litigation, monetization, and iLumOS AI businesses, working closely with Sales and collaborating with teams globally.** 
 
**About Lumenci**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Founded in 2018, Lumenci is a full-lifecycle intellectual property platform specializing in patent litigation, expert witness testimony, and patent monetization for leading corporations and global law firms across the software, telecommunications, semiconductor, and emerging technology sectors.

A key part of our model is the integration of deep technical expertise with litigation strategy. Our teams support high-stakes disputes by developing technical narratives, performing rigorous analysis, including reverse engineering and source-code review, and partnering with world-class expert witnesses whose testimony shapes case outcomes in courts and arbitration forums worldwide. Alongside our services business, our iLumOS platform delivers expert-guided AI for patent intelligence, moving clients from portfolio analysis to action in minutes rather than months.

Today we work with more than 200 clients worldwide. We have analyzed over 100,000 patents, tested more than 1,200 products, and supported clients in raising over $200M in IP financing, with more than $3.5B tied to verdicts, settlements, and cost savings. That work is delivered by 150 consultants and more than 100 technical experts with exceptional academic backgrounds.

Three Lumenci leaders are named in the IAM Strategy 300: The World's Leading IP Strategists 2026, and Lumenci ranks #14 in Vault's 2026 Top Consulting Asia-Pacific rankings. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we deliver end-to-end support spanning technical analysis, expert strategy, valuation, and monetization execution. We are backed by VSS Capital Partners and Century Equity Partners, and we are growing quickly.

**Employment Type:** Full-time, exempt  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote  
**Location:** US  
**Reports To:** Senior VP of Sales  
**Travel:** 15–25% (trade shows, industry events, client dinners)

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Lumenci is reshaping how it goes to market. As we grow our client base and expand iLumOS, we need marketing to shape the market story our commercial teams bring to clients. Our work has earned deep trust with the clients who know us. Your job is to make sure the rest of the market knows us too.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role with a clear path to building a team. With a US focus, you will own Lumenci's US marketing presence: our trade show calendar, client events, collateral, campaigns, and brand. You will support the rollout of our US team and work closely with Sales and sales enablement, while collaborating with Lumenci colleagues globally.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Events and client experiences**

* Lead Lumenci's US trade show and conference program, including key IP events such as AIPLA, IPO, and LES. Own each event from planning through follow-up, covering booth presence, staffing, materials, and lead capture
* Plan and run client dinners and hosted events in key markets
* Own promotional items, giveaways, branded merchandise, and client dinners within Lumenci's gift, entertainment, and expense policies, including vendor management, ordering, and inventory

**Content and collateral**

* Audit current collateral and set priorities for what to revise or create first
* Create overview, introductory, and solution-specific collateral for both Lumenci services and iLumOS
* Build tailored presentation slides for sales conversations, conferences, and client meetings
* Manage the webinar, white paper, and use case program, working with internal subject-matter experts to turn complex IP work into clear client stories
* Work with Legal and delivery leaders to make sure case studies, use cases, and outcome claims protect client confidentiality and are approved before publication

**Demand generation and sales enablement**

* Partner with sales enablement to keep sales materials and messaging current and consistent
* Create content for the SDR team and build targeted outreach campaigns aimed at priority accounts and buyer segments
* Design and run account-based marketing (ABM) programs for high-value target accounts, coordinating events, content, and digital outreach with Sales
* Build a demand generation engine that produces measurable pipeline, using HubSpot for campaigns, lead scoring, tracking, and attribution to prove ROI for every program
* Guide website content, SEO, and visibility in AI-driven search so buyers can find Lumenci and iLumOS
* Develop thought leadership programs that position Lumenci and iLumOS as authorities in patent monetization and IP strategy
* Manage the marketing budget, agencies, and external partners to get the most from every dollar

**Brand**

* Own the Lumenci brand across every touchpoint, including PowerPoint templates, email signatures, digital assets, and event presence
* Make sure brand standards are applied consistently across our US and global teams
* Partner with HR on employer branding, including branded templates for offer and onboarding communications and new-hire welcome kits

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Required**

* 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, including 4+ years in the intellectual property industry, such as IP information and analytics, IP software, IP or legal services, litigation support, or licensing
* Deep knowledge of the IP market, its buyers, and how they evaluate services and technology, including law firms, corporate IP teams, patent owners, and litigation funders
* Proven success running trade show and event programs from start to finish
* A track record of demand generation tied to measurable results, such as qualified leads, marketing-sourced pipeline, and closed revenue
* Experience owning a marketing budget and managing agencies or external partners
* Strong writing and presentation skills, with the ability to turn technical and legal subject matter into clear, persuasive content
* A strong sense of urgency and a habit of planning ahead, keeping several priorities moving without last-minute scrambles
* Comfort working as a hands-on individual contributor who personally delivers the work while also setting strategy
* Ability to build alignment and work well with sales and with global, cross-functional teams across time zones
* Ability to travel 15–25% for trade shows, industry events, and client dinners. Event work may involve standing for extended periods and setting up booth materials. Reasonable accommodations are available.

**Preferred**

* Director-level marketing experience in an IP-focused company
* Experience marketing both professional services and a software or AI platform, across multiple business lines
* Hands-on HubSpot experience, including campaigns, lead scoring, lead flow, and ROI reporting
* Experience building account-based marketing programs
* Familiarity with SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO) for AI-driven search
* Existing relationships across the IP event and association circuit, such as AIPLA, IPO, and LES
* Experience leading cross-functional teams or managing marketing staff

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

**First 30 days:** Review all existing collateral and agree with leadership on what to revise first. Take ownership of promotional items and giveaways. Get up to speed quickly on events already scheduled for conference season.

**First 60 days:** Deliver refreshed priority collateral and presentation templates. Run upcoming trade shows and client dinners. Start building SDR content and targeted outreach campaigns with sales enablement.

**First 90 days:** Set clear brand standards that every team is using. Put a regular webinar and white paper calendar in place. Put pipeline and ROI reporting in place for marketing programs. Present a US marketing plan that supports Lumenci's broader go-to-market strategy and iLumOS growth.

**Why You Will Love Working for Lumenci**
-----------------------------------------

**Be Part of a Global Team:** Joining Lumenci means joining a diverse and globally distributed team. You'll collaborate with talented individuals from different backgrounds and cultures, bringing unique perspectives to every project.

**Growth and Development Opportunities:** At Lumenci, we believe in recognizing and rewarding merit. We offer opportunities for merit-based promotions, allowing you to advance your career based on your performance, contributions, and dedication. We are committed to supporting your professional growth and development, providing the resources and mentorship needed to excel in your role and take on new challenges.

**Benefits & Total Rewards**
----------------------------

* **Comprehensive Health & Well-being:** We offer robust medical, dental, and vision insurance options that include significant company contributions toward employee premiums to support the health of our "Luminaries" and their families.
* **Retirement Strategy:** Lumenci provides a 401(k) program with a competitive employer-matching contribution, enabling employees to build long-term financial security.
* **Performance-Based Incentives:** Our total cash compensation includes a variable pay component designed to reward both individual goals and overall company success.
* **Time Off & Leaves:** We prioritize work-life harmony through a balanced leave policy that includes accrued Paid Time Off (PTO), designated company holidays, and additional "floating" holidays for personal or cultural significance.
* **Holistic Wellness Support:** Beyond standard medical care, we provide dedicated Wellness Leave to address both physical health and emotional well-being, as well as paid leave for significant life events like bereavement and parental bonding.
* **Culture of Autonomy & Growth:** Employees benefit from a flexible, remote-first work environment that favors autonomy and provides structured support for ongoing professional development and career advancement.

**Compensation and Pay Transparency**
-------------------------------------

The good-faith base salary range Lumenci reasonably expects to pay for this position upon hire is **$135,000 – $155,000 per year.** This range applies to candidates in all US locations. Actual base salary within this range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant experience, depth of IP industry expertise, skills, and internal equity.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for an annual performance bonus and Lumenci's benefits program, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, and paid time off.

**Application Window:** Applications will be accepted through December 1, 2026.

**How to Apply:** Submit your application through the Lumenci careers page at lumenci.com/careers.

**Salary History:** In compliance with applicable laws, Lumenci does not request, require, or rely on an applicant's salary history when determining starting pay or at any point in the hiring process.

**Work Authorization:** Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Lumenci is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** Lumenci is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Fair Chance Hiring:** Lumenci will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the California Fair Chance Act and the Los Angeles County and City of Los Angeles fair chance ordinances.

**Accommodation:** If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete this application or participate in the interview process, please contact careersus@lumenci.com.

**Employment Relationship:** Nothing in this job description creates or is intended to create a contract of employment for any specific period of time. Employment with Lumenci, if offered, is on an at-will basis and may be terminated by either the employee or Lumenci at any time, with or without cause and with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

title: Marketing Director
description:
Excellent creative work can help extraordinary organizations raise more and serve more. Unseen is looking for a Marketing Director who knows what great looks like, can explain why it works, and can bring together the people who make it happen.

You will own Unseen's brand, voice, marketing strategy, and creative standard. You will lead an outside agency through a brand rebuild, turn that work into a focused annual marketing plan, and direct major projects for selected Unseen partners.

You will turn complex information into compelling ideas that capture attention, build belief, and motivate action. You will set creative direction and hold teams accountable for quality.

Creating amazing products and campaigns is the floor. Activating people to invest in anti trafficking work is the job.

About Unseen

Unseen accelerates the fight against human trafficking and its root causes. We equip anti-trafficking organizations around the world with marketing, fundraising, and storytelling tools, and we deliver strategic grants that fund their most critical projects.

Since 2011, Unseen has worked with 94 partner organizations in 66 countries. Those partners have raised more than $119 million and served more than 1.3 million people.

We are entering a new chapter and investing in the leadership and creative work to support it.

The opportunity

This is a role for someone whose strength is creative judgment and leadership. You can recognize an exceptional idea, write a clear brief, give specific feedback, and push work further. You know how to recruit talented people and hold them to a high standard.

You will have direct access to Unseen's leadership, room to challenge assumptions, and the opportunity to shape work with lasting consequences. We want someone who can push back on the CEO's preferences, support their recommendations, and earn trust through their decisions.

You will lead through strategy, direction, and accountability, not by personally producing every asset. A social media specialist will activate the social strategy, and a production manager and production team will manage the execution of creative projects. You will guide the standard of work, help identify outside talent, and collaborate with the people responsible for daily delivery.

What you will lead

Brand and voice. Serve as the primary day-to-day client for an outside brand agency, guide the rebuild, and establish standards the team can consistently apply.

Marketing strategy. Build and execute an annual plan with clear audiences, priorities, budgets, responsibilities, and measures of success. Define how marketing builds awareness and trust, motivates engagement, and supports measurable growth.

Visibility and credibility. Build Unseen's visibility and credibility among priority donors and businesses, activating established relationships and advocates in selected markets.

Fundraising communications. Set the strategy and creative direction for campaigns, stories, and materials that support philanthropic strategy, major gifts, Guardian Business expansion, and a major capital initiative.

Partner projects. Lead strategic and creative oversight for substantial marketing and storytelling assignments for selected Unseen partners, with scope and delivery commitments established through the annual plan.

Creative talent. Identify, evaluate, recruit, and brief excellent agencies, freelancers, and other creative specialists.

Quality and accountability. Set creative standards, provide decisive feedback, and remain accountable for the quality and strategic effectiveness of work delivered by staff, production teams, agencies, and contractors without directly managing every task.

Practical AI adoption. Champion thoughtful AI use in research, creative development, workflows, and production, while protecting accuracy, privacy, and storytelling integrity.

Our philanthropic leadership owns fundraising strategy, donor relationships, and asks. Our Guardian Business lead owns that program's expansion. You will be their marketing partner, responsible for work that helps them succeed.

What you bring

* Exceptional creative judgment across storytelling, copy, design, photography, video, and campaigns.
* Demonstrated ability to turn complex information into persuasive creative concepts using audience psychology, narrative tension, message hierarchy, and clear calls to action.
* A track record of developing campaigns that produce measurable results, including fundraising outcomes, with an honest account of your strategy, decisions, contribution, and results.
* Experience selecting, briefing, directing, and evaluating outside agencies and creative specialists, including providing clear feedback and knowing when to change course.
* The ability to recruit strong creative talent beyond your existing contacts.
* Clear, constructive leadership that makes other people's work better.
* Strong execution skills, including setting priorities, managing budgets, and delivering on commitments through teams.
* Resourcefulness within a limited budget, with the judgment to surface tradeoffs early and recommend solutions.
* Practical fluency with AI tools and the ability to lead adoption collaboratively.
* Respect for ethical, survivor-centered storytelling that protects dignity, informed consent, privacy, and personal agency.

An established network of creative professionals, agencies, media contacts, or business partners is a plus. Experience in anti-trafficking work is welcome but not required.

What success looks like

In your first year, you will:

* Launch Unseen's brand rebuild and establish a consistent voice and creative standard.
* Build and execute a focused annual marketing plan with defined audiences, engagement goals, and performance measures.
* Provide creative direction and quality oversight for priority campaigns and partner projects delivered by the responsible teams against agreed goals, schedules, and budgets.
* Equip our fundraising and Guardian Business teams with compelling, useful materials and evaluate how those materials support engagement and growth.
* Build a dependable bench of creative specialists and strong working relationships with production leadership.
* Improve how we evaluate creative quality, audience response, campaign performance, and team delivery.

We will establish specific milestones together based on organizational priorities and available resources.

Working at Unseen

You will report to the COO and work closely with the CEO on brand direction and creative standards. Within approved organizational priorities and brand strategy, you will lead creative recommendations and day-to-day marketing decisions.

Our team works remotely across multiple locations. This role requires regular overlap with Central Time business hours and travel for selected events. Two team meetups per year are encouraged.

The salary range is $75,000 to $95,000, depending on experience and demonstrated capabilities.

You will have flexibility, meaningful creative responsibility, access to global partners and powerful stories of hope, and the opportunity to help organizations change lives for generations.

How to apply

Please submit your resume or professional background, plus:

1. Two examples of campaigns or major creative projects you led. Include the objective, your role, the team or agency involved, approximate budget, and results. At least one should demonstrate fundraising impact.

2. A short note explaining why this opportunity interests you and what you would bring to Unseen.

3. An intro video highlighting who you are and what makes you the best fit to join this team.

Links, existing case studies, and concise summaries are welcome. You may anonymize confidential information. We are interested in the quality of your judgment and contribution, not the polish of your application.

Candidates who advance will discuss their work with our leadership team and participate in a focused creative leadership exercise.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

* Please share two examples of campaigns or major creative projects you led. Include the objective, your role, the team or agency involved, approximate budget, and results. At least one should demonstrate fundraising impact. Links or concise summaries are welcome.
* Please write a short note explaining why this opportunity interests you and what you would bring to Unseen.
* Please include a link to a short intro video highlighting who you are and what makes you the best fit for this team.

· Ability to follow brand guidelines, incorporate feedback, organize working files, and meet agreed deadlines. Careful attention to accessibility, image credits, and instructions about permissions.

Experience with environmental, science, or nonprofit communications is welcome. A specific degree is not required.

**Organizational Overview**

The National Center on Domestic Violence, Trauma, and Mental Health (NCDVTMH) is a federally funded national resource center providing training and technical assistance; policy analysis and development; research and evaluation; and public awareness. NCDVTMH’s work is survivor-defined and rooted in principles of social justice. It is guided by the experiences of domestic and sexual violence survivors and their families, up-to-date research, and by an intersectional analysis of how systems impact the lives of survivors. Our work emphasizes the realities faced by marginalized communities and is aligned with the broader anti-violence movement.

**Position Description**

The Communications Coordinator will carry out NCDVTMH’s day-to-day communications and dissemination activities, ensuring that our resources, trainings, and messages reach the field accurately, consistently, and on schedule. This is a part-time, non-exempt staff position of 20 hours per week. This role reports to the Operations Manager, who provides day-to-day supervision and management. The Director sets NCDVTMH’s strategic communications plan and approves written content before dissemination. This position is remote within Illinois.

**Core Duties:**

* **Newsletter and Contact List Management:** Write, produce, and distribute NCDVTMH’s monthly newsletter and manage contact list.
* **Social media:** Manage NCDVTMH’s Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn accounts by creating, scheduling, and posting content, engaging with partner organizations, and growing our audience.
* **Campaigns: Support** planning and implement two annual social media campaigns (October and May), including content calendars, graphics, and post-campaign summaries.
* **Director statements:** Disseminate the Director’s statements to NCDVTMH’s email list, social media channels, and media contacts.
* · **Ensure content approval prior to dissemination:** Implement the Director’s communications plan and route written content to the Director for review, editing, and approval before dissemination.
* **Webinars:** Provide post-webinar follow-up, including posting recordings and related materials to the website and distributing them to participants and partners.
* **Product design:** Lead product design and visual production, including creating designs for staff who need design support and reviewing and refining staff-created designs (primarily in Canva) for quality, brand consistency, and accessibility before dissemination.
* **Online resource library:** Upload new NCDVTMH products and descriptions to the website’s resource library and ensure they are accurate, accessible, and easy to find.
* **Website:** Keep website content accurate and current, add new pages as needed, and serve as the primary point of contact for NCDVTMH’s contracted webmaster, who handles technical maintenance, software updates, backups, and security.

* **Collaboration:** Work with NCDVTMH staff, partners, and consultants to meet project timelines and adapt content into accessible formats for different audiences.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

The Communications Coordinator will bring strong writing, editing, and organizational skills; working knowledge of social media, email marketing, and website content management; and strong graphic design skills in Canva. title: Director of Marketplaces
